tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi/chos sde'i stod cha rtsa ba gter gzhung gzhung gi skor bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling
bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi/chos sde'i stod cha rtsa ba gter gzhung gzhung gi skor bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi /chos sde'i stod cha rtsa ba gter gzhung gzhung gi skor bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /'bri gung ti sgro'i gter byon bla sgrub rmad/ /pad+ma drag po'i chos sde'i them byang 'god/

de yang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i sgrub skor yin la/ de la'ang zhi drag gnyis kyi nang tshan yang zab bla ma drag po'i sgrub pa ste/ bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma zhes snyigs dus kyi gza' klu rgyal bsen sogs gdon gyi rigs dang gnyan rims nag po sum bsgril sogs sngar ma grags pa'i nad rims dal yams 'joms pa la mchog tu bsngags pa'i gnyen po stobs kyi lha drag po khyung zhon zhes bya ba phrin las lnga yi sgrub skor bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen sogs lam gyi nyams len ma tshang ba med cing zab khyad rmad du byung ba'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang 'god pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor/ yan lag chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor ro/ ༈ dang po rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor la/ ka) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: rgyud rngam klong me yi spu gri/ kha) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: dbang 'bring yang gsang gcig dril/ ga) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: char 'bebs bdud rtsi'i sprin phung*/ nga) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: char gcod me dpung 'khor lo/ ca) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: ser srung srog gi spu gri/ cha) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: sad srung sprin gyi 'khor lo/ ja) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: btsa' srung bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nya) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: nā ga klu 'dul gyi srung ba gser gyi 'khor lo/ ta) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: rgyal bsen gnad 'khor dam tshig srog 'dzin/ tha) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gson 'dre srung mnan bdud mo mthar byed/ da) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: ki king sde brgyad spyi chings zor thun gnad 'khor/ na) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: sngon 'gro man ngag zab don rgyun gyi lam khyer/

pa) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: phrin las lnga sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs/ pha) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: tshe yi zab don gnad kyi sgron me/ ba) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: dbang ltar sgrub pa'i las byang 'chi med bcud dril/ ma) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: 'chi med tshe sgrub rgyun khyer ye shes snying po/ tsa) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: khyung sgrub nā ga 'joms byed/ tsha) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: zhi ba ltar sgrub pa'i las byang snying po kun 'dus/ dza) drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi las byang*/ wa) yang zab pad+ma khrag 'thung las go cha'i lha tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba/ zha) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: mngon rtogs nad 'joms par bu/ za) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril/ 'a) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: smad las rlung gi 'khor lo/ ya) yang zab pad+ma khrag 'thung las: go cha'i lha bzlog dgra bgegs dpung 'joms/ ra) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: yang bzlog spu gri dmar po/ la) bla ma drag po'i gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi'i gtor 'bul/ sha) gter srung ma mo'i mchod thabs/ sa) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor 'bul/ ha) bka' srung bswe yi lha mo'i bskul byang dug gi spu gri/ a) bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gtum mo'i don khrid rlung sems rang grol bcas chos sde gsal byed grangs ldan gter gzhung dang*/ ༈ gnyis pa yan lag chog khrigs sna tshogs skor la/ ki)bla ma pad+ma khrag thung las/ gtor zlog 'don cha'i zin bris dbang po'i lde mig /khi)bla ma drag pad+ma khrag 'thung gi spros bcas sgrub chen gyi stong thun rab 'jigs khro bo rol pa'i gang rgyangs/ gi)thig chen lag len bla la 'dzin bde/ ngi)bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi /sgrub pa'i khog dbub dngos grub nyi ma 'gugs pa'i skya rengs/

bcas stong cha rdzogs so// yang zab drag po khyung zhon las: pad+ma khrag 'thung gi rgyud rngam klong me yi spu gri dmar po bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: : bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan don gyi ched: rkyen ngan bar chad bsal ba'i thabs: yang gsang snying thig gdams pa mchog: bdag nyid drag po he ru ka'i: rgyud byang rngam chen me 'bar bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: e ma: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung : gsang chen me ri 'bar ba ru: thugs rdo rjes dregs pa snying 'byin chen po'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe: phyi nang 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre ma rungs pa rnams kyis tho btsams nas: steng nam mkha' thog ser gyis bkang zhing : 'og sa gzhi rlung dmar sha rbud kyis bkang : mi sdug pa'i gzugs dang skad ngan sna tshogs bsgrags: de'i tshe rdo rje gsal ba'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs pas: sku la thog phab pa dang gnam yang rengs shing nyams te gnod pas phyi yi 'byung ba 'khrugs par btsams te/ yul thams cad la bkra mi shis pa'i rtags ngan pa btang : nad dmar bshal dang tre tre hoḥ lhog yams dmar po 'brum bu sogs: yul thams cad bcud dang mi ldan pa'i rten 'brel ngan pa byas: de'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes dang : rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi ḍāk+ki rnams nam mkha' la 'ja' lhags pa ltar byon te lung bstan pa: e ma: rang byung pad+ma 'byung : mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: ting 'dzin mi shigs go cha can: rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar bsgyur mkhan: he ru ka nyid mchog la bstod: lha 'dre 'byung po mi min rigs: gdug rtsub che ba ru tra'i gzugs: smon lam ngan pa 'di rnams kyis: nyid la bar chod mi tshugs kyang : 'dzam gling kun la gnod par nges: 'phral la gnod dang phugs su phung : ci'i phyir rtswa phung 'og gi me: ma 'ongs dam sri kha dar bas:

'di nyid 'dul ba'i thugs dam bskul: nged kyang rje yi grogs su mchis: zhes phul de yi tshe gu ru'i zhal nas: skye med rig pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: gsang gsum mdzod kyi bdag nyid can: klong lnga gar bsgyur sgeg pa'i gzugs: ye shes ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la bstod: skye med tshig la rjes yi rangs: kho bo'i sems can don las med: bdag gis phrin las bskul ba'i tshe: mkha' 'gro rnams kyang dpung la bzhengs: zhes gsungs nas: slob dpon rdo rje mi g.yo pa'i ting 'dzin las bzhengs te: thugs dam gyi rgyud drag po bskul bas: stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams kun yom zhing shin tu 'gul: de yi tshe 'og min rngam chen me ri 'bar ba'i klong dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: khro rgyal drag po me phreng can gtso 'khor rnams stong khams tshwa tshwas khengs shing chu rdol ba ltar mdun du lhags so: de yi tshe gu ru nyid kyang dbyer med du thim: ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams las kyi khro mor gyur nas: drag po'i yum dang phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs mo mdzad: de yi tshe drag po go cha'i khro tshogs dang bcas te rdzu 'phrul gyis lam la zhugs nas: ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mor byon: srid pa'i bya khyung sde lnga bran du bkol zhing dbang du bsdus te: khyung la chibs nas bya khyung gi 'khor dang bcas nas 'byung po tshogs pa'i gling du byon: 'byung po ma rungs pa'i rigs thams cad dam la btags: khrag 'thung 'byung po 'dul byed du grags: 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre ma rungs pa thams cad sdud cing drag po'i rngam sgra las: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma khrag 'thung rgyal: 'jig rten dregs pa dbang du sdud: lha 'dre ma rungs tshar yang gcod: skye med drag po'i hūm̐ sgra yis: bka' 'gal dam sri rdul du brlag: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri mā ra ya ghardza rbad bh+yoḥ zhes drag sngags btab pas:

dregs pa ma rungs rnams brgyal zhing rengs nas: dbang du bsdus te srog snying phul lo: de yi tshe: pad+ma drag po khrag 'thung du grags: 'og klu yul du byon: klu srin ma rungs pa'i rigs thams cad dam la btags shing tshar bcad pas: drag po me 'bar khyung zhon du grags so: de nas me ri 'bar bar byon nas: yul thams cad du drag sngags kyi char phab pas: 'go ba'i yams nad thams cad myur du zhi: 'jig rten du lo phyugs legs shing bkra shis par gyur: de yi tshe: mtshan rdo rje me 'bar du grags: de nas rdzu 'phrul so sor bshigs ye shes sprul pa'i khro bo rang sar thim: mkha' 'gro rnams kyang so sor gyur: las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis zhus pa: rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru nyid bzhugs pa'i tshe: lha 'dre rnams kyang mi sdang bar gyur lags te: ma 'ongs pa'i dus su: lha srin sde brgyad dang smon lam log pa'i dam sri rnams sdug 'drer skye zhing 'jig rten du yams nad sna tshogs dar: khyad par bdun drug nag po tre tre tar tar dang*/ lhog yams rgyug 'gyel sogs bcos thabs ma mchis pa'i nad dar: 'jig rten rnams la dmag 'khrug lo nyes 'byung : bde ba'i go skabs med: khyad par du rgyal 'gong gi dmag khrims 'khrugs dam sri nag po spun dgu dar: bcos lta med pa'i nad rims 'byung ste mi thog 'bud: de tshe bsam gtan nyal chog lta bu'i gdams pa dang : dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa'i mtshon cha 'dra ba'i gdams pa gu rus gsung du gsol: nged rnams kyi gsang mdzod na: yod pa'i man ngag kyang 'bul lo: zhes zhus: ma hā gu ru thugs rab tu dgyes te: ma 'ongs pa'i don du dmigs nas: bla ma drag po phrin las lnga ltar sgrub pa'i gdams pa dang : man ngag gi skor khyad par gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi skor rnams: gu rus gsungs te mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis brda'i yi ger btab: mkha' 'gro rnams kyis yang gsang snyan brgyud bzhi skor rnams dang :

drag sngags me yi spu gri bzhi pa phul te gu ru'i brdar btab nas: rin po che'i sgrom du bzhag ste rten 'brel lnga'i smon lam mdzad: phyi mor bod du phebs nas gzho stod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du gu ru rin po ches: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mtsho rgyal la sogs pa dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro stong gi gtso bo mdzad nas: rin po che'i sgrom kha phyes pas bod yul du 'ja' 'od dang gur gyis khyab par gzho stod lung pa dri bzang gis gang zhing me tog gi char dpag tu med pa babs: brda yi yig 'bru re re la mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum dngos su rang byon du gyur: tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i tshe: mkha' spyod dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro til gyi gang bu kha phyes pa ltar byon: gu ru yab yum la gsang rgyud gzhan la med pa'i las kyi mkha' 'gro'i chos skor nyi shu rtsa lnga gnang : de yi mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i shog dril nas: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis gsang ba mkha' 'gro la zhus pa'i sgrub skor: gu ru nyid la mkha' 'gros phul ba'i sgrub skor dang : lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor nyi shu ma yi nang nas zab khyad can dang bcas dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gyis mkha' 'gro brda bsgyur gyi yi ger bris gu rus rab tu gnas par mdzad pa dang bcas nas ma 'ongs pa'i don du: tshogs khang gi logs su sbas: gter srung las kyi mkha' 'gro ma la bcol: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i yi ge brda rtags khyad par can rnams las phal cher gu rus zangs mdog dpal rir gdan drangs shing : kha ya bod gangs can gyi ri bo ka ma la'i lho nub tu sbas: de yang rgya rim pa bdun dang bcas so: gzhan yang gzho stod kyi brag tu chos tshan sku gsung thugs kyi gter kha dpag tu med par sbas: gsang gter yang bdun tsam sbas: rdo rje sku gsang ba ye shes ma lnga sbas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi a ma yang dpag tu med pa sbas:

shar phyogs kyi brag sngon po chos 'byung 'dra ba'i logs shig la: rta mgrin h+ya ghṛ wa dpa' gcig dang lcags ral can drang srong gi sgrub skor bcas sbas: gter srung klu mal gro gzi can la bcol: de'i tshe slob dpon la sman chu phul: sbas thabs su mdzad: rta mgrin gyi shog dril yod pa'i thad kar rdo la sgo srung tshul gyis rta mgrin rang byon yod: sa ma ya: e ma yang zab snying thig mchog: sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i snying byang 'di: gzho stod ti sgro'i brag la sbas: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di mkha' 'gros srungs: bdud rigs lag du ma shor la: skal ldan thugs kyi sras la sprod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas/ me sprel lor gdan drangs shing rgya lo drug bsdams nas glang lor sprel zla ba'i tshes la sbas yul pad+ma rong gi skyed tshal gsang sngags chos 'byung gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o// // ༄༅/ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: dbang 'bring yang gsang gcig dril bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dbang mchog yang gsang gcig dril bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po dbang gi rdzas bsags ni: bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings rdzas sman gyis gang ba: bhan+dha bdud rtsi: me long shel rdo: khyung ṛgs lnga: sku 'bag: phrin las bzhi: ging bzhi: ma mo bzhi: dur khrod chas brgyad: bgrang phreng gtor ma rdo rje phur pa: gzhan yang mchod rdzas thams cad tshang bar bsags: las byang gzhung bsrangs sngags la bskyal: bzlas pa byas: de nas gtor ma bsngo zhing slob bu gral du 'khod: khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul: slob mas: hoḥ rdo rje rgyal po rigs kyi gtso:

dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag nyid: deng 'dir yang gsang dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug par stsol: slob dpon gyis: kyaiḥ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: sgom sgrub snying po len nus sam: skal ldan yin na dbang mchog sbyin: skal med rnams la mi bstan no: slob mas: hoḥ bdag ni skal ldan dam tshig can: dkyil 'khor sgom sgrub snying po len: yid dang ngag gus mos blo bstan: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bsrung : slob dpon gyis dam tshig gi chu thogs la: hoḥ khyed rnams skal ldan dam tshig can: las can skyes bur dbang mchog sbyin: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: zhes dam chu sbyin: de nas ma dag pa'i bag chags sbyong bar bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las e mthing nag gru gsum me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su 'jigs byed pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas gsum rdo rje dang gri gug me dpung : g.yon gsum thod khrag dang lcags sdig sbrul zhags 'dzin cing : shin tu khro la bya khyung gis brgyan pa: dur khrod dpa' chas rdzogs shing sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs pa zhabs bzhi gyad dor gyis rdzu 'phrul bya khyung brdzis pa: yum mchog gsang ba'i gtum mo gri thod 'dzin cing 'khyud pa: yab yum me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gzhan yang phrin las bzhi yi lha tshogs phyogs bzhir ging gi dpa' bo yab yum: mtshams bzhi khyung chen: sgo ma bzhi la sogs pa sprul pa yang sprul gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyis spyan drangs slob ma rnams la thim par sgoms: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ

gnas lngar rdo rjes rgya gram bya zhing: oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: slob mas: hūm̐: che mchog drag po rigs kyi bdag: dbang drag pad+ma he ru kaḥ dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi deng 'dir stsol: sgo gsum bskyed rdzogs ngang la gnas: de nas bum pa thogs te ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: skye med bum pa drag po'i mkha': bdud rtsi pad+ma he ru kaḥ yab yum gnyis med dbang bskur ro: bskyed rim sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti mūm̐ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: spros bral rang byung bhan+dha ru: dam tshig bla med rdzas kyis bkang : khrag 'thung yab yum ngo bo nyid: dbang bskur longs sku'i dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti mūm̐ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas me long thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag rang bzhin rig pa'i mdangs: zang thal ma 'gags ngo bo nyid: khrag 'thung yab yum thugs rje dngos: dbang bskur chos dbyings don ldan shog: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti mūm̐ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas sku 'bag thogs la: hūm̐: longs sku skye med he ru kaḥ gnyis med sprul sku khro bo'i rgyal: 'jigs byed yab yum dbang bskur ro: zung 'jug bde stong dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti mūm̐ gu na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: dam tshig rmad byung bha ling+ta: dbang bskur tshogs gtor bskang bshags dang : dus mchod la sogs 'dzin par gyis: mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti mūm̐ gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas zhi ba'i tsakli thogs la: hūm̐: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan yum dang sbyor: mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor dang bcas: zhi ba yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro: oṃ gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rgyas pa'i tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: longs spyod rdzogs sku dbang phyug dzam+bha la:

sa snying mdog can yum dang sbyor: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: rgyas pa yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ gu ru puṇ+ya ḍāk+ka ḍāk+ki a pa ra mi ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas dbang gi tsakli thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes tshe bdag dbang gi sku: in+d+ra'i mdog can yum dang sbyor: tshe bdag mgyogs ma 'bum gyis bskor: tshe lha yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro: oṃ pad+ma hrī dha ya ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga thogs la: hūm̐: las kyi dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro ma: ljang mo rlung gi rang bzhin can: rang 'dra lnga dang yang 'khor 'bum: dpal bskyed mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ baṃ ḍāk+ki te dz+wa ha ri ni sa pra mo ti ri sid+dhi dza dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas khyung rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ me gshog lcags sder zangs mchu rngam: deng 'dir khyod kyi dbu la brgyan: dbang rtags cod pan thob par shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ga ru ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje gri gug me dpung dang : thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul gyi zhags: skal ldan g.yas g.yon lag tu gtad: bdud bzhi tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra ā yur dha ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: prog zhu glang ko sbrul zhags pags: khrag zhag thal tshom seṅge'i pags: thod phreng rus rgyan stag sham brjid: dpal chas lus rgyan dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī an+ḍa dā sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas ging bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: sgrol ging gtum ging khro ging dang : las kyi ging dang yum chen bzhi: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: dpa' bo yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ tshur+dhi tshur+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas khyung bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kyi: sprul pa bya khyung chen po bzhi: krang kring sgra sgrogs klu gnyan 'joms:

zangs mchu lcags sder me gshog can: rigs bzhi khyung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa tur mu kha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas gdong mo bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: sdig pa chu srin phag dang khyung : rang bzhin gdong can skyong ma bcas: dam tshig las kyi bya ra ma: sha za rigs bzhi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma mo kro ti mu kha le tsa tur a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas phur pa thogs la: hūm̐: khro rgyal kun gyi phrin las sku: phyag na rdo rje phur bu 'di: skal ldan g.yas g.yon lag tu gtad: sbyor sgrol las mtha' 'dzin par gyis: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya karma dzaḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca satwaṃ: hom gzar blugs gtad la: hūm̐: thabs shes kun gyi ngo bo nyid: las mtha' mnan sreg 'phang ba'i zor: phrin las ma nges sna tshogs rigs: rgyun du 'dzin pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ karma pra wa ti a hu ti ku ru sa ma ya: de nas bgrang phreng gtad la: hūm̐: drag sngags rdo rje dmod pa nyid: gzungs sngags snying po lon par gyis: rtag tu rbad 'gugs bsgral thun sbrags: las bzhi sngags kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ an+t+ra dha ra tsaṇ+ḍa dha ra hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas bum pa shes rab ye shes kyi ngo bo dang me long shel rdo 'od 'bar ba thogs la: hūm̐: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid: snang stong ye shes rang bzhin mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: spyod pa tshogs drug lam khyer gyis: oṃ tsar+ya pra ni spar+she ṣ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas shes rab kyi dbang ni: hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren zungs: dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ: pra mo ti ri mi dharma hoḥ de nas shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: kun gzhi skye med stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid:

ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dz+nyā na hṛ da ya hūm̐: de nas tshig dbang rin pau che'i ngo sprod ni: hoḥ snang zhing stong pa'i chos thams cad bdag med pa'i rang bzhin dbyings la dbang po'i gzhu shar ba chu nang gi zla ba mngon pa ltar: snang la rang bzhin bral ba dbyings dang shel sgong 'phrod pa lta bu'o: gnyis pa shes rab bde ba chen po zung 'jug gi dus su mngon sum lta bu gzhon nu mas bde ba'i ro myong ba ltar: dbyer med kyi dus su lkugs pas rmi lam mthong ba lta bu brjod bya kha las 'das pa ste: tshig gis mtshon du med pa: ro gcig dus su khyab brdal chen po ngos bzung bral ba: blo 'das zang thal gcig tu byed pa'o: sgra rnams kyang grags stong skye ba med pa'o: gsum pa ye shes chen po yang : chos sku blo 'das ye nas stong pa de yang ma 'gags ci yang 'char ba: rang bzhin gsal la mi dmigs pa: rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba ka dag rang dbyings rdzogs pa'o: bzhi pa byar med tshig dbang ni: rig pa bsal bzhag bral ba ye nas rang byung 'od kyi snying po che stong pa rang byung can de'o: de yang med pa zang thal ma yin pas: sku gsum gyis mtshon pa: stong pa chos sku sems kyi gzhi: gsal ba longs sku sems kyi ngo bo: thugs rje sprul sku sems kyi nges tshig go: de yang med bzhin 'char ba me long gi 'gying logs dang shel rdo'i byad mig tu sgro btags pa lta bu'o: de bzhin du deng phyin chad 'dzin med ngo bo: rang gsal ye shes chen po la gnas par gyis shig: des bla ma drag po'i bskyed rdzogs dbyer med zung 'jug gi dbang thob pa yin pas deng nas bzung ste lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin mos pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p bkra shis las byang ltar bya: gtang rag bcas dkyil 'khor bsdu: rten 'brel legs pa'i rnam dbye dge bskul kyang bya'o:

lo mtshams med par dbang mi sbyin par shin tu bka' gnyan pas gar thod thod du bskul mi rung ngo : dam du 'chang bar bya: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: phyi rabs skal ldan rjes 'jug don: yang zab gsang ba'i rim pa bzhag: rgya 'di las kyi ma mos srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: o rgyan gter bdag gling la sprod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gnyan rgya: dam rgya: bdag kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas/ me sprel lor gdan drangs shing glang lor sbas yul pad+ma rong gi chos sdings nam mkha' 'brug grags su/ sangs rgyas lhum zhugs kyi zla tshes la shog ser las zhal bsgyur ro// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: char 'bebs bdud rtsi'i sprin phung bzhugs so: thod phreng drag po'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: dus ngan bskal pa'i yang mtha' la: dug lnga'i kha zas du ba rngub: steng 'og bar gsum lha klu 'khrugs: char chu mi snyoms sad ser ldang : tshe thung nad mang dbul zhing mug: de tshe byang chub sems ldan pas: lha klu gso zhing gter bcud sbas: ri khros bka' nan tha tshig bor: bod khams bde ba'i phrin las bcol: char pa 'bebs na 'di ltar bya: rtsa ba'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: nā ga ka la bha ri sha ya swā hā: dkar mngar klu sman bag zan la: sbyar ba'i ril bu re re la: sngags ni brgya rtsa re btab pas: klu gnas chu mig nang du blug: klu gtor btang zhing bden pa brdar: char pa 'bebs par the tshom med: ྀatsha: rgya rgya rgya: gal te phebs par ma gyur na: klu gnyan lha srin gnad la dbab: rgyal rigs bstan 'dzin gri khrag dang : rje rigs yugs sa'i mngal khrag dang : gtsod khrag bram ze gnyan po dang : mdze khrag dmangs rdol rigs kyi gnyan: gla rtsi klu rigs kun gyi gnyan: sbal sha klu yi bu thams cad: sbrul sha klu yi btsun mo dang :

nya sha klu yi bran rnams dang : sdig pa klu srin gnyan rgod rnams: te lo'i sha khrag gza' gnyan po: btsan dug ra gzhob lha srin spyi: gnyan po de rnams zhib par sbyar: ril bur dril te drag sngags sgrub: snyug tshig nang blugs rtsa sngags gsham: thum thum chem chem badz+ra phyir chad swā hā: zhes bris gzhug cing g.yag rog gi: snying rtsed khyi nag spus bcings la: la cha'am ni spra tshil byugs: gtsod mdzo ru dang phag mig gzhob: phyi nas klu sman mar sbyar gtum: chu mig gnyan nges shig gam phug: rdo la 'og la rgya gram ri gling steng la bris: bar du gzhug cing skyer phur gdab: nang du chu ni shor gyur na: rang nyid mdze nad dag gis 'khyer: de phyir rdzas sngags 'khor lo dang : byugs pa rgyan 'khor la sogs gces: chu mig klu yi pho brang na: phuḥyig zla 'od bsil zer gyis: 'jig rten khams kyi klu rigs bkug: phyogs bcur khro bcu bya khyung mes: srid pa mtha' sdud gzhom zhing spur: klu rnams 'bros pa'i gnas med par: skoms pa chu la snyoms pa bzhin: phuḥl 'bral mi phod par thim: bde ba'i 'od snang rgyas pa'i shugs: skad cig klu rgyal sku mdog dkar: sbrul mgo dgu la nor bus brgyan: phyag gnyis thal sbyar nor bu 'dzin: sku stod lha la sku smad sbrul: klu chen brgyad dang klu rigs bskor: sbrul mjug rgya mtshor dkrugs pa yis: sa gzhi bar snang na bun dang : char sprin glog 'khyugs 'brug sgra 'bir: 'dzam gling g.yo nus char chen po: myur ba nyid du 'bab par dmigs: gong gi sngags bzlas phyogs mtshams kun: bya khyung khro bos srung mtshams bcad: zhag gsum tshun chad char 'bebs 'gyur: phebs la rdzas phyungs klu sman sba: klu gtor btang zhing klu chog 'bad: phyis kyang 'phro gtsang shin tu dge: nam dgos dus su phebs par 'gyur: de tshe rlung gi gnod gyur na: dug shog ngos la dug khrag gis:

mi lus bya mchu lcags sgrog bcing : snying khar tri dza sa ma ya dam sri mā ra ya nan: a tam i tam bha yu satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes bris gzig spyang sre mong sha: klu bdud rdo rje bong nag dang : dbyi mong nag po'i khu bas byug: bden stobs 'gugs stim nan tan bya: skams gsher mtshams su spyi ltar mnan: de yis rlung gis gnod mi nus: char pa 'bebs nas dbyung bar gces: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gter bdag gling pas gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas spyan drangs pa'o/ sarba maṅga lam// // bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: char gcod me dpung 'khor lo bzhugs so: thod phreng drag po'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: sgom grwar kha char bu yug gnod: bas mtha'i nags rong dben par 'grim: gang 'tshams lo thog yul ljongs la: kha char bu yug gnod pas na: srung thabs man ngag khyad par can: ḍāk+ki'i gsang ba'i snying zhun bstan: dbang rdzas bsnyen sgrub drod thob c-ing : gzhan phan sems bskyed ldan pa yis: sbyar ba skyer pa bsregs pa'i thal: bag phyer bsres la sbal gzugs bzos: hūm̐ phu nā ga du tsan+dhe tsan+dhe mi li mi li bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni swā hā: phyogs skyong bcu'i gdon bgegs 'byung po 'byung ba kha char bu yug gi bdag po bdag mo thams cad mā ra ya myog myog ram̐ ram̐ ram̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces bris sbal pa'i snying khar gzhug: dung bus klu gnyan gnas sa yi: g.ya' sgrom zur gsum nang du bskyil: bden stobs 'gugs bstim drag tu bya: kha chod rdo ba'i logs su ni: tshar rdzas byugs la steng nas bkab: kha khob sbal pa reg tsam bya: de yi steng du dug shing la: sbal sbrul nya sha sre mong sha: wa sha gu gul mu zi dang : yugs khrag mdze pho'i skra sen gos: mi rigs mi gcig dgu'i skra sen: mi rta khyi gsum rus pa rnams:

zhib sbyar khrag gi snod chen btab: de nang dug shing thams cad brang : cung zad bskams nas me rnams sbar: me de khyung gi pho brang dmigs: rang nyid drag po khyung zhon sku: steng gi lha dang 'og gi klu: bar gyi sde brgyad zhabs 'og mnan: drag po'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le bh+yo bh+yoḥ oṃ dhe wa ra tsa phaṭ chod: nā ga ra tsa phaṭ chod: ya ma shwa shwa phaṭ chod: yo ge shwa shwa phaṭ chod: bh+rūm̐ dhe shwa shwa phaṭ chod: spra mo te shwa shwa phaṭ chod: ram̐ ram̐ shwa shwa phaṭ chod: 'u ṭa 'u ṭa shu shu phaṭ chod: e hi hi hu hu phaṭ chod: ha ha chod: hu hu chod swā hā: khri bzlas snang srid me yi dal: bya khyung rang bzhin khro chu'i rba: drag tu 'khrugs pas char bdag dang : sprin dang na bun thul gyis bsregs: mda' dar dmar po la sngags pas: phyogs mtshams g.yug cing mi dmigs bsgoms: rgya thab mang po'i tha tshig dmar: gro phye la btag gtor kyang thum: tho rangs bya skad ma grags gong : mi khyi'i skad kyang med pa'i dus: sngags bzlas nam mkha' phu yis gdab: sa ma ya: gdong bzlog byed na shug pa yi: ral gri ngos la rdzas chu dang : rgya tshwa bsres pas drag sngags sham:

oṃ sprin gyi rlung 'dzing pa shig khrol: sprin gyi gzer mgo shig khrol: sprin gyi spo ti khroṃ shig khrol: ma ti khroṃ khroṃ shig khrol: rlung gi rgyal po 'ur ljing chen gyis sprin phung gtor gtor shig: rlung ha tis shig gtor gtor phaṭḥ rlung lha mgyogs byed kyi sprin phung thams cad shig cig gtor cig swā hā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bha yaṃ bha yaṃ bha yaṃ ram̐ ram̐ ram̐ zlog zlog: ces bris drag por mnga' gsol bskyed: sku las me rlung cher g.yos pas: sprin phung gtor dmigs nam mkhar g.yug: des ni nges par bzlog par 'gyur: las grub me thabs so sor bsdu: bag zan sbal pa'i khong sngags phyungs: chu dkar klu sman khrus dang bcas: chu bor gshegs shing klu gtor btang : kha kheb g.yam pa khrag gis bkrus: dag par chu dkar 'o mas bshal: dben par bsdu zhing nam dgos spyad: sa ma ya: bstan du srung bar mi lcogs dang : yul phyogs gzhan du bsrung dgos na: mtshams phur tho yi man ngag ni: rdza bum gas chag med pa'i nang : lan tshwa mkhar sgong srub med dang : gang srung yul de'i chu sna bsdus: bzang drug ga pur klu sman btab: srung mtshams ri bo thon pa'i mtshams: tho yi 'og tu dung brus gzhug: klu gnyan char bdag 'gugs gzhug bstim: de steng rdo ba 'jam pa gnyis: mu khyud gsum gsum bskor ba'i dbus: yul chaig mo'i 'dir sde brgyad kyi kha char 'tshubs mar ma 'bab cig: kha ba zlog zlog: bu yug chod chod: chu bor sngon po ram̐ shig ram̐ ram̐ swā hā: bum pa'i 'og gi 'dab brgyad la: nag po shu shu rbad: dhe ba ra tsa rbad: nā ga ra tsa rbad: tsa tra ka ru ye rbad: ma ma shu shu rbad: ri bo kun 'dus rbad: kha ba rang ring rbad: kha 'tshubs 'khyil ma rbad: ces bris steng gi rtsibs brgyad la: e khroṃ ram̐ ram̐ ram̐: ma hā gu ru ta nā ga gshed du ram̐ ram̐ ram̐: trag sha mu me du ram̐ ram̐ ram̐: sa du sa ma ya tri ram̐ ram̐ ram̐:

sa tha ra srog thig ram̐ ram̐ ram̐: dha ha dha ha pa tsa pa tsa tshal pa tshal pa: kha ba bhan sman ku ru u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ki king bu mo sarba lig tshar rbad rbad: ces bris gnyis ka'i mu khyud la: bram bram g.ya' la bram nag la bram bram: ze zhon: sna zhon: sgang zhon: yam̐ yam̐ yam̐ gtor gtor phaṭ phaṭḥ rdzas dang phur pa 'di las ma 'da' cig: ces pa yi mgo nang bstan bri: bar du seng ldeng phur pa'i logs: na mo bud+dha ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: nā ga du tsan+dhe tsan+dhe mi li mi li bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni swā hā: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rbad rbad: thum thum chil chil hūm̐ phaṭḥ bha yaṃ bha yaṃ sarba shag khrol zlog: ces bris khrag 'thung mnga' gsol gzugs: lha klu sde brgyad pho brang steng : phur bu khro bos zer gyis mnan: nam mkha' khyung gi 'khor lor bsam: gang srung yul der phye phud bsdus: sde brgyad brngan mchod rgyas par bskang : dam brdar bka' nan las gnyer gtad: tho mtshams tshun chad kha char ni: 'da' bar gyur na pad+mas bslus: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma shin tu zab pa'i gnad: 'di nyid mang du spel gyur na: rang nyid nor rdzas dbul por 'gyur: shin tu gsang ba gnad du che: do gal che na spyad par bya: sngon du grangs bsnyen thim pa gces: gal ma mchis na tshod blang ni: gdams pa'i drod 'chor byin rlabs g.yer: the tshom med par phur du 'chong : las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lo gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las bshus so// // bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: ser srung srog gi spu gri bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: pad+ma drag po'i rnal 'byor pas: 'gro ba'i lo tog smin pa la: sde brgyad kha rlangs bsam sbyor dug: ser ba bsrung na 'di ltar bya: bsam pa bya rog ma dag la:

gla rtsi btsan dug mu zi dang : te lo'i khrag dang sre mong klad: bya rog snying dang sbrul sha bcas: rgya snag rgya mtshal la sbyar ba'i: mu khyud gsum gyi lte bar khrom̐: drag po'i rtsa sngags sham bu ru: bzlas sngags 'dod gsol dang bcas bri: de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ya ma trig nan li tsa rbad rbad dgra la bh+yoḥ de bzhin ya mi gnas mal du: rag mo? rā dza tri? du tri? mun tri? phu tri? ra tri? tsa tri? zhes bsgyur gong 'og mtshungs par bkod: rtsibs mchan la: gshin rjes ser ba dgra la bh+yo phaṭḥ ma mos ser ba dgra la bh+yo phaṭḥ rgyal pos ser ba dgra la bh+yo phaṭḥ bdud kyis ser ba dgra la bh+yo phaṭḥ rmu yis ser ba dgra la bh+yo phaṭḥ klu yis ser ba dgra la bh+yo phaṭḥ gza' yis ser ba dgra la bh+yo phaṭḥ btsan gyis ser ba dgra la bh+yo phaṭḥ mu khyud la: sangs rgyas kyi bden pas ser ba zlog: chos dang dge 'dun rtsa ba gsum: chos skyong rten 'brel bden stobs sgyur: me ri ram̐ gyis mtshan pas bskor: chu yis mi gnod spra tshil btang : lhar bskyed 'gugs shing rtsa sngags gsham: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri trig nan: e hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: li tsa rbad rbad: dgra la bh+yoḥ zhag gsum bzlas shing thun la sngags: gang du bsrung ba'i yul phyogs de'i: gzhi bdag brngan mchod bka' bsgo bya: 'khor lo bsrung yul mtshams su gzugs: des ni ser ba nges par thub: gdong bzlog srung na sngags bzlas shing : ro sreg tha tshig yungs dkar nag: drag po'i ting 'dzin ngar ldan pa'i: srung yul me rlung mtshon tshogs 'khrugs: gnod byed rdul du brlags par dmigs: yud tsam bskyar zhing phyogs su 'phang : thun gyis brdeg pas nges par thub: sa ma ya: e maḥ ser srung 'bum sde'i bcud phyung ba: ser gdong sde brgyad srog gi gshed: drag sngags kun gyi stobs 'dus pa:

dmod pa mtshon cha'i spu gri yin: gang du thug kyang thal bar brlag: dus ngan bskal pa'i yang mtha' la: nang rgyas gtad ser dar ba'i dus: ser srung spyi yis thub par dka': rang gshed srog gi 'khor lo ni: 'phral du bzlog par the tshom med: mang du ma spel gu h+ya rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: sad srung sprin gyi 'khor lo bzhugs: dbang drag he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: thugs rje drag po'i rnal 'byor pas: gzhan don 'gro la sems bskyed nas: sde brgyad kha rlangs sad srung na: yul lha mchod cing bden pa brdar: chu mig kun du klu sman dang : snyug tshig gzhug cing klu rnams bskyed: sprin bsdu sngags ni nub mo nas: mang du bzlas te srung mtshams 'ub: rang nyid klu rgyal sku mdog dmar: sku stod sprin bsdus phyag rgya can: sku smad sbrul mjug rgya mtsho dkrugs: na bza' sprin gyi phung po bklubs: sa gzhi bar snang thams cad kun: na bun char bsil 'tshub par sgoms: nā ga ka la bha ri sha ya hūm̐ bab bab hūm̐ sob sob hūm̐ sprin bsdus rak+ṣa swā hā: snga dro klu la char gtor btang : dgong mo phyogs gtor cha gsum btang : khrus dang bsang mchod yul lha brngan: nub mo sprin gyis 'dra ba na: rta pho gro dkar bsang sbyangs la: sprin dang sprin lha grogs su bcug: oṃ ka na ka kho ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ mang du bzlas shing rta sgrog bcug: rta dngos ma 'byor 'dam gtsang mar: spos dang rat+na'i phye bsres sbyar: rta gzugs bzos la dngos su bsam: gong ltar sgrog tu bcug par bya: sprin gyi lha rnams brtod la non: sprin dang na bun gyis mi 'gyur: rlung gi g.yer na rlung non bya: dam sri 'gong po'i gnod gyur na:

ar gtad drag pos gzir zhing mnan: las rnams grub nas snyug tshig bsdu: rlung non dbyung zhing khrus bshags bya: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing*/ chu glang lor shog ser las zhal bshus so/ bkra shis par shog/ // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: btsa' srung bdud rtsi chu rgyun bzhugs so: thod phreng drag po'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: drag po pad+ma'i rnal 'byor pas: gzhan phan phrin las 'jug pa'i sgo: zhing la btsa' nad bsrung byed na: sde brgyad brtan ma mdos kyis brngan: phyogs gtor chab gtor mang du btang: phung 'gong za 'dre kha sbyor bya: zhing gi mu mtha' thams cad nas: phye mar dri bzang sman sna bsres: dam rdzas a mṛ tas bran pa'i: gsur dud btang zhing 'byung por bsngo: rang rang las dang rnam smin gyi: khong khro gdug rtsub zhi bar bsam: zhing dbus spyan ras gzigs dbang gi: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: btsa' nad thams cad dag par dmigs: yi ge drug pa'i sham bu ru: me zhu chu ser bu shol kā li nan: sum kha bhi ri sha sod: mang du bzlas shing gla ba'i spu: g.ya' mtshams gang zhabs sa gtsang mar: sngags te khye'u gtsang ma yis: nangs rer gtor na nges par sel: skam btsa' la ni char 'bebs bya: rlon btsa' la ni sa sna la: cong zhi gtsang chen byad ma bsregs: sarba kham g.yer kham g.yer byil swā hā: khri phrag bzlas nas zh-ing la gtor: gzhan yang rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i: chu sna klu sman dam rdzas btab: gzungs chu zhing ljongs khyab par gtor: stong nyid snying rje 'byong ba yis: 'phral du phan par the tshom med: rang 'dod nga rgyal rlom sems kyis: 'byung po'i gdug rtsub zhi bar dka': de phyir dbang rdzas bsnyen sgrub thim: gzhan phan sems bskyed ldan pa yis: gang ltar rtsom pa de bzhin 'grub:

las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas: me sprel lo 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: nā ga klu 'dul gyi srung ba gser gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: nā ga rak+sha 'chi bdag 'jigs byed rgyal: bde gshegs stobs 'dus bcas chog bsrung ba bstan: de la lo rgyus bri thabs rab gnas dang : ngo mtshar yon tan dang bcas don lnga las: dang po yid ches bskyed pa'i lo rgyus ni: sngon tshe rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi lhor: byad yul mtha' 'khob mun pa'i gling gcig na: klu nag 'dam 'dzin gdol pa dbugs bsdus gnas: 'gro ba'i srog gcod mdze rigs bco brgyad btang : shrī singhas de nyid 'dul dgongs tshe: ḍāk+ki gser mche can gyis lung bstan nas: klu bdud 'chi bdag gser gyi 'khor lo can: rdo rje gdan gyi ka ba byang chub shing : de la yod pa phyungs la thugs rjes bskyed: ces bstan pha lam rdo rje'i rgya phyes pas: chu dar smug ser gser gyis bris pa la: shel gyi glegs shing 'dzam gling 'od 'geng zhig: thob ste baiḍūr gzhi la gser gyis bris: phyi mo shul du sbas te rgya yis gdab: bram ze he ru ka yi spun bdun sogs: gdams pa btags pas mi nor longs spyod rgyas: yul phyogs thams cad bde zhing skyid par 'gyur: shrī singhas bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung : bod du 'byon khar mtha' 'khob yul de yang : ston pa'i zhabs ni ma bcag gdug rtsub can: gnyan po'i lha srung 'di nyid sbyin gces gnang : bdag gis bod du 'khyer bar chas pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs thugs 'khreng zhing : 'dzam gling klu rnams cho nge der gyis song :

bal po'i gyi nag mal gro'i gzi chen sogs: sa gzhi kun btul lha srin dam la btags: rnga yab gshegs khar bsam yas dbu rtse ru: lha sras rje dang mtsho rgyal nam snying sogs: thugs sras lnga la brtse bas dgongs te gnang : mal gro la sogs 'dzam gling klu rigs kyis: rin chen sna bdun char phab dbu rtser bskor: slob dpon bka' gnyan mi 'da' dam la btags: ma 'ongs pa na bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir: gdol pa'i spyod pas sa rgod rdo rgod dang : chu rgod shing rgod gnyan rigs kun la bsdos: mnan gtad ser rgod phung sel sna tshogs byed: sa bdag gdug pa can thug mdze rigs ldang : zab phyir ma 'ongs don du gter du sbos: gsang gter thugs kyi man ngag gu h+ya rgya: sa ma ya: gnyis pa tsakra ji ltar bri ba ni: rgyal lam sa ri dmag dpon dar ba'i nyin: dmar smug mthing ba'i dar shog gang rung la: rab gser 'bring mtshal tha ma rgya snag la: rin chen brdar ba'i snag tshas mu khyud drug: lte bar khrom̐ḥmathar sngags mgo phyir bstan du: oṃ ra wa ta dha ṭa t+yaṃ 'chang ba po'i thugs rdo rjer byin gyis brlab tu gsol: rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: oṃ ma ka ma ya tra swā hā: 'chang ba po'i ngag rdo rjer byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ bi khrab khroṃ 'chang ba po'i lus rdo rjer byin gyis brlab tu gsol: de'i phyir mu khyud rtsibs lngar khyung re bris: sbrul gyi lto bar mgo skor lag gis brgyang : gong dbur sbrul dkar khyung gi lto ba ru: oṃ gha bha sgad pa ta ra khroṃ: oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya klu dmangs rigs kyi dug lnga phyir zlog: g.yas skor khyung bzhi rim pa bzhin du bri: oṃ ra ma sga za ṭa ṭa khrom̐ ze: oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya klu gdol pa'i dug sogs? oṃ ba ṭa gha za ṭa ṭa hūm̐: oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya klu rgyal rigs kyi dug sogs? oṃ gra han hi ra khrom: nag po ti pa tsa ya klu rje rigs kyi dug sogs?

oṃ gha ra gha pa ra ṭa nu ṭāṃ: nag po ti pa ra tsa ya klu bram ze'i dug? sogs bri: de yi phyi rim mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra pā ṇi badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā yak+sha ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ nā ga du tsan dhe tsan dhe mi li mi li bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni 'chang ba po la sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa thams cad srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: de yi phyi rol mu khyud kyi rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis: 'khor lo'i thad ni g.yas skor rim pa bzhin pad+ma rdo rje rin chen rgya gram lam: oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya hūm̐: bud+dha ga ru ṭa oṃ: oṃ nā ga phe lam hūm̐: des 'gres bar: pad+ma ga ru ṭa hrīḥ badz+ra ga ru ṭa hūm̐: rat+na ga ru ṭa trām̐: karma ga ru ṭa āḥ de yi phyi mu khyud la ye dharmā tshar bdun bris: khor yug me ri lnga ldan g.yas su bskor: phyi khog 'jam dpal thugs sprul 'jigs byed rgyal: nā ga rak+sha gser gyi 'khor lo can: khro zhal ma he'i ra can dmar nag mdog: sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka phyag g.yas sbrul zhags dang : g.yon pas nad rkyal sngo dmar 'phyar stabs 'dzin: snyan cha sbrul rgyan g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar: sbrul mjug sngo nag pad+ma'i gdan la 'khyil: bar mtshams khor yug me dpung 'tshub rgyas bri: de ltar yi ge rnams ni gser gyis bri: ma 'byor gyur na khyung dang lte bar khroṃ: ye dhar la sogs gser gyis bris kyang rung : chad lhag 'gyil bug bris bsub med pa bcos:

gsum pa rab gnas bya ba ni: gong gi gza' skar bzang po la: bdag nyid drag po'i ting 'dzin ngang : 'khor lo klu bdud ji lta ba: sku che yan lag shin tu rags: dbu ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten brgal: ri rab la ni sku stegs bya: lto ba bar snang khams gsum khyab: mjug ma rgya mtsho'i steng du 'khyil: rab 'jigs bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ak+ṣi phi lang sngags sgra sgrogs: 'jig rten gsum po bsreg cing gzhom: sa bdag klu gnyan snying rtsa yom: lta bas mi bzod 'jigs pa'i sku: spyi bor 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag ral gri sdigs mdzub mdzad: mgrin par 'phags mchog rta mgrin dbang : dmar nag dbyug tho sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: thugs kar rdo rje gtum po mthing : rdo rje sdigs mdzub me dpung 'bar: de nyid lto bar yangs pa'i klong : bris pa'i tsakra ji bzhin pa'i: rtsibs steng bya khyung rigs lnga dang : sngags rnams yig 'bru'i rnam pa la: ngo bo bde gshegs khro bo'i tshogs: bdag dang tsakra las 'od 'phros: 'og min dag pa rab 'byams nas: ye shes lha tshogs yig 'bru'i char: dpag med spyan drangs bskyed par bstim: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rdzogs pa'i: gzi byin rab tu 'bar bar dmigs: tsakra'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa'am: nyer gcig bdun sogs gang 'grub bzla: rten 'brel brgya rtsa'i rab gnas byas: lteb la tshon skud dar snas g.yogs: lcags sna gsum gyi gwa'ur bzhag: 'khor lo dang ni bsrung bya la: rdzas rgod dam ni gu gul dang : khyi spyang brun dang gla rtsi yi: dud pas bdug cing thun gyis brab: lag kun mi rgyud 'dor bar bya: mi la klu thebs dus mi rtags: mi la mi gnod lhog dus btags: sa ma ya: bzhi pa ngo mtshar yon tan ni: bde gshegs sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las 'dus ba'i khyung 'khor gyis: sgo gsum sku gsung thugs su mthong : rtsibs lngar sbrul dang klu'i snying pos: bskor ba'i klu rigs rnam pa lngas:

rje btsun su mthong gnod mi nus: gser 'khor khyung gi 'og mnan pas: 'dzam gling klu yis dgra mi nus: bde gshegs stobs 'dus drag sngags bskor: sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs: rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis bskor bas: klu rigs lnga yi dug lnga zlog: klu chen brgyad kyi drag sngags bskor: klu bdud nā ga rak+sha mthong : rten 'brel snying po bdun bskor gyis: sde brgyad gang gis mthong mi 'gyur: yon tan bdun ldan btags chog 'di: sus kyang spyir ni sde brgyad thub: dgos su klu gnyan sa bdag gis: bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar bar mthong : lha srin gang gis 'da' mi nus: yul gsar 'dzin dang sa gnyan slog: thog ser 'bebs dang mnan gtad brtsam: klu yi grong khyer me bsreg sogs: drag po'i las ni gang byas kyang : rang lus rdo rje'i sku ru 'gyur: mdze rigs yod sar btags gyur na: the tshom med par thub par 'gyur: 'go zin tsam la btags gyur na: thu lum mi 'gro tshe tshad bsring : phan yon bde 'bras bsam mi khyab: e maḥ dus ngan bskal pa'i yang mtha' la: gdol pa'i spyod pas klu dang thug: gdug pa zhe gnag smyugs su ring : mi rnams phal cher klu yis zin: de tshe 'gro ba skyob pa'i slad: dbang drag 'bar ba'i las mthar bsdebs: ti sgrau'i tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: sum cu'i mthar thug nyi shu'i dus: shar phyogs mi nag bod du lud: rta sha za zhing chung ma gsod: rdzas ngan dud pa gnam du bsgreng : dmar sbrengs drag shul sna tshogs byed: bod khams lha klu thams cad 'khrugs: mi nad phyugs nad sna dgu ldang : bod khams sdug gis mnar ba'i dus: sngags 'chang bud+dha dz+nyā na yi: thugs sprul drag sngags bka' bab pa: pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las phab pa'o/

sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: rgyal bsen gnad 'khor dam tshig srog 'dzin bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rgyal bsen srog gi gnad 'khor bstan: bskal pa dus kyi snyigs ma la: skye 'gro log spyod sdig la rngam: dam chos bka' log khrims shor mang : shi pho dam sri ma rungs skyes: nad du smyo 'bog mdze lhog ldang : gnod du rgyal bsen shi 'dre gnod: lha ru gri pho dam sri mchod: dpe dkar rgyal 'gong kha dar bas: skye 'gro kun gyi tshe srog 'phrog: chos pa yongs la bar chod brtsam: pad+ma bdag gi brgyud 'dzin la: cung zad gnod 'tshe chung gyur kyang : gnad kyi srog 'khor yang zab 'di: 'chang bas sngon gyis dam dran te: gnod par mi nus phrin las sgrub: de phyir 'di 'chang sngags pas kyang: rang dang bstan pa skyong ba yi: rgyud 'dzin re tsam ma gtogs pa: rgyal po'i gnod pas 'khu mi ldog: rtag tu bskyed rdzogs don ldan pas: bu nor chos brgyud rgyas par 'ong : dus mthar rdo rje theg pa yi: gter srung gza' klu rgyal po mchod: ci phyir sde gsum dar ba'i dus: dgra ru mi ldang lhar mchod pas: gdon bgegs ma lus grogs su mchod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de la rgyal bsen gnad 'khor ni: ro ras sam ni dug shog la: rgyal gzugs sa zhu ber 'jol can: rkang lag lcags kyis bcings pa yis: lte bar mu khyud bzhi ru bskor: ru tri hri hūm̐ phaṭḥ nang gzhug: de ltar dam tshig srog sngags bskor: drag po'i rtsa sngags sham bu ru: hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra badz+ra kro ta kro ta thib thā thib thā ra tsa sid+dhi a mṛ te hūm̐: sa ma ya: sa ma ya: sa ma ya satwaṃ: e a ra li dza dza: dam dam mā ra ya: dam tshig srog la sa mā ya dza dzaḥ 'chang ba la rak+ṣa: de yi phyi mu khyud snying po'i sngags: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ra tsa'i tsit+ta zung zung : kha rag sme sha rbad rbad:

ra tsa khu na dum bur shig shig: dha na rak+ṣa ra tsa'i tsit+ta phyung phyung : ldog na rak+sha ra tsa'i tsit+ta rbad rbad: ya tri ya: ya tri ya: ma tri ya: ma tri ya: ma zhung tri ya: ma zhung tri ya: braṃ dza braṃ dzaḥ ra tsa rak+mo tri li hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya tri sod bdag la rak+ṣa: de yi phyi rtsibs drug mnan pa'i sngags: oṃ badz+ra sum tri rak+sha nan: sa du rak+sha nan: tri du rak+sha nan: tsakra nan: 'byung po ya ma sho nan: tri'u tri'u nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: laṃ nan mā ra phaṭḥ rak+mo mā ra ya chings nan: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ ru tra'i tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ tsa mun tri tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ de yi mu khyud bcing ba'i sngags: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ra tsa thum a tri rbad: ra tsa shag dun khong tri rbad: tsit+ta gtub gtub ra tsa ha tri sum tri nan sod: e ru mun thum dza la rbad: snying la ling : mo du tri ma shang srol dril: mu tsa mu tsa snying la hur thum a tri rbad: sum tri shag shar rag mo rag mo snying la gzer thum rbad sod: tri mā ra ya: dam tshig srog la sa ma ya: srog bdag snying la sa ma ya: bsen mo'i snying la sa ma ya: gnod byed snying la sa ma ya: bh+yo zlog: ma ma ru tra ur nan dzaḥ 'chang ba la rak+ṣa: yig mgo phyir bstan lhag chad spang : lte ba dmar la mu khyud dkar: rtsibs ser mchan sngon mu khyud ljang : drag rdzas byugs la lcags zangs khab: dung mgron pha wang long bu'i phye: lte bar bcug la mdun du bsham: bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal bas: gdon bgegs spyi dang rgyal bsen la: snying rje'i bsam pa dung dung bskyed: tsakra gnod byed gnyis med kyi: khog pa dam tshig yig 'brus gang : gsang sngags dben par mthu bskyed pas: nyon mongs dug lnga'i bag chags bcom: lus sems sdug bsngal mi bskyed par: phan dge'i byang sems bskyed par dmigs: bde gshegs byin dbab gnyis med dang : rtsa ba'i drag sngags sham bu ru: lte ba'i sngags sham btags te bzlas: brgya'am stong las mang mi dgos:

gser skyems mchod c-ing tha tshig bsgrag: bar chad med pa'i phrin las bcol: lte ba ma nyams gru bzhir lteb: sna lngas bcing pa spre'u lpags gtum: mchan 'og drod dang mi 'bral 'chang : rgyal bsen kun gyis 'da' mi nus: de min dus kyi snyigs ma la: rgyal po dam sri nag po 'dis: skye 'gro mtho dman yongs la gnod: gsang sngags nus pa'i bden pa yis: srog 'phrog ar la gtad pa na: brgyal bar 'gyur te brgyal sangs nas: zhe gnag slar yang gnod tshab che: dngos su 'tshe bar ma nus kyang : gzhan gyi blo sgyur nyer dkrugs nas: mi kha gtam ngan phung sbyor rlom: 'di ni sus kyang thul bar dka': de bas stong nyid snying rje btsun: dam bor mna' bgag dbyings rig bsre: de ni srung bzlog kun gyi mchog: rgyal po srog gi gnad 'khor 'di: brgyud 'dzin gcig las mang mi spel: 'chal na rang srog 'gum par bcad: srog tig yang gsang gnyan gyi bcud: rig 'dzin rgyal sras gcig dang sprod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: 7 kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lo 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag dkar nas gdan drangs te slar sbas yul bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du chu glang lor shog ser las dag par zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gson 'dre srung mnan bdud mo mthar byed bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gson 'dre nag po srung mnan bstan: gang phyir bskal pa dus kyi mthar: dam sri nag mo shwa na ma: tsang kun lte phur nag mo yis: 'jig rten dbang byed bod du chug: mo lus thob tshad gson 'drer ldang : de yi gnad bcos srung ba'i thabs: ro ras sam ni dug shog la: 'dre mo nag mo bya mchu ma: yan lag lcags kyis bcings pa'i mi: lto bar mu khyud lnga yi dbus:

hūm̐ mthar drag po'i rtsa sngags rnams: hrī e ka ya ma snying khrag tsakra baṃ: ru lu ru lu sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trig nan: gson 'dre cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo mā ra ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'chang ba la rak+ṣa: de yi phyi rim rtsibs bzhi la: rag+mo trig nan: yag+mo trig nan: 'dre mo trig nan: dam sri mo trig nan: rtsibs mchan rdo rje phyed pa ste: lte ba dbus gcig rgya gram tshul: de yi phyi rim mu khyud la: nag mo ki li ki li nag mo bh+yoḥnā ga hrīḥ nā ga thum thum rbad: 'dre mo dza nan: spe hi ti dza dzaḥ khug sha rbad rbad: 'dre mo rak+ṣa: ma rak+ṣa: ya ril tsa nan: tri hur thum: 'byung po cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo 'di sod sod bdag la rak+ṣa: de yi phyi rol rtsibs drug la: sho na mo dza nan: lte phur nag mo dza nan: tsang kun nag mo dza nan: gson 'dre mo 'di dza nan: dam sri mo 'di dza nan: kun rgyu nag mo dza nan: rtsibs mchan la: ya tri ya ya tri ya: ma tri ya ma tri ya: ma shu tri ya ma shu tri ya: ma zhung tri yā ma zhung tri yā: gnod byed bsen mo'i snying la bram dza dzaḥ rag mo mā ra ya: ching ching : de'i phyi mu khyud tha ma la: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ha la nag po hūm̐ hūm̐: ma tri mā ra ya rbad: ma dung ma dung sod: srog lam tri sod: tsa tri tsa mun tri sod: ma ma dung dung sod: ma tri ling mā ra ti sod: sarba ma ma tri sod: ma rag+mo ma le sod: cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i lus ngag yid gsum ka wa tsi nan nan: tsi du sod sod: ching ching rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: khor yug me dpung ram̐ gyis bskor: gri khrag bud med bsregs pa'i rus: rgya tshos tsan+dan a ga ru: btsan dug gang la dmigs pa'i dri: legs par byugs la gson 'dre dgug: lto bar rgya gram rtsis kyis brgyang : rtsibs rtse dbang po'i phyi ru don: bsregs pa'i tsha ngar me dpung 'bar:

lte ba'i sngags sham dang bcas pa: brgya stong la sogs gang 'dod gdab: rtsibs dang yig 'bru thams cad la: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyang bstim: lteb la yugs sa'i skra yis bcing : dmar nag thum g.yogs bsgrub phyir gdab: gson 'dres nam yang gnod mi srid: sa ma ya: ma rungs dam sri bdud mo dngos: zhes kyang tshub ngad che ba yis: dngos dang dngos med ci yang brdzu: sde brgyad 'byung po kun dang bsdong : yul phyogs kun tu sdang gyur na: dug mda' snying la brdeg cing bsreg: 'dre mo thur la phyin pa'i sa: dri ma drug po gang rnyed dang : phung sa bsregs par gzugs byas la: bden stobs 'gugs gzhug drag tu bya: skyer mda' 'ug pa'i sgro bskyon pa'i: le'u dug sna tsha gsum byugs: mtshar pa'i gzhu byas yak+shar bskyed: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: 'dre mo'i srog rtsa la u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭ: ces bzlas snying khar gsum bdun brdeg: me hom nang bsregs thal ba mnan: des ni rtsa bar chad par 'gyur: 'gag thug min par 'di brtsam na: sdig pa che bas gzhan la gsang : sa ma ya: gzhan gyis dbang med nan 'jum gyis: gnas skabs dag tu gnod byed na: drag po'i rtsa sngags ma gtogs par: srung ba ltar du bris nas kyang : 'gugs gzhug lte ba'i sngags bzlas la: zhag ni bdun tshigs gnyis gsum bsgrub: 'dre mo'i skra gos dum bus dril: sāts+tsha nag po'i nang du bcug: mchod rtain rgya lam zam sngas 'og: gnod tshab che chung bstun la mnan: rang them 'og mnan the tshom med: gson 'dre nag mo rtsa mun tri: ar la gtad pa'i srung mnan cing : 'gro ba thugs rjes skyob pa'i slad: 'byung po 'dul byed rgyud nas bsdus: ma 'ongs nyi shu'i yang mtha' la: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las zhal bshus so//

// ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: ki king sde brgyad kyi spyi chings zor thun gyi gnad 'khor bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rnal 'byor gang zhig yi dam lha'i: bsnyen sgrub drod rtags zhan pa yis: dregs pa las la bskul ba dang : bzlog zor 'phang dang ser srung dus: ki king sde brgyad spyi chings bstan: smug nag dar ram gro shog la: rin chen sna lnga'i snag tsha yis: gza' bdud mgo dgu sbrul mjug can: lto bar mu khyud ling tshe brgyad: dbus su ra yig khong seng hūm̐: phyogs bzhir a ya ma du dang : mtshams bzhir ru sha tsa na bris: mu khyud sde brgyad spyi srog sngags: oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la a rak+mo dhe wa ging ka ra ya ma shu la tri yak+sha nā ga du pra ma sarba tsit+ta hṛ da ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya thun thun swā hā: mgo brtsegs gsum steng mu khyud gsum: rigs gsum zhi drag sngags rnams bris: phyi la drag po'i rtsa sngags dang : go cha sngags bcas 'khor bar bris: de'i phyir rdo rwa me rir sarba pañca a mṛ ta yis byugs: stegs bu 'bru tshom gtsang mar bkram: dbus su thog rdel sbrul lpags bris: shar du shel rdo dar dkar dril: lho ru khro chu ro ras dril: nub tu byi ru dar dmar dril: byang du lcags rdo dar nag dril: shar lho dung chung za 'og dril: lho nub byang zangs bya dmar sogs: nub byang gser thigs dar smug dril: byang shar mu tig dar sngon dril: dal la drang srong yig 'brus mtshan: bdag nyid drag po'i bskyed rim gyis: tsakra dbang drag me phreng gi: lto ba chos dbyings yangs pa'i khyon: khrag mtsho me dpung klong dkyil du: gza' rgod lto ba bla rdo rnams: sde brgyad dregs pa so sor gsal:

a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ dza swā hā: drag po'i sngags gsham btags te bzlas: dregs pa sde brgyad gnas nas 'gugs: gza' rgod lto zhal rdo rjes gtams: rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan pas dgab: lte ba ma nyams gru bzhir lteb: byin rlabs nus ldan sngags pa'i skra: dar sna lngas bcings skyes pa stag: bud med glang lo'i thod pa yi: gwa'u kha sbyor nang du gzhug: hūm̐ mgo thod pa'i dpral bar bstan: sna lnga'i rgya gram hūm̐ gis gdab: gri lpags stag gzig pags pas g.yogs: zor tshe rang lus snying khar gdag: ser ba srung yang de dang mtshungs: rgyun du sgrub khang steng du btsug: mchod gsol phrin las gang brtsam dang : khyad par dgra la mthu byed na: rigs gsum mgon po'i mu khyud dor: gza' bdud lto zhal mi dgab par: liṅga ming yig gang rung ba: sde brgyad gtad khram dmod pa gzhug: zhal bstab dmod pa bgyis tsam gyis: dgra bo ma lus rtsad nas brlag: 'di ni gnyan pas shin tu gsang : dgra zas 'khon zas 'dum mi za: gza' rgod gnod pa'i ngo mi ldog: khyi dang zhum bu bud med dang : dam med rnams kyis mthong mi rung : 'di nyid khyim du bzhugs tsam gyis: sde brgyad 'khu ldog 'tshe mi nus: zor bzlog dregs pa rang gnas kyi: ki king dpal chen bstod la mnan: mi shigs gsang sngags go cha zab: dus mthar sngags pa nus med kyis: gzhan gyi gnyer gdams bzlog bsad skabs: 'di med rang srog mi sgor bskyal: de bas 'di la nan tan bya: gnad kyi snying dril man ngag 'di: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing*/ chu glang lor shog ser las dag par phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ bla ma pad+ma khrag 'thung las: phrin las lnga sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so:

rje btsun thod phreng rigs 'dus lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang zab mo gsang ba ye shes kyi rgyud nas legs par 'byung ba'i bla ma phrin las lnga ltar sgrub pa la sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs yul theg pa rin po che nyer len bgyid pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor spros bcas dang spros med go rim ci ltar 'dug kyang dgos pa'i cha lag khrigs bsdebs su brgyud rim brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'bad pa ni: thog mar rnam snang chos dang ldan zhing phan sems bla med dam pa'i dge bas rab tu bskul zhing dam bca'i gzer gsum 'chug med du gnas pa'i ngang la 'di ltar gdab pa'o: na mo: mdun gyi nam mkhar chos dbyings skye med ngang: ma bcos stong nyid e yi 'phro 'du las: rang byung lhun grub 'od kyi gzhal yas khang : phyi nang gzhal 'das bkod pa rab rgyas pa'i: 'ja' tshon dpung bzhin khyon kyang yangs pa'i dbus: dri med gdod ma'i mtsho dkyil pad sdong rtser: chags med skyon bral 'od skur sprul pa'i lha: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan dri med gzi 'bar ba: mtshan dpe'i sku la rgyan kun rab rdzogs pa'i: phyag mtshan la sogs cha shas ma nyams par: dpa' la rab tu bzhad cing bzhugs pa yi: 'khor yug rab tu bskor ba'i skyabs yul lha: skar 'tshogs grangs bzhin chu zla'i snang ngor ltar: ma 'dres gsal bzhin gsol ba 'di ltar du: sku gsum bla ma bsgrub par dam bca'o: e ma hoḥ ka dag bde ba chen po'i klong yangs nas: chos sku 'od mi 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma 'gags ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs: cir snang sgyu ma rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: sprul sku o rgyan rje la gsol ba 'debs: skye 'chi 'khrul 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs:

zab lam bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang nas: dbyings phyug man+da ra bar gsol ba 'debs: snyan brgyud klong du grol bar byin gyis rlobs: shes rab ye shes mchog gi pho brang nas: mtsho rgyal rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs: brda bzhi mngon du grol bar byin gyis rlobs: sku gsum don ston brgyud pa'i pho brang nas: 'phags mchog rigs gsum mgon por gsol ba 'debs: tshig don rgyud la 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen dbang drag 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: dmar nag me phreng sku la gsol ba 'debs: bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad 'dul bar byin gyis rlobs: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: drag po rigs bzhi'i lha la gsol ba 'debs: las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul pa rnam bzhi 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: phrin las der ston lha la gsol ba 'debs: dus min 'chi ba 'joms par byin gyis rlobs: gzhan yang pho brang gnas yul ma lus nas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la gsol ba 'debs: mchog thun 'bras bu 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: rje btsun chen po o rgyan rin po che: zol med bdag gis re ltos nyid las med: sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dam pas thugs rjes zungs: byin gyis rlobs shig gsol ba snying nas 'debs: sku yi dbang bskur bskyed rim lha yi sku: sprul sku'i 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs: gsung gi dbang bskur zung 'jug sngags kyi sgra: longs sku'i rang rtsal rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: thugs kyi dbang bskur rdzogs rim ka nas dag: chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen ye shes dbang drag 'dus pa'i lha: 'di nas brtsams te zag med rdo rje'i sku: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor bsgrub par dam bca' nas: mi 'da' mi 'gyur bla med ye grol ngang : rang dbyings a ti'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dz+nyā na pad+ma dhā ra sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ

zhes gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'od zer sku dang lug gu rgyud kyi rnam pas za 'og snal ma brgyud cing mthud pa lta bur 'ub kyis bsdus nas rang la thim pas rang lus ye shes chen po'i skur grol nas: lhan skyes kyi dga' ba nyams su myong zhing : bde gsal mi rtog pa'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur te: rang bzhin lhun grub rol pa'i ting 'dzin la gnas pa'i ngang la ci 'tshams su bzhag go: zhes pas gnad ni sku gsum bla ma'i rol rtsed: nyams len rgyun gyi thig le rang dbyings gcig tu rdzogs pa'i man ngag bla ma rtsa gsum gyi sngon 'gro 'khyer bde la rab tu nges so: sa ma ya: rab dbyings khyon las dpag dpar dka' ba'i dpyid: 'jo ldan ku mi ta yi phreng bas spel: gzi 'bar brgyud pa'i lam bzang 'dren mchog bzhag: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༁ྂ: bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: 'chi med tshe yi zab don gnad kyi sgron me bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma'i thugs sgrub kyi: yang snying 'chi med bcud dril ba: zab don gnad kyi sgron me bstan: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes: dang po bkra shis dben pa'i sar: dkyil 'khor go rim ci bzhin pas: sgo rdzogs 'dab bzhi lha mtshan can: bri'am yang na 'bru tshom bkod: de dbus bum pa sman bcud gtams: steng du mtshan ldan dum gcig nang : 'chi med bdud rtsi'i ril bus bkang : de la ka ra bu ram sbrang : bal dkar se ba'i me tog dang : gser mdog bar skyur kham bu'i 'bru: rtag ngu dkar dmar ser po dang : dbyar rtsa rgun 'bu nye shing dang :

ra shag lca ba ba spru ba: gze ma pi ling dbang lag sga: ga pur gur gum dzā ti dang : li shi sug smel ka ko la: cu gang tsan dan dkar dmar dang : cong zhi brag zhun so ma ra: gser dngul zangs thal a ba rtsa: skyes pa rigs bzang nyer lnga man: kun dha bcu drug mtshan ldan khrag: 'gro ba'i dbugs sna ci mang dang: byin ldan brag dang gtan 'khyil mtsho: bdud rtsi mya ngan med pa'i shing : byang sems tshe ring dgu yi skra: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs: rang rang 'byung ba'i 'phrod dang sbyar: zhib btags a rag bzang po'i sbrus: ril bu sum brgya drug cu ni: sran phos tsam dril dar snas btum: brgyad cu'i lo lon lag brgyud nas: thod par bzhag la me long bkab: shel rdo bzhag la gzung thag drang : sman rag gtor mchod ci 'byor bkod: zur bzhi'i mdun du mda' dar gzug: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub las gsum las: drag po'i gzhung bsrang sngon 'gro'i mtshams nas bzung : 'dzab bzlas bya zhing mdun bskyed tshe yi dal: bdag thugs gsang bdag thugs mchog nyi zla'i klong: dwangs ma lnga ldan 'od kyi rdo rje ni: rtse lnga hrīḥs mtshan hrīḥyi 'od zer dang : gnyis med tha mar snying po g.yas su 'khor: tshe bdag thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor dang : hrīḥyig sngags phreng mthing gsal sgra bcas 'khor: bdag mdun gsal brtan gyur nas spro bsdu bya: drag po'i thugs srog las 'phros 'od zer gyis: 'chi med rgyud bskul sngags phreng sgra bcas 'khor: bde stong nyams 'bar 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: mgyogs ma 'bum sde bskul zhing stong gsum khyab: bde gshegs byin rlabs tshe la dbang ba'i mthus: lha klu mi dang 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud bcas: ye shes lnga ldan 'od mdangs 'tsher ba bsdus: baiḍūr sngon po ri rab khong seng nas: nyi zla bye ba'i 'od 'bar ltar mi bzod: khyed shes gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab pas:

tshe bcud dwangs ma ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun: lnga ldan bar ma chad pa bdag nyid kyi: thugs srog la thim bla tshe rang bzhin khug: srog tshe nyams pa gsos la bkrag mdangs gsal: lus kyi nang khengs snang srid 'od phung gtibs: ba spu'i bu gar rdo rje me ris gtams: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub par dmigs: tshe bsnyen bye ba'am ni bdun 'bum bzlas: gnyis pa sgrub par 'phro 'du gong ltar la: tshe lha yab yum sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas lhan cig phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams: tshe lha'i ngo bo dbyings kyis gar khyab 'khrigs: kun gyi mkha' nas ye shes bde rgyun babs: nyi zla'i zer 'phro ro bcud phun tshogs pas: 'chi bdag bdud gzhom mi shigs rdo rje'i tshe: skad cig nus ldan rdzas mchog bla med gyur: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'bum phrag gsum mam gcig tu bzlas: thun mtshams gong ltar tshe dbang blang : gsum pa las sbyor 'khor 'das mnyam rdzogs nas: bdag mdun thugs srog 'od kyis snod bcud khyab: 'jig rten thams cad dag pa'i gzhal yas klong: bcud kyi sems can thams cad tshe dbang rgyas: nam mkhas gar khyab 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud 'bar: nyon mongs gnas dag ye shes snying po'i bcud: bdag mdun 'od kyis khab len lcags phye bzhin: 'ub 'ub bsdus te gnyis med gzi byin bskyed: 'chi med 'od sku 'grub pa'i nges shes bskyed: mdun gyi dam rdzas lha dang dbyer med pa: ye shes 'od snang gsal 'tsher mi shigs blta: oṃ tshe bh+rūm̐ g.yu bh+rūm̐ g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: khri phrag gcig bzla bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi: 'grub pa'i rtags su ril bu 'phel ba dang : dri bzang 'thul dang 'ja' zug sgra snyan sgrogs: dngos nyams rmi lam zhal mjal tshe lung ston: nyi zla shar dang ri rab rtse la 'dzeg: mkha' la 'phur dang mchod rten bskor ba byed:

gdugs dang rgyal mtshan g.yung drung rdo rje sogs: rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnyed dang khong du mid: rnga rdung dar phyar dung 'bud khri brtsegs dang : mkhar dang mchod rten brtsegs dang go cha gyon: brag rir zla ba shar dang rgyab brten pa: lus las me 'bar me tog sna tshogs 'thu: bdud rtsi 'thung dang khrom 'dus lo tog legs: ston dus 'bru la longs spyod bzang mos ni: bdud rtsi ster dang sāts+tsha mang du mthong : rtse gcig nyams blangs rtags mtshan bsam mi khyab: de tshe dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni: tshe bum dam rdzas dang bcas spyir bor bzhag: 'chi med tshe bcud gsang gnas bar gang zhing : phyi snod dwangs bcud ma lus sku la rdzogs: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: rtsa sngags sham bur btags ste brgya rtsa bzlas: mgrin par bzhag la skye 'gro'i tshe dpal dang : rlung rig shes rgyud rang byung thig ler bsdu: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes bzla snying khar bzhag la bde gshegs kyis: thugs rje byin rlabs nus rtsal sems la thim: 'khor 'das dbyer med stong gsal tshe yi gter: mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i sku mchog thob: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes bzlas tshe ril myong zhing tshe chu 'thung : khro tshogs mgyogs ma 'bum gyis mi shigs rgya: mda' dar rgyas gdab slar yang dal du bkod: mchod bstod gsol btab 'od zhu ril bur bstim: rab gnas rten 'brel shis brjod tshe brten pas: gzungs ring brgya rtsa la sogs thun gsham bzla: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa rjes thob spyod lam ni: tshogs rdzas gzhan gyis mthong mi rung : rang gis spyad cing dben par bsdu: ril bu sum brgya drug cu po: lo gcig bar du tho rangs te: bar ma chod par bsten gyur na: dwangs ma bskyed cing snyigs ma dag: ril bu tshe lha yab yum dmigs: mid tshe tshe bsnyen brgya rtsa bzla: zla gcig bsten pas nad rims thon: gny-is bsten stobs rgyas dbang po gsal:

gsum bsten bkrag mdangs 'od dang ldan: bzhi bsten shes rab rtsa kha bye: lnga bsten gzhon nu'i lus su 'grub: drug bsten rtsal stobs seng glang ltar: bdun gyis lha 'dre mi gsum 'du: brgyad kyis spyan dang mngon shes 'char: dgu yis skye dang tshe rabs dran: bcu yis nyin mtshan snang ba 'dres: bcu gcig dgra gnyen phyogs ris bral: bcu gnyis dbyings rig gcig tu 'dre: 'byung ba bzhi la dbang sgyur nus: ji ltar sdig sgrib tshan che yang: bshags sdom 'bad cing lo gsum du: sgrub cing zos na tshe gcig la: nges par tshe yi dngos grub stsol: sa ma ya: e ma tshe sgrub gdams pa bsam yas kyang : dbyings rig nam mkha'i brda rtags kyis: phyag rgya gsal rdzogs ye shes lus: 'di ni yang dag don gyi nor: chos kun rgyu 'bras rten 'brel phyir: bdag 'dzin a 'thas ma yin par: sa chu me rlung nam mkha' sogs: rang gzugs rnam par bsgoms pas kyang : rang rang rigs kyi yon tan thob: de phyir gdos gzugs mtshan bral ba: nam mkha' 'byung ba kun gyi gzhi: kun 'byung 'gyur med yon tan ldan: thugs rje'i dbyings rig rdo rje'i tshe: pad 'byung ngo bo sgrub pa'i thabs: bskal pa dus kyi snyigs ma la: bdud rigs kha rgyas sdig can rnams: tshe ring chos mdzad sku tshe thung : rkyen 'phrang bar chad sel phyir gdams: mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro'i brda thob la: gsang ba yang rdzong gter du rgya: snod ldan bu mchog ma gtogs par: ma gsang rang gi tshe la gnod: sdig can brtson 'grus can la gsang : las can bu dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i gnas nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ ༁ྂ: bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: dbang ltar sgrub pa'i las byang 'chi med bcud dril bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dben pa'i sa ru da la bzhengs: tshe bum kha rgyan mgul chings can: 'chi med rdzas kyis rab tu bkang : bhan+dha'i nang du tshe gtor bzhag: tshe yi ril bus rab tu bskor: me long sin+dhu ra yis byug: hrī ma ha ri ni sa'i dkyil 'khor bri: phyi nang gzhung bzhin bsham par bya: rang nyid bde bar bag phebs 'khod: ma bcos dran rdzogs ngang nyid las: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las dbang chen nam mkha'i dbyings: rlung me chu las rdo rje'i sa gzhi brjid: rang byung 'byung lnga e yi pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang 'ja' tshon gtibs: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs rin chen tog gis spras: de dbus zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa: lug rgyud zer thag 'ja' tshon rang bzhin can: pad+ma nyi zla thabs shes rdo rje'i khrir: hūm̐ yig sngon po in+d+ra nī la'i mdog: skad cig gnas 'gyur bla ma thod phreng rtsal: 'ja' lus 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin ni: chos dbyings mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mdzes 'dzum zhal ldan ral pa spyi bor bcings: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar dmar cod pan 'phur: snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag gdub se mo do: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas tshe bum bsnams: lha rdzas ga shal rgyan ldan dar dpyangs bskyod: mi shigs rdo rje phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro dmar mo mdangs ldan ma:

phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas bhan+dha bsnams: dbu rgyan ga shal dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: phyed skyil mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: yab yum bde stong zung 'jug 'ja' lus ngang: phyi rol pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i ltai ba ru: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi bdag: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar stabs bsgyur: g.yas pas rang rtags phyag mtshan mda' dar 'dzin: g.yon pas tshe bum pad+ma'i phreng ba thogs: phyi rol tshe 'dzin mgyogs ma sprin ltar gtibs: rang bzhin ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings la shar: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: 'chi med dbang po rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: yab yum tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: lhun grub tshe yi dal du gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje 'jigs bral sra brtan khrir: mi g.yo ngang tshul rgyas pa'i gdan steng du: deng 'dir 'ja' lus tshe yi rgyud bskul phyir: bdag la dgongs shing dgyes phyir brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: sku gsum lhun grub 'ja' lus rdo rje'i bdag: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin lha tshogs la: mi phyed 'dun blo rtse gcig drag po yis: gsang 'dus 'chi med tshe yi lha la bstod: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i phyi mchod rol mo gar: nang mchod sman raka bha l̥ng ri ltar spungs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas kyis mchod: gsang 'dus 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe sogs? āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra nī la'i mdog: ye shes lnga ldan cod pan phyogs bcur bskyod:

rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan sku lnga lhun gyis grub: zhi 'dzum spyan gnyis mkha' dbyings phyogs bcur gzigs: phyag g.yas rdo rje tshe bdud bar chad srung : g.yon pas tshe bum sgrub la 'chi med stsol: rin chen rgyan ldan 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil mi shigs rdo rje'i ngang : gsang ba'i yum mchog zung 'jug bde stong nyid: shes rab rang bzhin dmar gsal mdangs dang ldan: phyag g.yas mda' dar srid gsum tshe bcud sdus: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi 'ja' lus srog 'dzin sgrub: dbu rgyan cod pan rtogs med don dang ldan: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril bde stong zung 'jug ngang : yab yum sku la mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin lha la bstod: hūm̐: phyi rol mgyogs ma tshe yi las byed ma: dkar ser dmar ljang mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar: mda' dar phyag mtshan lha klu'i tshe bcud sdus: g.yon pa'i tshe bum 'chi med bdud rtsis bkang : dar tshon sna tshogs cod pan dbyings la bskyod: 'jo sgeg mdzes sdug mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi la: bde stong dbyings rig ma bcos ngang la bstod: rtse gcig gdung shugs drag pos bstod pa'i mthus: 'ja' lus 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ pad+ma hrī da ya ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes bzlas par bya: 'dzab bskul zhi ba nas blangs: bdun phrag gsum mam gnyis la sgrub: myur zab snying gi le'u'o: de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni: mda' dar dkar po thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: shar phyogs dkar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: de nas mda' dar ser po thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: lho phyogs ser mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog:

mda' dar dmar po thogs la: hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: nub phyogs dmar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: mda' dar ljang gu thogs la: hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: byang phyogs ljang mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi ri rab bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: mda' dar sngon po thogs la: hūm̐: bud+dha rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: dbus phyogs sngon mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes tshe bskyed cing dngos grub sogs drag po nas blang : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: d+yargya/rgyargya/dh+yi/: e ma kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan rjes 'jug don gyi phyir: tshe sgrub dbang gi gdams zab khyad par can: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i snying po'i srog sgrub bzhag: 'di nyid sgrub zh-ing nyams su len pa rnams: tshe tshad phug tu phyin kyang lo gsum bsring : de phyir gdams pa yang zab-i atsha rgya: ma 'ongs lnga brgya nyi shu shar ba'i tshe: pad+ma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gnyan rgya: dam rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag dkar nas gdan drangs shing glang lor sbas yul pad+ma rong gi chos sdings nam mkha' 'brug grags su sangs rgyas lhum zhugs kyi zla tshes la shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: 'chi med tshe sgrub rgyun khyer ye shes snying po bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra tshe bdag pad+ma yi:

bdag don rgyun gyi rnal 'byor las: rig gdangs 'od kyis gang khyab pa'i: snod bcud zhing ku+un dbang drag lha: mi shigs gsang bdag chos dbyings klong : sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya gram steng : ye shes mngon gyur gzhal yas dbus: rig pa'i ngo bo tshe dpag med: mthing gsal 'od kyi phung po can: thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor nang: hrī yig dwangs ma gsal 'tsher 'bar: sngags phreng 'od zer 'khyugs par 'khor: sgom pas byin rlabs rang bzhin 'bar: lta bas tshe bcud gcig tu bsdus: spyod pas bla tshe yal ba 'gugs: gnas pas tshe srog bkrag mdangs gsal: 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje'i sku: rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes tshe: mtha' yas pad+ma'i dgongs klong ngang : oṃ pad+ma hrī dha ya ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam kun: khong pa'i dbugs bzhin tshad med bzla: bza' btung la dmigs tshe lhar bskyed: 'od zhu longs spyod tshe'i dngos grub: de bzhin mig dang rna ba lce: gnas khang gos stan tshe lhar gsal: bskyed pas 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi: rang rang las kyi tshe dbang thob: nyi zla mtsho brag la brten nas: sgrub kyang de yi yon tan ldan: rten 'brel rgyu 'bras shes par mdzod: mdor na a 'thas ma yin par: rig pa'i dran so ma nyams tsam: ye shes rol rtsal cir yang bsgyur: rten 'brel snang ba 'gags med gsal: kun khyab thugs rje shugs la 'char: ye shes mtsho rgyal snying la phul: phyi rabs las 'phro skal ldan ni: mi nub gter du a thaṃ rgya: snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor ti sgro nas gdan drangs pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: khyung sgrub nā ga 'joms byed ces bya ba bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:

khro rgyal phrin las sprul pa'i mchog: khyung nag rigs 'dus bsgrub pa bstan: dben par phyi nang mtshams bcad la: mthing nag gru gsum e dal steng : pho mo'i bhan+dha kha sbyor nang : sman chen bswe zho a ru nag: gla rtsi gu gul shu dag nag: rtsod mdud mu zi dngul chu sbrang : gri sha mi khyi phag brun rnams: zhib 'thag nus ldan dri chus sbrus: ril bu sran ma tsam dril blugs: dar mthing gis dril gtor mchod bshams: bgegs bskrad srung mtshams byin rlabs sogs: gzhung ltar bya zhing lha bskyed pa: hūm̐: badz+ra khrom̐ dzaḥ stong gsal snying po khrom̐ yig mthing nag las: 'od 'phros snang srid gru gsum e yi klong : dug mtsho khro chu khol ma'i klong rum nas: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan: dug gi ri rab bang rim dgu yi steng : khrom̐ las bya khyung rgyal po ga ru ṭaḥ mthing nag khro chu lus po me gshog can: gnam lcags mchu sder dug mig rdo rje'i mchu: mchong gi mche gtsigs dug lce dmar 'od 'khyugs: krang kring sgra sgrogs srid pa'i klu rigs sngangs: me yi ral pa ra bar nor bu'i steng : pad+ma khrag 'thung rdo rje lcags sdig 'dzin: khro rgyal stobs ldan gshog rlabs srid pa sdud: gzir ba'i phyag rgyas gdol pa nag po za: dpung mgo g.yas su khyung dkar rgyal rigs gzir: g.yon du khyung ser rje rigs klu sbrul gtun: brla g.yas khyung dmar bram ze klu rnams rol: brla g.yon khyung ljang dmangs rigs klu rnams 'dren: spu gri'i sgro gshog bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: ba spu'i gseb nas mtshon cha'i char pa 'bebs: snang srid sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul bar bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas: ye shes khyung chen lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: khrom̐ badz+ra ga ru ṭa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i ri rab rtse mo nas:
