khro rgyal 'dus pa'i mthu stobs bdag: gdug pa 'dul mdzad ga ru ṭaḥ thugs rje rol pa'i bya khyung tshogs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: gdug pa 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum e yi dbus: dam ye gnyis med brtan par bzhugs: 'byung po kun 'dul drag rtsal can: ye shes drag po khyod la 'dud: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gdug pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan gdon: gnod byed 'byung po bsgral ba yi: sbal sbrul nya sdig ri ltar spungs: khrag gi rgya mtsho me re re: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can: khro chen khyung gi tshogs la 'bul: mchod bzhes thugs dam bskang gyur cig: khrom̐ badz+ra ga ru ṭa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañca rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min lcang lo can gyi gnas: ri rab 'bar ba'i yang steng nas: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i phrin las bdag: sprul pa'i khyung chen sku la bstod: khro chu'i lus la me gshog sdeb: gnam lcags ra la rdo rje'i mchu: zangs sder 'jums shing dug mig bgrad: khro rgyal khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: ljags ni glog dmar stong du 'khyug: rno gdug mche ba bgegs la gtsigs: lus dkrugs gnam lcags ser rgod 'bebs: klu dang sa bdag bzung zhing za: klu 'dul gser mig 'khyil la bstod: dbu skra dmar nag me zer 'bar: nyi zla nor bus 'od mdangs 'tsher: bde gshegs stobs 'dus me phreng rtsal: snang srid 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: spu gseb bya khyung dmag tshogs 'gyed: ye shes me dpung klong dkyil nas: krang kring sgra sgrogs klu srin 'dren: khrag 'thung rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: gza' dang rgyu skar gnyan gyi gdon: klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen bgegs: ma lus 'joms pa'i lha chen por: dam tshig gnyan pos thugs dam bskul:

da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar: bdud srin 'byung po kha dar bas: bdun drug nad dal yams rims phyur: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i: nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sol: mi shigs rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol: ces bstod dzap bzlas rim pa ni: thugs kar nyi steng khrom̐ yig mthar: sngags phreng 'brug ltar sgra sgrogs 'khor: bde gshegs rab 'byams mthu stobs 'dus: sngags phreng las mched me zer gyis: rtsa khams gang ba'i nad gdon de: ba spu bu ga nas thon te: lus kun khro tshwa khol ma'i mdangs: snang srid sreg pa'i me dpung 'bar: rdzu 'phrul gshog rlabs srid pa sdud: klu gnyan sa bdag ma lus pa: sngangs 'dar snying rtsa yed yed dang : khyad par gnod byed klu gnyan rnams: bdag dang sprul pa'i khyung tshogs kyis: dbyings nas gzir 'debs thal phung du: rngam rngam hrum hrum tsher tsher za: lhag ma med par rdul du brlag: shul kyang khro chu'i zhun du mkhregs: tshur 'dus bdag dang rdzas la bstims: ril bu rnams kyang khyung du gyur: rngam pa'i 'brug stong di ri ri: dbang drag 'bar ba'i stobs rdzogs gyur: oṃ khrom̐ badz+ra ga ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ta na ma sha pa: nā ga sde brgyad srog la gtub ling thum sod ya:

zhes pa sgra zur ma nyams par: grangs kyi bsnyen pa khri tsho gsum: dus bsnyen zhag bdun ngag dam bcad: dus bzhir mchod bstod thugs dam bskul: sbal lcong sdig sbrul bsad dang za: srog chag brdung dang gtub cing gcod: ri brag bshig dang khyu ma bdal: lus la me 'bar nags tshal bsregs: go gyon mtshon thogs rdo rbab 'dril: mtsho skam lus la rnag khrag bshal: srog chags don sogs rtags rnams 'byung : de tshe dbang dang dngos grub blang : hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bdag: khro chen mthing nag bya khyung rgyal: dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: gzi byin drag pos mthu stobs bskyed: sku gsung thugs kyis dbang bskur stsol: lus kyi nad gdon zhi ba dang : rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs: ngag gi zhen 'dzin dag pa dang : drag sngags nus rtsal bskyed du gsol: sems kyi by-ing rmugs nad dag nas: gsal stong ye shes dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags sham bur kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra dhā tu sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang gtor ma btang : ril bu bya khyung khrom tshogs la: bde gshegs stong gis rab tu gnas: dal bsdu bsngo smon la sogs bya: mdze sogs klu nad tshab che na: tho rangs ril bu bdun bdun btang : drag sngags stong tsho re mi bcag: skabs su dri chur gla rtsi sbyar: sngags bzlas yang yang bskul rdeg btung : rgyun du khrus byas grib la 'dzem: phag mkhris thang khrom la sngags la: rdo bsregs dud pa snyug sbubs rngub: de yis stod mdze sel bar 'gyur: mkhal rtsa bol gong me btsa' gdab: rkang khrag phyung bas smad mdze sel: chags pa mi spyod mngar skyur spangs: zla ba gcig nas mdze rgod kyi: tho lum song yang sos par 'gyur: dam tshig bya sgong sha mi za: gzhan dag po yang de dang mtshungs: mdze rigs rkyen sogs byung dogs la: lto sman khog srung ril bu re: rtag tu tho rangs dri chus phul:

gzhan yang gag lhog gnyen thor dang : shu ba la sogs reg pas 'joms: grib dang chams rims kun la bsngags: 'di ltar rdzas sngags sus 'dzin pa: lha srin sde brgyad gnod pa zhi: klu gnyan sa bdag gdon las grol: 'go nad yams rims nad kyang 'joms: mnan gtad ser ba 'bebs srung dang : sa gnyan 'phru slog gnyan kha gsol: yul gsar 'dzin dang gnas gter 'byed: brag bshig shing gcod nad ngan btul: brtul zhugs drag las gang byed kyang : rang lus gnam lcags mkhar dang 'dra: mdze gdon 'byung dogs srung ba la: 'di las zab pa 'jig rten dkon: drag sngags me ri dmar po'i rgyud: snying po'i bcud du dril ba 'di: bskal pa dus kyi snyigs ma la: klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen por bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: dam rgya: rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor bdud 'dul sngags gling du phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: zhi ba ltar sgrub pa'i las byang snying po kun 'dus bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dben zhing yid 'ong bkra shis gnas: dmar smug dbang gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs: bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings can: bum rdzas chu yis sum gnyis bkang : bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang du ni: zhi rgyas dbang drag gtor ma bzhag: phyi nang spyan gzigs gzhung bzhin bsham: rang nyid shar du zhal kha gyu: drag po'i sngon 'gro song nas ni: ma bcos lhun grub ngang nyid du: rang byung dran rdzogs 'di ltar bsgom: ka) hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐: keṃ las bh+rūm̐ gyur rang byung pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang mtshan nyid ldan: 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i zer 'khrigs ye shes klong :

rin chen rgyan rdzogs mdzes pa'i pho brang dbus: pad+ma nyi zla sna tshogs khri steng du: gser gyi rdo rje hūm̐ dmar tshwa tshwa can: dran rdzogs rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: dkar gsal mdangs ldan shel gong dwangs ma'i dbyibs: he ru ka pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje gdeng stabs mkha' la phyar: g.yon pa'i thod pa bdud rtsi lnga yis bkang : dbu skra thor tshugs thod phreng rigs lngas brgyan: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan rlung gis bskyod: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs: gsang ba dbang phyug dmar mo rus rgyan can: rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: mnyen lcug brda 'byin zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: yab yum zung 'jug thugs kar ā dang ma: sngags phreng 'khor zhing bde chen ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: phyi rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing 'od gri thod 'dzin: rin chen mkha' 'gro ser gsal gri thod 'dzin: pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin: las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang smug gri thod 'dzin: thams cad 'jo sgeg mnyen lcug 'khril ldem ma: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan sna tshogs cod pan 'phur: gcer mo bha ga nu ma rab tu rgyas: dbu skra thor tshugs lcang lo sil bur 'phyangs: gar stabs tshul gyis pad zla'i gdan la 'gying : thugs kar ha ri ni sa lam gyis gsal: de ltar sngags phreng 'khor zhing gzi 'bar bsgom: gzhan yang phyi nang mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: thod phreng mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas rnams: bar snang sa gzhi til gang kha phyes ltar: dri bzang 'ja' gur 'thib cing spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rnga yab gling mchog dpal ri'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin thod phreng yab yum gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi sna tshogs 'od lnga'i pho brang nas: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol:

gnas nas gshegs shing byin gyis rlob pa'i tshe: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan pu ru ru: gzi brjid bkrag mdangs mtshan dpe ya la la: snyan dbyangs drug cu g.yer kha si li li: nyi zla'i zer 'phro bkrag mdangs ta la la: brda bsgyur gar rtsed rol mo di ri ri: dri zhim spos ngad phyogs bcur chi li li: byin rlabs dpal 'bar thugs rje sha ra ra: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: skal ldan bdag la nyams rtogs ting 'dzin bskyed: dur khrod dkyil 'khor rdzas la bcud chen phob: phyi yi snang ba snod bcud dbang du sdud: nang gi rtsa rlung thig le bkrag mdangs bskyed: gsang ba'i nyon mongs dug lnga dbyings su spor: phyi nang rten 'brel 'phel zhing bskyed du gsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ dzaḥham̐'u baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: sna tshogs 'ja' tshon 'khyil ba'i dbus nyid du: rig 'dzin yab yum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams: byams gdung bdag la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: phod ka sngags chas brgyan c-ing phyi phyag 'tshal: gnas lugs bskyed rdzogs dran pas nang phyag 'tshal: gar mo ging mo sgeg mos gsang phyag 'tshal: rnal 'byor bdag gi gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: yid 'phrog lha mo gsang ba'i gzugs mdzes ma: brda gar bsgyur zhing bde ba'i skad 'byin ma: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin bde ba'i zungs bskul ma: thod phreng gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she gīrti nīrti lā s+ye mā l+ye swa ra swa tī mu ḍa s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐:

de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha'i snod du bdud rtsi chi li li: dung dmar zhal bur rak+ta rba rlabs 'phyo: dam rdzas rmad byung gtor ma ri ltar spungs: thod phreng gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rdo rje nyid: shes rab dbyings phyug gsang ba'i bha ga ru: srub cing bskul ba'i bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag klad rus 'bul: oṃ badz+ra pad+ma ti ri a haṃ a mṛ ta pañca ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag skye med ngang nyid las: sku mdog dkar gsal 'od stong ldan pa ni: bde chen sku la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: dbu skra thor tshugs gyen du bsgrengs pa ni: ye shes zang thal dbyings rig rdzogs pa'i brda: thod skam rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa ni: nyon mongs dug lnga ka nas dag pa'i brda: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba ni: ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub rdzogs pa'i brda: thugs rje'i spyan gyis phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni: 'od gsal ngang la 'khor 'das bral ba'i brda: zhal 'dzum dkar la dgyes shing snum pa ni: pad 'byung thugs rje phyogs ris bral ba'i brda: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdeng ba ni: sku lnga lhun grub 'gro don mdzad pa'i brda: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi bsnams pa ni: sgrub la 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol ba'i brda: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba ni: rtag chad mthar phyin pha rol phyin drug brda: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang phyed skyil bzhugs pa ni: skye 'chi bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i brda: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni: 'khor ba ma spangs skyon gyis ma gos brda: gsang ba dbyings phyug sku la 'khril ba ni: bde stong zung 'jug skye med rdzogs pa'i brda:

sku mdog dmar mo mdzes chags gzigs pa ni: shes rab gzugs la dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i brda: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams pa ni: chos rnams thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i brda: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba ni: rtsa rlung thig le bde drod bskyed pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril ba ni: 'khor 'das ro gcig chos skur mtshon pa'i brda: yab yum sku la gzi brjid ldan pa ni: snang srid dbang sdud chos skur grol ba'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs bla ma rje la bstod: hūm̐: phyi rim ye shes gsang ba'i ḍāk+ki ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing 'od ldan pa ni: gnas lugs gshis la mtha' dbus bral ba'i brda: rin chen mkha' 'gro ser gsal mdzes pa ni: ma 'gags rtsal ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i brda: pad+ma mkha' 'gro zil chags mdangs ldan ni: shar grol rtogs pa rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i brda: las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang smug g.yo ba ni: ye shes rlung gis 'khor 'das dbye ba'i brda: thams cad rigs lnga cod pan 'phur ba ni: dug lnga ma spangs ye shes spyod pa'i brda: thor tshugs lcang los sku rgyab g.yo ba ni: rang byung rang shar rtsal snang rdzogs pa'i brda: khro 'dzum mdzes la zim bur gzigs pa ni: thugs rje chags pas sems can 'dren pa'i brda: g.yas pa thams cad gri gug phyar ba ni: ma dag 'khrul rgyun rtsad nas gcod pa'i brda: g.yon pa'i dung dmar rak+tas bkang ba ni: ro gcig rtogs pas sa gsum gnon pa'i brda: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la mdzes pa ni: tshogs drug ma spangs rang sar grol ba'i brda: gcer mo bha ga nu ma rgyas pa ni: dam tshig can gyi grogs mo bgyis pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar gyis bzhugs pa ni: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong ba'i brda: pad zla'i gdan la 'gying stabs ldan pa ni: skye 'gag gnyis med lhun gyis grub pa'i brda: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor tshogs la bstod:

gsang ba mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i tshogs la bstod: phyag 'tshal bstod cing rtse gcig gdung ba'i mod: byin rlabs 'bad med thugs rjes char bzhin phob: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par mdzad du gsol: oṃ gu ru pad+ma kā ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes sngags ci nus bzlas: de nas 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: yang gsang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: skye med dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: 'gags med rang byung snying pos bskul: thugs kar āḥyig tha ma ru: sngags phreng 'od zer lta bu 'khor: lus khengs phyi nang zang thal klong : spros pas rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas bde stong bla na med: gnas pas ma bsgoms lhun gyis grub: gsal ba'i snod bcud dkyil 'khor lha: lta ba rang rig pad+ma 'byung : sgom pa lhun grub mkhyen brtse'i ngang : spyod pas ma sring dbang du sdus: 'bras bu ma 'grub bar du bsgrub: srog la babs kyang mi btang ngo : bsnyen pa ni: oṃ gu ru pad+ma kā ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ deng sangs skya rengs dang po shar: rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: lus kun bde bas ltem gyis gang : rten 'brel sngags bzlas mtha' ru phyin: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: 'dzab kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ces nad gdon zhi ba la: oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bsod nams rgyas pa la: oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: thams cad dbang du sdud pa la: oṃ wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa la: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces sham bu sbyar: 'grub rtags ma byung bar du sgrub: bdun gsum lha zhal nges par mjal: grol nas dbang bzhi legs par blangs: 'di nyid drag po'i bdag bskyed bya: yang na so sor bsgrub kyang chog: kha skong drag po dag nas blangs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:

gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i rgyud lung bzhin: skal ldan 'di phyi'i don gnyer na: nga nyid he ru ka lta bu: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrub brtson: 'di nyid bsgrub cing nyams len na: phyi nang bar chad dag kyang zhi: rnam g.yeng 'khrul pa'i bdud las rgyal: rtsa rlung snang ba dbang du 'dus: rten 'brel phyogs med nyid kyang 'char: dug lnga rtsol med rang sar zhi: 'ja' lus chos sku mngon du 'gyur: 'di ltar gdams pa bzhi skor rgyud: gsang ba mkha' 'gros bskul phyir bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gnyer rgya: dam rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag dkar nas gdan drangs shing glang lor sbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi lha sdings nam mkha' 'brug grags su sangs rgyas lhums zhugs kyi tshes la shog ser nas bsgyur ro/ yi ge pa yang 'bri gung pa bdud 'dul rtsal gyis bgyis so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi las byang bzhugs so:

drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gsang sgrub zab mo rdo rje me 'bar bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: drag po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dur khrod dam mam rang byung phug: shing gcig drung ngam dben pa'i gnas: bkra shis rgyud dang mthun pa'i yul: dmar smug sa la stegs bu bya: dkyil 'khor las rim gzhung bzhin gdab: yang na ras bris 'bru tshom steng : dbus su bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang : drag po'i sman rdzas rnams kyang blugs: dar dmar kha bcad dar nag gdugs: bum pa cha tshang tsa ka li: sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang mchod: spyan gzigs la sogs tshang bar bshams: rang nyid drag po'i ting 'dzin ngang : dang po dkar gtor spyi mthun bsngo: de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyangs bya: gsum pa rdzas mchod byin gyis brlab: 'byung ba rim brtsegs lha bskyed bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po skyabs 'gro ni: na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed ni: hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: de nas bgegs 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yi: 'gugs pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed: sgrub la mi dbang log 'dren bgegs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir mchis: oṃ badz+ra ṭak+ki rā dza ya: gnod byed 'byung po dza dzaḥ bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: 'byung po bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma khyer la rang gnas dengs: 'tshe na drag sngags me char 'bebs: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐:

gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad bh+yoḥ thums shig gtor myog rbad raṃ dz+wa la ya phaṭḥ de nas srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ me ri'i gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rak+ṣa: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsakra rak+ṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rak+ṣa: tri shū la tsakra rak+ṣa: ram̐ dz+wa la tsakra rak+ṣa: e swa bhā tsakra rak+ṣa: zhes srung 'khor drag po bsgom: mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dz+nyā na pañca pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs: sman raka phyar zhing dkrug: de nas bum pa dang sman rdzas rnams la: hūm̐: bum pa gzhal yas bdud rtsi lha: bhan+dha'i snod du rdzas sman gtams: phyi nang spyan gzigs sna tshogs rnams: bskyed spel mtshan ldan rab tu sbyangs: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dhe wa bhai ṣa dz+yai ye bhi shwa oṃ āḥhūm̐: byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki chos skyong rnams: mi mngon dag pa mkha' spyod klong nas bzhengs: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: dbang bzhi mchog thun stsol bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki dz+nyā na sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ brda sgo brda phyag dam bca' ni: hūm̐: ma rig blang dor 'thib sgo bcad: rang rig lha zhal 'char sgo phyes: brda phyag 'tshal zhing mchod bshags bstod: ma 'grub bar du srog ltar bzung :

oṃ bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing brdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rol rtsal rdzogs: oṃ kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: de nas 'byung rim brtsegs shing gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa ni: kha) hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ rgya gram: ram̐ las me ri kham̐ rak+ta: sum̐ las sa gzhi keṃ ri rab: bh+rūm̐ las rang byung bhan+dha'i mkhar: rmang gzhi rdo rje rgya gram nag: gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna lnga'i rtsig: lha klu sde brgyad gza' rgyu skar: ka gdung gral lcam thog steng phub: dmar nag 'dod snam pha gu ser: drwa ba rus rgyan thod tshal 'phyangs: rlung gis sham bu lda ldi bskyod: mda' yab bhan+dha skam rlon spel: g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan tsit+ta'i tog: rta babs bya khyung seng 'brug ngar: chos 'khor hūm̐ sgra tog gis mdzes: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa mtshon: me ri khyung dang lcags sdig gur: srid pa'i rlung yang mi thar bsgom: nang du dmar nag rak+ta'i mtshor: mi rta bam ro'i lhu dum 'khril: dur khrod rgyan 'phyang du ma bres: dbus su zla gam dmar smug klong : chos 'byung mthing nag bam gyi steng : gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra can: me ri tshwa tshwa si li li: dran rdzogs pad+ma he ru kaḥ khro rgyal drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar 'khrugs: khro gtum spyan rtsa glog ltar 'gyu: dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga rdzogs: g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje me: g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal chas brgyan: zhabs bzhi khro bo rol pa'i stabs: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog brdzis: gsang ba khro mo gri thod mthing : 'khyud cing yab yum me dpung klong : lha srin sde brgyad 'dul bar bskyed:

nga) hūm̐: phyi rol gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad steng : shar du sgrol ging mthing nag rngam: g.yas gsum spu gri chu gri me: g.yon gsum thod phreng snying dang sdig: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs: me yi bya khyung dmar nag zhon: hūm̐: lho ru gtum ging sngo nag khro: g.yas gsum tsit+ta me chu gri: g.yon gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ lcags sdig me: dur khrod dpal chas rab tu rdzogs: 'joms byed bya khyung kham nag zhon: hūm̐: nub tu khro ging dmar nag gtum: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug thod: g.yon gsum 'khor lo spu gri sdig: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal dang ldan: srog gzan bya khyung ser nag zhon: hūm̐: byang du las ging ljang nag rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum tri shūl lcags sdig khyung : dur khrod chas ldan khro la brjid: gtor byed bya khyung ljang nag zhon: hūm̐: yum chen ging gi khro mo bzhi: rang mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis: gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: kun kyang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: 'jigs byed bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga rdzogs: thams cad gtso bo'i chas dang mthun: hūm̐: mtshams bzhir yab yum sprul pa'i khyung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing la rngam: bswe mig zangs rwa lcags kyi mchu: me gshog rlabs kyis dpag tshad g.yo: dam sri 'dre rgod gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi sgo yi las byed ma: shar du ma mo sdig pa'i gdong : lho ru ma mo chu srin gdong : nub tu ma mo phag gdong ma: byang du ma mo khyung gdong ma: bzhi ka gcer bu mi bzad pa: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na gri gug bhan dmar dkrugs: thams cad lcags sdig mgo dgu zhon: dus 'khrug lo nyes mu ge dang : nad rims dal yams 'joms par gsal: hūm̐: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: khyung dang lcags sdig phag rgod 'gyed: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha:

gsal snang chu zla'i klong ltar bsgom: cha) de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas khrag 'thung khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs par gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: gri sha'am sha chen gang rung gis gsur btang zhing rol mo drag tu bya: hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum dang : las kyi ma mo sprul khyung rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren myur du byon: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ nya) bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dre rgod dang : 'byung po sa bdag klu yi khrir: gdug pa 'dul ba'i rngam stabs kyis: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: mi bzad skur ston khrag 'thung pa: 'jigs byed bla ma drag po yi: phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: brkyang bskum gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta king ni ri ti kha kha khā hi: bdud rtsi lag mchod byed na skabs 'dir sbyar/ de nas bstod pa ni: tha) hūm̐: bla ma drag po he ru kaḥ stobs 'dus pad+ma khrag 'thung rgyal: sku mdog dmar nag srid gsum 'dul: zhal gsum khro zhing pho rgyud sngangs: spyan dgu sdang mig mo rgyud sdud: snyan nas 'brug sgra stong khams g.yo: shangs nas rlung dmar 'byung po gtor: khro bcu'i mche gtsigs dgra sha za: ljags dmar 'dre rgod snying khrag rngub: khyung gi dbu rgyan snang srid 'dul: sbrul bcings ral bsigs srid rtse 'gul:

phyag drug mtshon cha dgra la 'debs: sgro gshog bar snang me 'od 'khrugs: dur khrod chas brgyad dregs pa 'dul: dpal chas ma tshogs dbang du sdud: zhabs bzhi dor thabs stong gsum gnon: srid pa'i khyung brdzis rgyal 'gong bsgral: yum chen gsang ba khro mo mthing : zhal gdangs khro gtum ma rungs brgyal: gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: bhan dmar 'byung po'i klad khrag rol: dur khrod chas ldan phar phyin rdzogs: yab 'khril sprul pa'i khro tshogs bskul: yab yum bskal pa'i me ri'i dbus: bzhugs shing tshwa tshwas stong khams khyab: dus ngan 'byung po 'dul byed pa: 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku: snang srid 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: na) hūm̐: khro chen mi bzad 'jigs pa'i ging : las kyi dpa' bo chen po bzhi: zhal gsum gdangs shing rgyal 'gong 'dul: spyan dgu bgrad pas klu gnyan sngangs: dbu rgyan bya khyung sa bdag 'joms: sgro gshog nad rims dal yams gzhom: g.yas gsum mtshon char dgra la 'bebs: g.yon gsum mtshon gyis dam sri bkums: dpal chas dus 'khrug 'dre rgod 'dul: zhabs bzhis khyung brdzis klu srin 'joms: rang mdog khro mo rigs bzhi rngam: gri thod 'dzin cing dug lnga gzhom: yab 'khril rang 'dra'i khro chung 'gyed: sku las me lce ya la la: yab yum ging chen tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ bswe mig tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: zangs rwa dmar po rngam la rno: me gshog stong khams 'u ru ru: lcags sder klu 'dzin khyugs se khyug: gnam lcags rkan dgra thags se thag: dam sri 'byung po'i snying khrag 'thung : sprul pa'i bya khyung bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: sdig pa chu srin phag dang khyung : gdong can sha za khro mo bzhi: zangs kyi gri gug lhabs se lhab: rak+ta'i khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: gcer mo skra dmar sa la gzhol: lcags sdig 'dur ldang khyugs se khyug: me char tshwa tshwa spungs se spung :

sprul pa'i bya khyung phag dang sdig: 'byung po'i srog len myu ru ru: dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsang ba'i lhar: sgo gsum 'dun pas rab tu bstod: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar: nad mtshon 'byung po 'dre rgod dang : dam sri rgyal 'gong kha dar bas: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: phyi yi dgra 'dre 'byung po thul: nang gi dug lnga'i bar chad sol: gsang ba'i skag rkyen dgra la phob: nad mtshon dal yams rtsad nas chod: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid che mchog pad+ma drag po gsal ba'i thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten gyi dbus bum pa'i gzhal yas su pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' phyag rdor mthing nag /rdo rje sdigs mdzub can/ de yi thugs kar dmar ser thig le'i steng du ting 'dzin sems dpa' snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar rtsa ba'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor bar dmigs la sngags bzla bar bya'o/ slar yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba sras bcas mchod byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus gzi brjid lhag par rgyas shing ma dag pa'i khams rnams su cig car du khyab/ khams gsum gyi dregs byed ma lus dbang du bsdus shing log rtog rnams zil gyis mnan/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad/ 'gro ba'i las sgrib mtha' dag bcom nas yi dam lha yi go 'phang la bkod/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rol par sad par bsams la bzlas pa bya'o/ yang lha tshogs thams cad kyis zhal dang sngags las kyang rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba'am gnam lcags kyi thog rgod drag tu lhung ba ltar srid gsum thams cad yom yom shig shig tu 'gul zhing ldeg pa dang*/ 'od zer dmar nag 'bar zhing rab tu 'khrugs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig tu gnas par byas la bzla bar bya'o/

zhes pa'ang gnam lcags gu h+ya'i ming gis 'phral mkho la dmigs te bris pa'o// // pa) dang po rtsa sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: ging bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra tsakra kro ta tsaṇ+ḍa ghṛ wa tsa tur kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ khyung lnga yi sngags ni: oṃ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa pañca hūm̐ phaṭ: khro mo sha za bzhi la: oṃ ma mo mu khā le kro ti tsa tur baṃ ru lu ru lu bh+yoḥ phag sdig khyung la: oṃ wā ra hī pa paṃ khroṃ ṭa ya bh+yoḥ zhes rtsa sngags las sngags sham bu sngags rgod ni: nyi ma bdun phrag rim bzhin bzlas: rgyal bsen ar gtad sham bu ni: oṃ she la du ging rā dza nan tsit+ta thum bh+yoḥ srin mo la: oṃ rak+sha kā li ya ma nan: tsit+ta shag 'gas hu lu bh+yo bh+yoḥ 'dre rgod 'byung po la: oṃ a mu ka bhū ta mā ra ya dzi ni rbad bh+yoḥ dam sri la: oṃ ya ma ye ru ṭa mā ra ya nan bh+yoḥ gdon spyi la: oṃ trag thur shag rbad dun+tsa mā ra ya a mu ka tri sha rbad bh+yoḥ trag thum: zhes bzlas 'go nad srung na nad 'joms par bu'i sngags bzla zhing sgrub pa 'dis byas kyang rung : yang sngags so sor kha bsgyur sham bu gang dgos bya: gzhung la rtsa sngags dang las sngags sgrub pas chog: sngags so so'i bzlas pa bya zhing rdzas kyi ril bus srung ba byas na thub nges so: dmigs pa gang 'os sngags dang bstun: skabs su rang bzhin 'ub kyis bdag la bsdu ba mi dmigs gsal stong ka dag ngang la bsgom: spyi 'gror:

rang nyid khro rgyal pad+ma khrag 'thung gi thugs ka nas: me yi bya khyung dug gi phag rgod lcags kyi sdig pa rdo rje'i ser ba rnams snod bcud khengs par 'phros pas rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po gnod byed ma rungs pa klu dang sa bdag rnams gzhob kyis bsregs hab hab ljib ljib tu zos nas lhag ma med par bsams: tshur 'dus pas srung ba'i gur du gyur nas bskal pa'i rlung yang bgrod mi nus par bsgom: de ltar rang nyid thun mtshams rdzogs par bsgrub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran zhing : hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rang byung snying po'i 'od zer gyis: rgyu 'byung yi ge sbyong byed 'phros: gtsang btsog bzang ngan ka nas dag: oṃ dharma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ shud+dhe hoḥ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro bo'i thugs ka nas: byin rlob yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: tshogs rdzas nam mkha' mdzod du gyur: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ de nas tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rje btsun thod phreng yab yum la: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: drag po khrag 'thung yab yum la: ging dang khro mo sha zas bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig pho brang nas: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs thibs se thib: khro bo'i lha tshogs ya la la: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang la: gshegs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mos pa'i skal ldan smin par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: deng 'dir mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha khā hi: bar pa bskang ba ni: hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs sna tshogs mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma thod phreng yab yum dang : drag po'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bshags pa ni: hūm̐: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'khrul gzugs bdag: grangs med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib tshogs: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: tha ma bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed 'byung po glags lta'i rigs: myur du tha ma'i ling gar khug: pho nyas bzung zhing byad du chugs: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya ru tra mā ra ya dza dza nan: phur bu thogs nas: hūm̐: khrag 'thung thugs las sprul pa'i sras: las mdzad badz+ra kī la ya: nam mkha'i mthongs nas thog ltar babs: ru tra'i snying la kī la ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bhigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ru tra trag rak+sha mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dam nyams ru tra bsgral ba yi: dug lnga'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: skye med ngang du dgyes par rol: lhag med ye shes dbyings su hoḥ de nas tshogs la rol ba ni: hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos sogs/ lhag ma ni: hoḥ dpal gyi pho nya bye ba 'bum: gnas nyul dur khrod tshogs khang 'grim: gsang sngags grogs kyi mel tshe ma: lhag ma bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ bhak+ṣa li si ta ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: dam las 'gal ba'i dgra bgegs la: bka' yi chad pa drag po phob:

dmag 'khrug zhi ba'i dus la bab: mtshon bskal nyams pa'i dus la bab: nad yams bzlog pa'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i dus la bab: klu srin 'joms pa'i dus la bab: 'dre rgod bsgral ba'i dus la bab: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: thad nas langs pa'i dgra bgegs 'di: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo bh+yo 'byung po gnod byed thams cad zlog zlog: gtor zor 'phen na zor thogs te: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring dam nyams dgra la 'phen: lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung bskyed: nyams pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: gtor zor dbal kha sha ra ra: drag sngags tshwa tshwa si li li: pho nyas srog len khyugs se khyug: nam gyi phar ma tshur phyed la: dgra srog dmar po chod la shog: zor sna las byed shan pas drongs: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma du na du bh+yoḥ thun tsa thun tsa bh+yoḥ rbad du shag du bh+yoḥ trig thum gzer thum bh+yoḥ mā ra ya bh+yoḥ zhes gtor ma me dpung ngam mtshon char bsgyur la dgra bo'i phyogs su 'phang : de nas chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: bla ma thod phreng drag po dang : mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes gnyis: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor phyes: steng 'og lha srin khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og ti sgro'i tshogs khang du: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring gnas nyul khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa yis: ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas: gsang rgya zab gter bton pa'i tshe: las kyi ma mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ḍā ka ḍāk+ki ma mo ru lu bh+yoḥ

i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan sil snyan sgra: brda gar glu dbyangs khyugs se khyug: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi: de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dam sri bkug: rta bro ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: mnan mnan ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bro: nam yang ma ldang las kyi bro: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul zhing shig: oṃ nan ā nan hūm̐ nan mā ra ya nan: zhes rta bro bya: de nas gtor snod kha yar bzed la me tog 'thor: dngos grub len pa ni: hūm̐: zab dbyings bla med gsang ba'i mchog: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: mi 'gyur sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: 'gags med gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: spros bral thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang bzhi stsol: 'chi med tshe dang mi zad nor: snyan grags mnga' thang chos dang srid: phun tshogs 'dod rgu deng 'dir stsol: oṃ dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirmā kā ya: swa bhā kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang bzhi blangs shing dngos grub rol: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung dpal chen pho brang lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu yum la bsdu: yum yab hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang mi dmigs klong : ka dag rang byung rang shar klong du hoḥ a āḥ zhes mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bsdu: rjes bsngo ba ni: hoḥ dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rol rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gzhi gcig bsngo: de nas smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral: gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas:

tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: ka dag lhun grub rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'chi med tshe yi lha: gnas lugs rang rtsal mngon pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : tshe rabs gtan gyi bla mar bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang : gsang rgyud gdams pas rgyud smin bkra shis shog: sa ma ya: e ma kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i snyan brgyud zab rgya can: yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje me 'bar bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: chos pa rnams kyang chos gzugs rtags tsam 'dzin: nyams len snying rus smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra: yi dam mi sgrub rgyal 'gong the'u rang bsgrub: de yi rkyen byas stong khams ru trar skye: yi dam mi dgyes ri rab logs la gzigs: steng 'og 'khrugs shing nad mtshon char pa g.yo: chos rgyal bris pa'i ri mo shul rjes smra: ma 'ongs de dus 'gro mang skyob pa yi: yang zab snying thig zab chos bka' rgya can: bla ma drag po sgrub pa'i las tshogs 'di: gzhan las khyad 'phags yid bzhin nor bu'i chos: tshig nyung don che myur zab snying gi cha: yang gsang 'di 'dra gzhan la sbas pa med: mtshan skar mang yang nyin mo'i skar ma gcig: me tog mang yang u dum+ba ra gcig: sems can mang yang sa bcu'i sangs rgyas gcig: sgrub skor mang yang snying gi thig le gcig: zab rgya mang yang gnad kyi gzer bu gcig: de phyir mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod ma gtogs par: yang zab gcig dril 'di 'dra shin tu dkon: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed ri mor gzugs: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: pad+ma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: las kyi ma sring mkha' 'gros rgya 'di srungs:

dam nyams bdud rigs lag tu ma shor cig: dus drug ma yengs bya ra lhang lhang gyis: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i tshogs khang nas/ gsang gter du bgyis nas lo drug bar gsang rgyas bsdams/ slar glang lor pad+ma sbas tshal nam mkha' 'brug grags su sangs rgyas lhums zhugs kyi zla tshes la shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi mngon rtogs: nad 'joms par bu zhes bya ba bzhugs: khro rgyal stobs 'dus drag por 'dud: ma 'ongs yang mtha' rtsod ldan gyi: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: bod mi mgo nag bsod nams chung : mi dge dug sbyor nag po yi: bar chad ldang zhing dus min 'chi: mtha' yi mi bzhi dbus su bsnyeg: dam sri 'dre rgod tsha ngar che: sngar gyi chos khrims sil bur 'thor: chos rgyal dmangs kyi khol bur 'bebs: gtsug lag bya sprang yul 'dres 'dzin: bcos thabs ma mchis nad rigs dar: srin mos sha khrag dmar 'gyed gtong : grib btsan shan pa rlung ltar 'tshub: dmar nad lhog yams tre tre hoḥ rims yams me dbal sha khol gyis: bar chad sdang zhing mi thog 'bud: smyo 'bog snying gzer steng grib kyi: ltas ngan sna dgu ldang ba'i dus: srung thabs man ngag khyad par can: gu ru bdag gis legs par gdams: jo mo mtsho rgyal khyod nyid kyis: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: gter bdag dge bsnyen bzhi la bcol: gzho stod ti sgro'i brag la sbas: yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: gnubs ban dz+nyā na'i skye ba ni: pad+ma gter bdag gling la sprod: dur khrod tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan: sa gzhi mthing nag 'jam pa'i dal: dkyil 'khor bri zhing mchod pa bsham: las rim gzhung bzhin shes par bya: yang na spros med lugs ltar bya: rang nyid drag po'i nga rgyal gyis:

bskyed rim gsal zhing drag sngags bzlas: rims yams lhog rgod gdon gyi rigs: sbur ma mes khyer ci bzhin du: gzhom zhing bsregs pa'i dmigs pa bya: rang nyid srung ngam nad pa la: rdzas kyi gdams pa 'di ltar bstan: nag po dgu dang khyung lnga sman: gri khrag ke tshe shang tshe dang : dug khrag thod rus phag nag khrag: 'dzin pa thar nu ra nag khrag: de dag sngags shing ril bu bsgril: lus la 'chang ngam lto ru btang : zhag bdun dag la lan re bskyar: yang na yul srung dar lcog 'dzugs: snga zhogs dud pa ma btang gong : sngags bzlas bskyed rim gsal gyur na: 'go nad srung bar the tshom med: srung ba bya na rdzas rnams byugs: lus la rgyun du 'chang bar bya: dang po skad cig dran rdzogs su: snang stong ma bcos 'di ltar gsal: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ rgya gram: ram̐ las me ri kham̐ rak+ta: sum̐ las zhing chen keṃ ri rab: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas rdzogs: ye shes me zer srung ba'i gur: mi shigs pho brang rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: oṃ badz+ra e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na hūm̐: de nas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: dur khrod e yi sa gzhi dbus: lha klu sde brgyad bsnol ba'i khrir: dam sri bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka: drag rtsal pad+ma khrag 'thung sku: sku mdog dmar nag me zer 'phro: zhal gsum phyag drug zhal gdangs khro: spyan dgu smin ma glog ltar 'khyug: dbu la rigs lnga'i khyung chen rdzogs: g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje me: g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul: dur khrod dpal chas yongs su rdzogs: zhabs bzhi khro bo'i 'gying stabs kyis: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog zhon: sa bdag klu yi gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: shar du sgrol ging srog bdag mthing : g.yas gsum spu gri chu gri me: g.yon gsum thod khrag snying dang sdig: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan: me yi bya khyung dmar nag zhon: hūm̐:

lho ru gtum ging sngo nag 'bar: g.yas gsum tsit+ta me chu gri: g.yon gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ lcags sdig me: dur khrod dpal chas rab tu rdzogs: 'joms byed bya khyung kham nag zhon: hūm̐: nub tu khro ging dmar nag gtum: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug thod: g.yon gsum 'khor lo spu gri sdig: khro chas rdzogs shing rngam pa la: srog gzan bya khyung ser nag zhon: hūm̐: byang du las ging ljang nag rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum tri shūl lcags sdig khyung : dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs la rngam: gtor byed bya khyung ljang nag zhon: kun kyang dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhal gsum gdangs shing spyan dgu bgrad: ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: dbu rgyan bya khyung dmag tshogs 'gyed: brkyang bskum khyung zhon gsal bar bskyed: mtshams bzhir khro bo sprul pa'i khyung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag rngam: gser mig zangs ra lcags mchu bgrad: me gshog rdeb cing khro sder bsnun: rgyal bsen dam sri'i gnyen por bsgom: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ru: shar du ma mo sdig gdong ma: rgyal bsen 'joms pa'i gnyen por bsgom: lho ru ma mo chu srin gdong : klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen por bsgom: nub tu ma mo phag gdong ma: gson 'dre dam sri'i gnyen por bsgom: byang du ma mo khyung gdong ma: yams nad dus 'khrugs gnyen por bsgom: las kyi ma mo mched bzhi po: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams: gcer mo mtshan bsgrad stong khams nyul: chibs su lcags sdig mgo dgu bcibs: stobs kyis dpag tshad stong khams g.yo: yams nad 'joms pa'i gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: phyi rol sprul pa'i bya khyung 'gyed: gzhan yang las byed pho nya rnams: snang srid rol pa'i rtsal shar nas: chu zla rmi lam ji bzhin bsgom:

spros med spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: dgongs shig che mchog drag po rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha': dus 'khrug yams nad rgyal 'gong dang : dam sri gnod byed kha dar bas: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: nad bdag choms la nad mkhar shigs: nad dal chod la yams dal sgyur: nad mtshon bsregs gtor rdul du rlog: sgrub pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams su: bya khyung sprul pa'i dmag dpung 'khrigs: me gshog rlabs bskyod stong gsum g.yo: drag sngags gzir 'debs srid gsum gzhom: yams nad gdug pa thal bar rlog: hūm̐: bskul lo rig 'dzin mthu ma chung : rbad do bya khyung rtsal ma zhan: brten no ma mo bang ma bul: g.yab bo sgrol ging rgyang ma ring : nad mtshon gdug pa'i dbal zor 'di: myur du gzhom pa'i phrin las mdzod: dang po las sngags nad 'joms ni: oṃ ma hā gu ru khroṃ ka ra ging ka ra tsa mun tri ta ya: ka la dun+ti tsit+ta la bh+yo bh+yoḥ oṃ she la du ging rā dza shig shig: nā ga du na dun+ti tri zlog zlog: oṃ a ka tsa tu mā ra ya rbad rbad: rak+sha du tri snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ tsha ba tsha nad mā ra ya nan nan: oṃ du na du na shig shig: hag tshal pa kha la dun+ti bh+yo bh+yoḥ ha ching rba du tri kha la bh+yo bh+yoḥ spel tshig sbyar: tsit+ta zung zung yaṃ yaṃ rmug rmug: chum chum baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad rbad: las sngags nad bdag 'joms byed ni: oṃ du ching nag po nad bdag gi srog la rbad rbad: pra ching nag po bdun drug gi sha la zo zo: khro chu khol ma rgya nad kyi snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bya khyung nag po rgyu gzer gyi snying la rbad rbad: lcags sdig nag po rgyal bsen gyi srog la chum chum: phag nag khro gtum rims yams kyi dbugs la sdud sdud: trig khroṃ nag po sha khol gyi snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ

bhe tri nag po khrag skyug gi nad la thum thum: artsig nag po dmar bshal gyi srog la rngub rngub: ka ru nag po rgya 'brum gyi nad la shig shig: khe tra nag po rgyug gzer gyi srog la hur hur: yak+sha nag po 'go nad kyi srog la rbad rbad: trig khrom̐ ra tsa khrag skyug gi nad la rbad rbad: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa pañca 'byung lnga'i nad la shig shig: nad bdag rims bdag pho mo myog myog dril dril: thun thun rbad rbad swā hā: zhes drag sngags rnams yengs med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzlas shing dmigs pa bskyed rim ltar la: rang nyid che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las kyi ging bzhi sprul pa'i khyung lnga sgrol ba'i ma mo bzhi khro bo rang 'dra dang bcas nas skar mda' 'khrugs pa ltar: me dpung gi rang bzhin 'bar zhing stong khams khengs par 'phros pas: nad nad bdag dang bcas pa hub hub ljib ljib tu zos nas lhag ma med pa rdul du brlags par bsam: yang lcags sdig nag po bye ba dung phyur 'phros shing rgyal nad srog rlung du gyur pa rnams brlags par bsam: de nas rim bzhin dmigs pa spro bsdu bya ste rdzas la sngags chu sbyar zhing rang ngam gzhan bsrung na sbyin: yang na nad pa sogs la sbyin na rdzas rnams mang bar bya: yul bsrung na: ras sam shing shun la bris te rgyal mtshan du gzugs pas rlung gi zer phog pa rnams la bsrung bar 'gyur ro: rang nyid nad pa'i sa ru 'gro na: snga zhogs dud pa sna la ma song dus: sngags rnams mang du bzlas shing sna bug tu spur bas srung ba'i mchog: yang na rdzas la sngags shing bu ga dgu dgag par bya: nad lam gcod pa ni shing tsher ma can la sngags te phyogs bzhir 'dzugs: mnan pa ni: liṅga bris shing 'gugs gzhug bya la: shing tsher ma can la sngags pas lan dgu brab ste: lam rgya gram du mnan: sreg pa ni: thugs dam bskul zhing sngags te tsher ma can gyi me ru bsreg:

'phang ba ni: thugs dam bskul te rdo thun gyi zor steng 'og phyogs bzhir 'phang : skyabs pa ni: sngags chu steng 'og khang khyim du steng 'og tu gtor: spo ba ni: dar lcog bris pas tshang : srung ba ni: lcags sdig pho mo gnyis kyi khog par sngags 'di 'bri zhing las sngags kyis rab tu gnas te la chas dril la 'chang : sdig pa pho yi khog par 'di bris: papaṃbadunadruganadalasrungasashig: sdig pa mo yi khog par: ghanghararimasayamasalasrungasashig: khang par 'dzugs na bya khyung pho'i khog par: garuḍapakhyingadza'agonadalasrungasashig: bya khyung mo yi khog par: khroṃthaḍagingahara'agoba'inadalasrungasashig: yul bsrung na phag nag po pho yi lto bar: ghakhyingarādzaganyan rgodalasrungasashig: phag nag po mo yi lto bar: trishigaharalhogayamasalasrungasashig: ces bris te: thams cad la rdzas kyis byugs nas dril la thum dmar nag bya'o: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug mchog: yang zab drag po khyung zhon 'di: sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: ma 'ongs yang mtha' kha ral la: 'go nad sna dgu dar ba'i tshe: bsam gtan nyal chog bsgrub pa 'di: 'gogazand nathayan+dad: thugs sras bud+dha dz+nyā na yi: byin brlabs sprul pa shes rab can: pad+ma gter bdag gling pa la: sprod cig dge bsnyen sde bzhi rgya: gter srung sman mo mched bzhi khyod: dam chos 'di yi mel tshe gyis: dam nyams bdud rigs log lta can: snying med dred po skal chad mkhan: lag tu ma shor sa ma ya: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra smyo spyod can gter bdag gling pas 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen po nas gdan drangs shing*/ sbas yul pad+ma rong du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // yang zab pad+ma khrag 'thung las: go cha'i lha tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba bzhugs so: bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang go cha'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni:

rang nyid ting 'dzin rnam gsum mi 'bral ba'i ngang : ga) hūm̐: rang rig bla ma drag po rtsal: 'jigs byed dmar nag dpal chas can: he ru ka dpal gsal ba yi: thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten dbus: nyi zla'i gwa'u brtsegs pa'i steng : hūm̐ las gsang bdag rdo rje gtum: mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub can: de yi thugs kar na dā'i dbus: thugs mchog snang ba mtha' yas sku: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: de yi thugs kar dran rig sku: hūm̐ ljang 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: drag po'i spyi gtsug 'khor lo ru: ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag ber con thod khrag bsnams: mgrin par h+ya ghṛ wa'i sku: dmar nag dbyug pa lcags sgrog 'dzin: lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga ni: mdangs lnga gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: gsang bar yak+sha me dbal te: smug nag tho ba lcags kyu 'dzin: kun kyang khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma drag po yi: rtsa gnas yan lag bzhi la ni: shar du badz+ra kī la ya: lho ru rat+na kī la ya: nub tu pad+ma kī la ya: byang du karma kī la ya: rang mdog dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: sgro gshog dbyings kyi mkha' ru brgyangs: phyag na ri rab phur pa 'dril: thams cad sku smad dbal zur ldan: ma 'dres chu zla'i dbyibs ltar bsgom: ja) oṃ a mi dhe wa hūm̐ hrī dha badz+ra pā ṇi ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa ha ri ni sa yak+sha kā la badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: ta) hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: snang ba mtha' yas gshegs su gsol: he chen sku yi pho brang nas: ya mān+ta ka gshegs su gsol: dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: h+ya ghṛ wa gshegs su gsol: lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: badz+ra pā ṇi gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod dag pa'i pho brang nas: mkha' 'gro sde lnga gshegs su gsol: gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas:

yak+sha me dbal gshegs su gsol: zhi ba lhun grub pho brang nas: badz+ra kī la gshegs su gsol: rgyas pa mthar phyin pho brang nas: rat+na kī la gshegs su gsol: khams gsum dbang sdud pho brang nas: pad+ma kī la gshegs su gsol: mngon spyod drag po'i pho brang nas: karma kī la gshegs su gsol: bde chen lhun grub pho brang nas: drag po'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub yul: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: che btsan rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: laṅka mgrin bcu'i kha gnon mdzad: gdong dmar srin po dam la btags: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad: rje btsun de yi rjes 'jug phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: drag po'i pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir: byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur: 'gyur med sku yi pho brang nas: bskyed rim stobs bcus byin gyis rlobs: 'gags med gsung gi sgo phyes la: tshangs dbyangs drug cus byin gyis rlobs: 'khrul med thugs kyi sgo phyes la: ye shes chen pos byin gyis rlobs: yon tan brgyad khri'i sgo phyes la: myang 'das chos kyis byin gyis rlobs: phrin las sna tshogs sgo phyes la: mchog thun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de ltar ye shes lha yi tshogs: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rang bzhin dbyings su rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: thugs rje'i dbyings nas 'gro don du: dbang drag lha tshogs bdag gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ oṃ sarba pū dza hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ca) hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: rang byung phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: puṇ+ṭa'i phreng ba mkha' yi gzhu ltar bkra:

skyed mo'i dri bsung g.yu bun lan tshar bsigs: ku mud tsha zer dmar 'od zhags pa 'khyil: klu yi bdud rtsi gzi 'od rba rlabs 'phyur: mkha' yi gru 'dzin ro brgya'i bcud du bskyil: dbyar rnga'i sgra chen stong gsum khyon du g.yo: yid spyod de las gzhol ba'i bye brag rnams: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: bla med nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bhan+dha lcang lo 'khyil ba'i snod yangs su: 'bru bcud sna tshogs sbyar ba 'bras kyi chang : rtsi bcud sna tshogs sbyar ba bstar ba'i chang : sman phud sna tshogs sbyar ba gso ba'i chang : sha chen sna tshogs sbyar ba rdzas kyi chang : rak+ta sna tshogs sbyar ba drag po'i chang : de ltar bskyed dang rang bzhin bdud rtsi rnams: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: bde chen gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: brda grogs snang stong gsal ba'i me long thogs: grags stong glu mos snyan pa'i pi waṃ thogs: tshor stong bzhad mos dri bsil phreng ba thogs: myong stong gar mos ro brgya'i bcud ldan thogs: reg stong sgeg mos lha yi yug gos thogs: blos blangs yid la dgyes pa'i mchod sprin rnams: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: zung 'jug sbyor ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: snang mtha' gos dkar sbyor ba chos sku'i klong: spyan gzigs sgrol ma sbyor ba longs sku'i rtsal: drag po phag mo sbyor ba sprul sku mdangs: go cha'i lha tshogs rang bzhin bde stong sbyaur: phyag rgya drug gis bde chen dga' bzhi bskyed: ging chen rigs bzhi rang rang yum dang sbyor:

zung 'jug rgyas 'debs 'khor lor khyab par bskul: thabs shes 'du 'bral med pa'i mchod pa 'di: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: spu gris bcad pa'i 'dre rgod thod pa ru: gdug pa'i dgra bo byad ma'i snying bshos la: dbang po rnam lnga gtor skyu zor gyis bskor: klad rus khrag dang zhag gis shin tu sbags: byad ma mi ro rta ro'i g.yang gzhi la: gdugs sogs sham bu rnams dang phyar rgyan spras: zhe sdang rus pa'i sgal tshigs rtsang gis brgyan: sbrul ltar 'khyil ba bha su'i zhags pas dkris: ye nas rang byung snod bcud bha liṃ ta: bskyed cing spel ba'i dmar chen gtor ma 'di: rdo rje thod phreng 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo gdug sems can: mngon spyod rdo rje ral gris bsgral ba'i sha: sgrub la 'tshe ba'i log lta bsam sbyor can: chos skyong rnams kyis bsgral ba'i snying khrag dang : gsang sngags gnyan la dgra bgegs sdig to can: las mkhan rnams kyis bsgral ba'i don snying dang : bdag la 'tshe zhing sdang ba'i dgra bgegs dang : myur mgyogs shan pas bsgral ba'i klad rus rkang : dgra rgol dmag jag ston pa'i byad ma rnams: sna tshogs pho nyas bsgral zhing gtub pa yi: bsgral mchod phung po khyon ltar bkang ba'i tshogs: rdo rje thod phreng 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: rang byung kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni: snang srid ye grol mtshan ma'i brjod las bral: snod bcud gang snang ye shes sgyu ma'i rtsal:

sna tshogs ma 'gags rang byung ngo bo stong : phyogs med res bral bde chen 'dus ma byas: ci yang ma yin ci yang 'char ba'i rgyu: rnam pa ma grub rnam grol chen po nyid: dbyibs su mi snang a 'thas brtag gzhig bral: 'gogs pa dran 'gags khegs pa'i chos kyang med: kun grol khyab brdal ngang gi gar dgu la: shugs kyis cir mtshon cir yang lta ba'i lha: byed spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs ci srid kyi: de srid 'gro 'ong mchod yul bral ba 'di: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bdag gi g.yar dam nyams pa sor chud nas: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pa'am gu ru sa twa brjod: de nas thugs bstod rdo rje'i go cha ni: da) hūm̐: rdo rje mi bskyod snang mthas spyi bor brgyan: mnyam bzhag bsgoms pas kun snang khyab par 'gems: rdo rje sku yi gar dgu 'jigs su rung : be con 'bar ba ma rungs bdud la 'debs: rdo rje gsung gis drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: dbyug tho 'bar bas bgegs kyi spyi bor 'gems: rdo rje thugs kyis rang bzhin klong la khyab: rtse lnga'i rwa gdeng snang srid yongs la phyar: rdo rje glog 'gyu mkha' la 'gro ba'i gar: gcod byed gri gug nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor bshig: rdo rje gnod sbyin srid pa las su sbyor: gnam lcags tho bas ma rungs spyi bor 'gems: rdo rje'i las bzhi'i phrin las sna tshogs 'grub: ri rab phur bus 'khor 'das dbyings su sgrol: de ltar 'jigs byed 'bar ba dbang drag lha: sku yi cha la rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: go cha thams cad yi dam lha ru snang : mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor gzhan nas btsal du gang : snang mtha'i rang bzhin zhi ba dbyings kyi lha: zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmar nag me phreng khro bo 'dus pa'i dpal:

khro bo'i dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ya mān+ta ka 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha: sku yi lha tshogs rnams l h+ya ghṛ wa pad+ma dbang chen lha: gsung gi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: badz+ra pā ṇi gsang bdag rdo rje'i lha: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje gzhon nu badz+ra ku mā ra: phrin las phur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ḍāk+ki rigs lnga dbyings phyug nam mkha'i lha: ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: yak+sha me dbal mngon spyod ldan pa'i lha: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs bzhi'i sras kyis gdab pa'i phyag mtshan 'gyed: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:

ces pas bstod de rang lus rtsa khams thams cad go cha'i lha tshogs su gyur nas gzugs sku khro bo rol pa'i gar rdzogs: longs sku sgyu ma lta bu'i dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur: chos sku bde chen yangs pa'i dgongs pa bde blag tu 'grub: sna tshogs ma 'gags he ru ka'i pho brang snod bcud zung du shes pa'i skal ldan du 'grub par mngon no: sa ma ya: go cha'i hūm̐ sgrub bya ba ni: gdod nas dgongs pa rang byung du: skye med ngang la gsal gdab cing : 'gags med ci yang 'di ltar shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: snang srid thams cad drag po e yi klong : snod bcud gzugs snang yi dam lha yi sku: 'byin 'jug rlung rnams rang bzhin snying po'i sngags: khams kyi rang mdangs khro bo rol pa'i rtsal: gnas lugs ma bcos skye med yi ge hūm̐: rang rig ngo bo che mchog drag po rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng sku mdog mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing drag tu khros: rdo rje gri gug ral gri g.yas su thogs: bhan dmar thong shol lcags sdig g.yon na bsnams: rdo rje sgro gdeng dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: rdo rje phag mo zangs mdog gri thod 'dzin: brkyang bskum ye shes gar gyis pang du 'khyud: 'bar ba'i zer ldan me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs byed drag po'i sku yi char: spyi bor snang mtha' rigs kyi bdag: steng du sprul pa'i bya khyung rngam: dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje 'jigs: mgrin par dbang chen rta mgrin gshe: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje gtum: lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu 'bar: gsang bar yak+sha khro bo brjid: phyag g.yas badz+ra kī la ya: phyag g.yon rat+na kī la ya:

zhabs g.yas pad+ma kī la ya: zhabs g.yon karma kī la ya: gsang ba yum gyi gnas lnga ru: bde chen mkha' 'gro sde bzhis gar: gzhon nu rgyan rdzogs cha lugs 'chang : drag po yab yum phyogs bzhi ru: 'jigs byed ging chen yab yum bzhi: sgrol ging gtum ging khro ging dang : las ging bcas pa yab yum brgyad: mtshams su sprul pa yang sprul bcas: gzhan yang sgo skyong la sogs pa: dbang drag rdo rje srin po yi: sku gsung thugs kyi gzi brjid rnams: stobs bcu 'gyed phyir sprul pa'i lha: srid gsum mngon spyod las kyis sdud: stong gsum sde brgyad dam la btags: gling khams kun la 'gran zla bral: sku las khro chung tshwa tshwa 'phro: me ri'i 'bar mched wa la la: 'byung po mi dang mi min sogs: bgegs dang dam sri ma lus kun: drag po'i stobs kyis tshar bcad gyur: rang bzhin hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: zhes hūm̐ sgra sgrogs shing snang srid thams cad res 'ga' khro bo khro mo res 'ga' hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan snang srid kyi khyon thams cad khengs par bsgom/ skabs su rang bzhin 'ub kyis bdag la bsdu ba mi dmigs gsal stong ka dag ngang la bsgom: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ rang byung lhun grub rang shar rol pa'i lha: rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtshos dbugs dbyung ba: skye dgu'i bstan srid man ngag zab mo'i chos: nges don lam zhugs gsang sngags spyi la che: ma gi ta ltar ha la'i gnyen por mchog: skyogs la skyes 'di da chu'i zung sdeb bzhin: si hul klu yi gnyen po'i ro gcig ltar: na ra'i bstan gnyis 'jig rten mgon gyi lhums: rang bzhin dpe kyud gzhol med blang spyod pas: snang srid 'gengs 'dir khyab tu g.yo ba gang : gzhom par mi dmigs gzhigs su mi bya ba'i:

yang dag 'di bkod dbang po dpe skyong la: yon tan dpung mtsho nyer len sprod kyi rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa las: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril bzhugs so: pad+ma he ru ka la 'dud: pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa yi: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril ba: spros med don gyi rnal 'byor che: gu ru'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod skyabs sems dang : tshogs bsags mchod pa byin brlab sogs: ji ltar rigs pa sngon song nas: zhes pas: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: lan gsum: gsum pa mchod pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dz+nyā na a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lnga'am bdun gyis brlabs: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim ni: ma bcos lhun grub ngang nyid du:

rang byung dran rdzogs 'di ltar bsgom: oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gdod ma'i stong nyid ngang las snying rje'i rtsal: hūm̐ dmar 'od kyi 'phro 'dus snod bcud sbyangs: stong gsal ngang las rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang : dur khrod rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas dbus: pad nyi dregs pa rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i steng : sa bon phra thabs tshul du babs pa las: che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po rtsal: dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar khro zhing gtum: spyan gsum sdang mig sma ra smin ma gzengs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra sgrogs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes snang srid zil gyis gnon: g.yon pas phur pa ma rungs snying la gzir: lcags sdig tshwa tshwas dam 'gong hub hub za: dbu gtsug rta mgo rdo rje dbyings su 'tsher: 'jigs pa'i gad mos stong gsum 'gul zhing 'khyom: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du rngam: gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: drag me dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong na rol: spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med pas mtshan: sku la zhi khro rab 'byams sprin phung 'phro: gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge gsal zhing 'bar: thugs ka'i 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ rak+sha srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas: stong gsum dregs pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po'i skur bzhengs nas: ma rungs log 'dren 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hrīḥ pad+ma kro dha he ru ka e h+ya hi hrīṃ hrīṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: bskyed pa'i dam tshig rten la gnyis med bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pa'i brda yis dad phyag 'tshal: drag po'i nyer spyod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs phyag rgya'i gar gyis mchod: shrī he ru ka badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs? pañca a mṛ ta ta na ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar:

rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bzlas pa sngags kyi 'phro 'du ni: thugs kar pha lam rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: sngags phreng dus mtha'i me lce 'bar ba yis: dregs pa tshar bcad rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs nus stobs bdag thim gnyis med gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ pad+ma he ru ka artsig nirtsig sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ sgra dag ting 'dzin gsal bar 'bum phrag bzhi: bzlas pas khrag 'thung chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs: thun mthar mchod cing bstod la bzod par gsol: lha dang rang sems dbyer med 'od gsal ngang : bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas gdab bo: zhes pas: shrī he ru ka badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs? pañca a mṛ ta ta na ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang : ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya bzla'o: mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs bya la: bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung ye shes dkyil 'khor lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu gtso la bsdu: gtso bo hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang dmigs med klong : ka dag rang byung shar grol klong du hoḥ a āḥ bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral:

gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rdzogs rim thugs ka'i hūm̐ dmar kho na la: rlung yig rig pa dril la mdung tshugs gtad: 'das pa 'gags shing ma 'ongs ma skyes pa'i: da lta'i shes pa rig stong lam du khyer: bdud dang dam sri rgyal 'gong la sogs pa: thams cad sems kyis snang ba kho na te: sems la ngo bo ngos bzung mtshan ma med: stong gsal don gyi pad+ma khrag 'thung che: gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang rig 'di ka rang : 'khor 'das gnyis med chen por la bzla'o: de ltar goms 'dris brtan pa thob pa na: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos kun zil gyis gnon: rdo rje he ru ka dpal mngon sum 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: snod ldan smin byed snying po'i gtor dbang ni: dpal gyi gtor chen brjid ldan mdzes par bsham: lha sngags ting 'dzin nus ldan cho gas bsgrub: slob mas yon phul gsol gdab rgyud sbyangs la: dam ye dbyer med brten byas gnas gsum du: gtor ma bzhag cing sku gsung thugs dbang sbyin: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung sku: rtsa gsum rab 'byams sku dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi lus la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim sku yi dbang mchog thob par shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sngags mthar: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung gsung : rtsa gsum rab 'byams gsung dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi ngag la dbang bskur bas: nus pa sngags kyi dbang mchog thob par shog: sngags mthar: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung thugs: rtsa gsum rab 'byams thugs dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi yid la dbang bskur bas: rig rtsal don gyi dbang mchog thob par shog: sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: slar yang gtor ma spyi bor bzhag byas la:

hūm̐ hrīḥ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pad+ma khrag 'thung rtsal: rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang gnyis su med: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sku yi dbyings su rdzogs: skal ldan slob ma'i spyi bor mngon sum byon: sgo gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sol: smin grol dbang dang byin rlabs char ltar phob: rang byung rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor na: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: sarba sid+dhi hrī: zhes brjod gtor ma'i lha bstim dngos grub sbyin: bkra shis brjod cing me tog char chen dbab: bar chad bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rab rgyal nas: pad+ma khrag 'thung nus stobs rdzogs par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma khrag 'thung gi: smin grol spros med don gyi gdams zab 'di: ma 'ongs don phyir rin chen gter du sbas: las 'phro can gyi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter gyi snying po'o// // ༈ bla ma drag pad+ma khrag 'thung las: smad las rlung gi 'khor lo dmar po bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma kho bo pad+ma bdag 'dra ngas: phyi rabs skal ldan smon lam can: rjes su 'jug pa'i blo ldan don: yang bzlog rlung gi 'khor lor bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po bca' gzhi'i lag len ni: drag po'i lcags snod la sogs su: ma traṃ sa gzhi legs par bcag: de dbus chos 'byung bsnol ma brtsegs: de steng drag po yab yum gzugs: phyi rol gnam lcags rtsibs bcu drug: de steng khyung dang ging yab yum: ma mo bzhi bcas tshang bar bshams: dar nag gdugs dang tsa ka li: srung bzlog 'khor lo dag kyang btsugs: phyag rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig la: phyi rtsang drug cu rtsa bzhi'o:

dmar chen la sogs gzhung bzhin bshams: mda' dar sna lnga'i rgyan ldan spras: thun rdzas la sogs zhib tu bsags: sa ma ya: dang po mdun bskyed ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod sa gzhi'i dbus: 'byung ba rim brtsegs dmar chen rgya mtsho 'khyil: keng rus gar bsgyur gcan gzan sna tshogs ngar: de dbus rab 'jigs drag po'i thod mkhar ni: rngam stabs nag 'jigs me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho kyi li li: ru tra'i snying khar chos 'byung 'khor lo'i dbus: srid pa las kyi drag rdzas 'dus pa yi: dmar nag gtor ma dbal ldan ri rab tsam: drag po rtsang dang sha khrag liṅgas brgyan: rno dbal thog dang myur mgyogs rlung gi shug: phyi ni gtor ma nang ni khro bo'i mkhar: ru tra'i snying las grub pa'i pho brang gyur: de dbus ti ra bam chen bsnol ba yi: tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i nyi zla gdan du gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sūr+ya ti ra baṃ tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya lhan: de nas bdag bskyed kyi mngon rtogs nas sngags su bskyal: hūm̐: de steng ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ spel steng : gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra can: me ri tshwa tshwa si li?

sogs na bsrangs: sa ma ya: bskang ba ni: mchod pa kha gso zhing dri gsur sogs btang la: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: sgrol ging ma mo khyung gi 'khor dang bcas: dkyil 'khor thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog ri ltar spungs: sha chen gsur gyi dud pa sprin ltar gtibs: rkang dmar zhag gi sgron me nyi ltar gsal: dmar chen rgya mtsho'i dri chab mtsho ltar 'khyil: ru tra'i tsit+ta dpal bshos dbyings la bsnyegs: rkang gling thod rnga'i rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: drag po phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'dis: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum thugs dam bskang : dpa' bo ging bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa'i bya khyung sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong ma mo gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul phag sdig khyung gi thugs dam bskang : gter srung ma mo gnod sbyin thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: bhan+dha'i snod du mu tig dri med gtams: dung dmar tsan+dan dmar po mtsho ltar 'khyil: bswe phur srub med nang du dpal bshos btsugs: rang byung g.yang gzhi rgyan gos mkha' la bres: don snying sna lnga'i lda ldi bar snang khyab: pha rol dgra las rgyal ba'i go mtshon bkram: dar tshon spyan gzigs sna tshogs dbyings la lhub: dur khrod pho brang rgyan dang mchod sprin 'dis: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum thugs dam bskang : dpa' bo ging bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa'i bya khyung sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong ma mo gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul phag sdig khyung gi thugs dam bskang :

gter srung ma mo gnod sbyin thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: ga ṇa tshogs mchod rgya mtsho kyi li li: māṃ sa sha chen sna tshogs spungs se spung : 'bras rgun bur chang bcud g.yo me re re: mchod sprin lha lcam brda gar khyugs se khyug: sbyor sgrol mchod pa sna tshogs thibs se thib: dpag yas sprin ltar gtibs pa'i mchod pa 'dis: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum thugs dam bskang : ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung khro rgyal sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : dpa' bo ging bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa'i bya khyung sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong ma mo gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul phag sdig khyung lnga'i thugs dam bskang : gter srung ma mo gnod sbyin thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bsal gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: bshags pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor rgyal ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med dmus long sgrib pa can: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs ma gsal sngags sgra nyams: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgyu chung phud lhag 'dres: gtang rag dus kyi mchod pa lo zla 'das: so thar bslab don khas blangs dam la nyams: rnam g.yeng le lo ma rig ci mchis pa: dbang drag 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : de nas mnga' gsol bya ba ni: gser skyems gtor chung sogs bshams la: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru kaḥ srid gsum dbang sdud dregs pa bran du bskol: snang mtha'i thugs las sprul pa khro bo'i rgyal: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: chos sku'i mnga' gsol skye med thugs dang ldan: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo:

longs sku'i mnga' gsol sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul 'gyed: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: sprul sku'i mnga' gsol dmar nag khro zhing gtum: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: dbang lha'i mnga' gsol dbu la rig lnga'i khyung : de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: khro bo'i mnga' gsol dpal chas bcu yi brgyan: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: khro mo'i mnga' gsol dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: srid gsum mnga' gsol bya khyung mthing ga zhon: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: dpa' bo'i mnga' gsol ye shes ging bzhi'i bskor: de bzhin rnal 'byaur bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: mkha' 'gro'i mnga' gsol las kyi ma mo sdud: de bzhin rnal 'byaur bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: chos skyong mnga' gsol mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: pho nya'i mnga' gsol khyung dang phag sdig 'gyed: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: bstan srung mnga' gsol bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: drag rtsal mnga' gsol klu bdud sa bdag 'dul: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: myur mgyogs mnga' gsol ma mo'i dal yams 'joms: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: mthu stobs mnga' gsol rgyal bsen snying khrag 'thung : de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: shan pa'i mnga' gsol dam nyams srog dbugs phral: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: yul lha'i mnga' gsol lo nyes sad ser zhi: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: dam tshig mnga' gsol rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo:

bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: sgra snyan rol mo'i dbyangs kyis mnga' gsol lo: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas gnyan pos mnga' gsol lo: phyi nang mchod tshogs rgya mtshos mnga' gsol lo: gser skyems rin chen phud kyis mnga' gsol lo: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mnga' gsol lo: dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par mnga' gsol lo: dge 'dun sde dgon skyong bar mnga' gsol lo: bar chad bdud bzhi bsgral bar mnga' gsol lo: 'go ba'i nad rims 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: lo nyes sad ser zhi bar mnga' gsol lo: dus 'khrug mtshon bskal zhi bar mnga' gsol lo: sgrub la mchog thun stsol bar mnga' gsol lo: tshe yi rig 'dzin 'grub par mnga' gsol lo: lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs par mnga' gsol lo: gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gser skyems dang bdud rtsi sman raka gis gtor ma bran zhing nam mkhar gtor: de nas liṅga bsgral ba ni bsgral chas sna tshogs bsags: lcags snod nang du liṅga bzhag la dang po gser skyems gtong ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rdzu 'phrul dpa' ba'i brtul zhugs rtsal phyungs shig: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bstan srung thugs dam can: yul gnas dben ri gnyan po skyong ba la: mkha' la rgyu ba'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rogs dan sgrubs: dam nyams ru tra'i mgon skyabs ma byed cig: mthu ldan srung ma phrin las dus la bab: brnag pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: de nas rnal 'byor pa drag po'i chas su zhugs te phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug mthu stobs dbang :
