rtsal chen bdud dpung 'joms pa'i ngo bor gsal: thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog kī la ya: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu bsgril: byad ma 'byung po bsgral ba'i rang bzhin gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gsal btab hom bskyed pa ni: phaṭḥ mdun du las kyi brub khung nag po gnam lcags las grub pa zur gsum pa nag la 'thug pa dmar la rngam pa kha dog la gting zab pa zin na thar pa med pa'i nang du: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sngo la ham pa: skya la rid pa: mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa mgon skyabs kyi lha dang bral ba zhig tu gyur: phaṭḥ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang rig 'dzin thod phreng yab yum mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum ging bzhi sha za khyung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gter srung ma mo dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: khyad par du nad bdag pho mo'i mkhar khang dang bcas pa: dmag jag 'khrug pa'i sna 'dren pa'i dam nyams dgra bo: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i byad ma: 'dre rgod 'byung po gdug pa'i tshogs thams cad rang dbang med par gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ de nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs ma mo sdig gdong ma:

sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bsnams: sprul pa lcags sdig bye ba 'bum: shar phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo ma duṣ+ṭān dgra bo a kar+sha ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs ma mo chu srin gdong : sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na 'ching ba'i zhags pa thogs: sprul pa dug sbrul bye ba 'bum: lho phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo ra tsa ya dgra bo a kar+sha ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs ma mo phag gdong ma: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na bsdams pa'i lcags sgrog thogs: sprul pa dung gi phag rgod 'bum: nub phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo rak+sha ya dgra bo a kar+sha ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs ma mo khyung gdong ma: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na myos byed dril bu bsnams: sprul pa me yi bya khyung 'bum: byang phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo ma tsa bh+yo dgra bo a kar+sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas dgra bo lha dang dbye ba ni: bya rog dang 'ug sgro thogs nas: hūm̐: kha khā mu kha bya rog gdong : hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong : las kyi ma mo dmar nag gnyis: dam nyams dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha phyes: skyes lha yul lha dgra lha phyes: mgon skyabs ban bon srung ma phyes: lha dang phyes la bdud dang sprod: lhan cig skyes pa'i bdud dang sprod: 'chi bdag srog gcod bdud dang sprod: las ngan nyon mongs bdud dang sprod: nyams pa'i byad ma dgra bo 'di: lha dbye bdud sprad dus la bab: shan pa ma mo mthu ma chung : rdul phran bzhin du las mdzod cig: oṃ kha khā mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes:

ru tra thun bh+yo dgra bo shag phyes: myog thun baṃ ril dgra bo shag phyes: mā ra ma dun dgra bo shag phyes: zhes lha dang dbye zhing bdud dang sprod: de nas phur pa thogs te: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: khro rgyal badz+ra kī la ya: mgo bo rgya mdud 'brug stong ldir: 'chang gzung sgra gcan glog dmar 'khyugs: chu srin kha nas thog ser 'bebs: zur gsum shan pa gri thod 'bum: byad ma bdud la kī la ya: bsgral zh-ing gtub bo mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bo tsit+ta bhan+dha bhan+dha mā ra mā ra ha la ha la thun rbad: de nas rnam shes spar ba ni: hoḥ khyod kyi rnam shes āḥdakar po zhig tu gyur nas phur pa'i khong seng nas thon te snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar thim shig: phaṭḥ ces rnam shes sangs rgyas kyi zhing du spar: de nas thun sna tshogs brdeg cing : hūm̐: nyungs thun khro bo nyi li li: khrag thun nad rlangs phyu ru ru: dug thun rlung ltar chi li li: rdo thun rbab rgod sha ra ra: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: mtshon thun bu yug tshubs se tshub: zangs thun lcags thun spungs se spung : thun rdzas sna tshogs dgra la phob: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ thun da ye rbad da ye: na lo shag: rbad rbad: ces brdeg go: de nas ral gri thogs te: hūm̐: ma mo mched bzhi dus la bab: dug lnga bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: gtubs shing phye mar dkrugs par gyis: oṃ ma mo ma dun bh+yoḥ khaḍ+ga ya dgra bo'i sha khrag don snying lnga la rbad bh+yo bh+yoḥ chod chod: gtub gtub: myog myog: baṃ ril rbad: de nas lha la mchod pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shig: dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: phung po khams dang skye mched tshogs drug bcas: rngam yangs chos nyid 'bar ba'i zhal du bzhes: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes phul:

de nas bzlog mdos gso zhing rak+tas bran: liṅga sha dum gtor chung bshams nas: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed che btsan pad+ma he ru kaḥ snang srid lha srin 'dus pa'i dbus nas bzhengs: deng 'dir thugs dam bskul lo dmag dpung skyed: khrag 'thung mngon spyod las la bskul ba'i tshe: sku mdog dmar nag me zer ya la la: zhal nas hūm̐ sgra drag po chems se chem: phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha zings se zing : sgro gshog tshwa tshwa skar ltar si li li: dur khrod chas brgyad bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: dor stabs gyad kyis gling bzhi lto bar bcug: ye shes khro bo sprul pa'i dmag tshogs 'bum: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog khro mo gtum chen zhal: mthing nag skur ston chos nyid rang bzhin can: khro gtum spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing byad ma sngangs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung sdud: zangs gri 'bar bas bstan dgra'i mgo lus phral: sha za khro mo'i dmags tshogs bye ba 'bum: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ye shes las kyi dmag tshogs khrag 'thung pa: ging chen yab yum mtshon cha si li li: bya khyung dmag tshogs gshog sgra 'u ru ru: ma mo'i dmag tshogs bh+yo sgra di ri ri: lcags sdig tshogs ni 'dur ldang chems se chem: dug gi phag rgod mche ba thibs se thib: dug sbrul nag po 'khyug 'greng khyugs se khyug: las kyi shan pa gri thogs zengs se zeng : dmag dpung skyed cig srung ma dam tshig can: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: bskul lo thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor: bzlog sngags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor: drag sngags rdo rje'i ser chen phob:
nad dal chod la nad mkhar shig: 'byung po dam sri rmang nas phyungs: rig 'dzin srung ma dam tshig can: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

ces gtor ma 'bul zhing ye shes khro bo'i dmag tshogs go mtshon can grangs med 'khrab nas 'byung po nad bdag thams cad 'joms par bsgom: de nas rtsang bzlog ni: hūm̐: drag po'i pho brang dur khrod gnas mchog tu: las mkhan ging gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: myur mgyogs rngam pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs nas kyang : khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur seng ldeng rang bzhin can: rtse la me 'bar srid gsum wa la la: rtsa bar mun pa khrag mtsho kyi li li: sked par nga rgyal thog ser sha ra ra: drwa mig phrag dog rlung dmar 'u ru ru: logs su nga rgyal dug rlangs chi li li: dmar nag drag po'i rtsang phur hrangs se hrang : bha su'i ska rags zhags pa brengs se breng : zlog sngags rbad bskul dmod pa lhangs se lhang : khrag 'thung drag po'i rno dbal rtsang phur 'di: dgra bo byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i dal kha zlog: klu srin lhog yams 'bebs pa zlog: sa bdag zha grum gtong ba zlog: gnyan mdze rgyug 'gyel bdun drug zlog: khrag skyugs tre tre nag po zlog: sha khol dmar bshal grum bu zlog: rgya nad gzer thum smyo 'bog zlog: rkyen ngan bar chad dgra la zlog: oṃ khroṃ kro ta ya bh+yoḥ dza tri rbad tri ya bh+yoḥ nad bdag shaṃ long ya bh+yoḥ nad mkhar ru tri ya shig: trig khroṃ mā ra ya: nad bdag 'byung po kha thaṃ rbad ching ching bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de nas gtor mdos rak+ta bran zhing : khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyi zhal phyi la gzigs shing bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam: yang bzlog me yi spu gri dmar po ni: hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod pho brang e yi klong : gru gsum me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:

'jigs byed pad+ma khrag 'thung skur bzhengs shig: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sku mdog dmar po me zer 'phro ba yis: 'byung bzhi tshe yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: g.yas zhal dkar po dgyes la khro ba yis: yi dam lha yi bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: g.yon zhal mthing nag rab tu rngam pa yis: ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags bzlog tu gsol: dbus zhal dmar po gtum la 'khrugs pa yis: rtsa rlung dbang thang nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcur 'khyil ba yis: phyogs skyong bcu yi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: mche ba dkar po ri ltar gtsigs pa yis: khro bo bcu yi zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: shangs nas drag po'i rlung dmar g.yo ba yis: ma yams gdug pa'i sun kha bzlog tu gsol: zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa yis: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: bya khyung rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa yis: steng phyogs lha yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: dug sbrul nag pos dbu skra bcings pa yis: 'og phyogs klu srin ma rungs bzlog tu gsol: thod skam 'bar ba'i tshal lngas brgyan pa yis: lha srin gdug pa'i dal kha bzlog tu gsol: sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar ba yis: srid pa las kyi cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yas dang pos gri khug phyar ba yis: pho rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags bzlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag bsnams pa yis: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags bzlog tu gsol: g.yas kyi bar pas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi bar pas lcags sdig 'dzin pa yis: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: g.yas kyi tha mas me dpung bsnams pa yis: lus ngag bsregs mnan bskrad pa bzlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi tha mas sbrul zhags bsnams pa yis: klu yi gtad khram ngan pa bzlog tu gsol:

g.yas kyi rdo rje sgro gshog brgyangs pa yis: ye shes khro bo'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs pa yis: 'jig rten khro bo'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: glang ko zhing lpags stag sham brjid pa yis: srid pa las kyi g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: thod phreng khrag zhag tshom bus brgyan pa yis: 'byung po dam sri'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: stag sham rus rgyan dug sbrul brgyan pa yis: pha rol mi kha dmod tshig bzlog tu gsol: me ri dmar nag klong na bzhugs pa yis: ngag mnan bskrad gzir gtad pa bzlog tu gsol: gsang ba'i khro mo sku la 'khril ba yis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog brdzes pa yis: gnyan rgod lhog yams dmar bshal bzlog tu gsol: kha) hūm̐: khram kha nag po gshin rje'i gdon: gzi byin stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: shwa kha thogs pa btsan gyi gdon: gtum pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: nad rkyal thogs pa ma mo'i gdon: rngam pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: bse rag chung sri 'gong po'i gdon: khro bo'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: smyo 'bog snying gzer rgyal bsen gdon: gshe ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: god sri 'thab 'khon yul gyi 'dre: sgeg pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: lo nyes sad ser 'byung 'khrug gdon: dpa' ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: dbang thang rgud dang g.yang kha nyams: rgod pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: dus 'khrugs mtshon cha'i dal 'bab rnams: mthu rtsal stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: shar gyi sgrol ging chen po yis: ma mo'i rims nad bzlog tu gsol: lho yi gtum ging chen po yis: sa bdag zha grum bzlog tu gsol: nub kyi khro ging chen po yis: lhog rgod dmar yams bzlog tu gsol:

byang gi las ging chen po yis: tre trai khrag skyugs bzlog tu gsol: yum chen ging mo mched bzhi yis: rims nad me lce bzlog tu gsol: sprul pa'i bya khyung sde lnga yis: klu srin 'byung po bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo mched bzhi yis: bdun drug rgya nad bzlog tu gsol: phag sdig khyung dang dug sbrul gyis: mdze nad bco brgyad bzlog tu gsol: sprul pa yang sprul dmag tshogs kyis: rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong zlog: nga) hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: gnyan lhog sbos 'gas nag po zlog: me dbal sha khol khrag skyugs zlog: tre tre gnyan rgod rgyug 'gyel zlog: mdze nad tshad gzer rims nad zlog: rgya nad rgyug gzer khong lhog zlog: srin glang tar+pa dug mda' zlog: 'go nad snying gzer khrag bshal zlog: 'brum bu dkar nag me dbal zlog: nad bdag choms la nad mkhar shig: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra trag sha ya rbad bh+yoḥ kha thun nag po nad bdag gi snying la rbad rbad: nad bdag a purtsi ma tha ma tha rbad rbad: ga ru ṭa pak+ṣiṃ nad bdag pho mo'i snying la rbad rbad: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: shig shig ha la ya rbad rbad thun mā ra ya nan nan: zhes zlog sngags rnams tshar gsum du bzla'o: de nas srung 'khor dang bzlog 'khor bsgom pa ni: hoḥ skad cig gis rang nyid dpal chen khrag 'thung khro rgyal: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi gyad kyis dor stabs brdzis pa: yum dbang phyug rdo rje gtum mo 'khyud cing bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: phyi rol rdo rje dang ral gri me dpung 'bar ba'i gur chen po: bskal pa'i rlung bgrod du med pa'i bar thams cad lcags sdig dang bya khyung sbrul nag dug gi phag rgod rnams kyis gtams pa: nang du khro bo rdo rje drag po dkar gsal rdo rje gri thod 'dzin pa dpag tu med pas srung ba'i sngags sgra sgrog cing tshe yi rig 'dzin can du gyur:

oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa: bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūm̐ dmar nag 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can de'i nang du bla ma snang ba mtha' yas zla tshes la thod phreng yab yum mgo sked la bdag srog nṛ yig ljang ku: ha khog tu bsrung bya pho thams cad g.yas: mo thams cad g.yon zhabs kyu'i nang du zhing khang nor rdzas rnams tshud de bsrung ba'i rang bzhin ni phyi rol sngags rnams rang sgra dang bcas nas 'khor bar gyur: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma he ru ka dz+nyā na ghṛ wa kro ti shwa rī ma ma nṛ bh+rūm̐: bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: badz+ra rak+ṣa swā hā: hoḥ mdun du brub khung gi steng 'og gnam lcags 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor bas byad ma rnams sha khrag dmar nyil nyil gtub pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur: khro bo'i gdan zangs lcags 'khor lor gyur pa'i bar thams cad dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha khrag gtubs te pho nya rnams kyis gsol: steng lcags kyi 'khor lor g.yas su 'khor: 'og zangs kyi 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba phyi rol zlog byed khro bo'i zlog sngags dang bsad sngags 'brug ltar sgrog par gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum dza rbad bh+yoḥ oṃ trig khroṃ bh+yoḥ mā ra ya du byad ma zlog: ces zlog sngags mang du bzlas: tha ma nyal tshe srung 'khor bsgoms: sa ma ya: de nas gser skyems gtong zhing sgo dbye ba ni: dar nag gzengs shing rol mo drag tu rdung : lha srin thams cad dgra bo'i yul dmag la chas par bsam: dang po phyi yi gser skyems ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams na: bzhugs pa'i grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang : zhi khro'i lha tshogs srung ma thugs dam can: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi la: gnas pa'i rgyal chen phyogs skyong bcu:

gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor lam phyes: gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la 'phen: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa dang : gzhi bdag dben ri skyong ba yi: mthu ldan srung ma thams cad kyis: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor lam phyes: gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la 'phen: hūm̐: lo zla zhag dus dbang ba yi: gdong la gnas pa'i sa bdag dang : gza' skar 'gyu ba thams cad kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor lam phyes: zor gyi dbal kha 'phog srid kyis: dbu chum zhabs bskum g.yas g.yon byol: bdag ni ma nyes dgra bo nyes: nyes can dam nyams dgra bo la: 'phen pa zor gyi sna drongs shig: de nas nang du phyogs bzhir mchod la sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: shar lho sgo ma sdig gdong mas: lcags kyus mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang shar sgo phyes: bzhengs bskul dmag gi dpung skyed cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma chu srin gdong : zhags pas mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang lho sgo phyes: bzhengs bskul dmag gi dpung skyed cig: hūm̐: nub phyogs sgo ma phag gdong mas: lcags sgrog gis mtshan lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang byang sgo phyes: bzhengs bskul dmag gi dpung skyed cig: hūm̐: byang phyogs sgo ma khyung gdong mas: dril bus mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang byang sgo phyes: bzhengs bskul dmag gi dpung skyed cig: hūm̐: bzhengs shig khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: de ring drag po'i phrin las mdzod: nad dal mtshon gyi bskal pa choms: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems gtong zhing sgo phye: de nas gong gi dmag bskul btang yang chog:

de nas liṅgar dgra bgegs 'gugs zor 'phen pa ni: dang po phyi yi gser skyems de tshar gcig btang yang rung : de nas zor 'phen pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khrag 'thung sku: nga ni snang srid kun gyi gtso: nga ni 'jigs byed kun gyi rje: nga ni mkha' 'gro kun gyi yab: nga ni snang srid kun gyi gnyan: steng na khros shing chas pa'i tshe: stong khams me 'od 'u ru ru: nyi zla gza' skar cha la la: drag sngags 'brug sgra di ri ri: gnam lcags thog ser sha ra ra: pho rgyud chos skyong las la 'gyed: mo rgyud ma mo dbang du sdud: sde brgyad dregs pa gum gum chums: de nas ging bzhi'i zor thogs nas: hūm̐: khrag 'thung thugs las sprul pa'i sras: sgrol ba'i gri thogs yab yum bzhi: rbad cing pho nyar mngag pa'i tshe: shan pa srog la rngam pa bzhin: dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol la shog: mi rta nang tshan dkrugs la shog: nam gyi phar ma tshur phyed la: dgra bo'i bla srog chod la shog: snying khrag dron mo 'thung bar gyis: hūm̐: gtor zor drag po sha ra ra: mtshon cha'i bu yug chi li li: dug mda' nad rlangs thibs se thib: 'phen no drag po'i zor 'phen no: drongs shig zor sna dgra la drongs: zor 'phang tshur la ma ldog cig: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: badz+ra kro ta ging ka ra kro ti ni tsa tur rag+mo mu kha li bh+yoḥ rbad thun trig myog yaṃ gtor raṃ chod: ṭa ṭa dā ha ya: ma tha mā ra ya: ru tra nṛ tri myog thum rbad rbad: de nas gdong mo bzhi yi zor thogs la: hūm̐: sha za srin mo zangs mche can: khrag gi ral pa sha ra ra: g.yang gzhi rak+ta 'du ru ru: me char tshwa tshwa si li li: rbad do ma mo las la chos: srin mo 'bum gyis zor sna drongs: brnag pa'i sangs rgyas bstan dgra sgrol: nad dal choms la nad bdag sgrol: 'byung po the'u rang rmang nas phyungs: dam sri 'dre mo'i snying khrag rol: gdug pa'i sa bdag klu srin chums:

sprul pa'i lcags sdig dgra la bh+yoḥ dug gi phag rgod dgra la bh+yoḥ dug sbrul nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ me yi bya khyung dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra mkhar dgra yul rmang nas shigs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo ma mo rak+sha kro ti mu kha li bring bring myur myur: ru tra a mu ka mā ra mā ra ma tha ma tha: bhan+dha bhan+dha myog thum rbad dril zlog zlog: de nas khyung gi zor thogs nas: hūm̐: srid pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ me gshog brdeb cing nad dal 'joms: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder can: khroṃ khroṃ nad bdag snying la khroṃ: chum chum klu gnyan snying rtsa chums: myog myog sa bdag srog rtsa myog: 'gas 'gas nad bdag snying rtsa 'gas: thum thum rgyal bsen dam sri thums: rbad rbad lhog yam snying la rbad: phyungs phyungs nad bdag rmang nas phyungs: chod chod myog thum trig sha bh+yoḥ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa hūm̐ kro ta ya gardza ya trig khroṃ ya gri khroṃ ya nad bdag gdug pa'i srog la rbad rbad: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces 'phang de nas gtor chen btegs la: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: rig 'dzin o rgyan chen po yab yum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgyal sras drang srong bden tshig 'grub pa rnams kyi dgongs su gsol lo: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra: snga dgra yid la sems pa: da dgra thad du langs pa: gdong nas rlung ltar 'tshub pa: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: dben gnas chos 'khor bcom pa: dmag jag dgra sna ston pa: nad bdag yams bdag 'byung po bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba: ngos bstod lkog nas smad pa: bka' dang dam la 'gal ba: bzhag pa'i bran g.yog khrel med: rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: dam nyams slob ma ngo log: bstan pa'i ru tra 'byung po: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo dam nyams pa 'di: lo dang zla bar ma bzhag:
zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang bar: bka' yi gtor ma drag po 'di dang mnyam du bzhes shig: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: mā ra ya thun bh+yoḥ rbad kha la dun tse dgra bo dam nyams mā ra ya rbad rbad:

ces gtor chen rdzongs shing dar nag g.yab bzlog pa bya: de nas rta bro las byang ltar brdung te: dmag dpon khyung nag bzhag: hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ 'byung po phyi 'brang khyod la gtad: bskal pa stong du ma shor rgya: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa bh+yo bh+yoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ tsakra ya thun thun nan: de nas nang du log la tshe 'gugs bya zh-ing dngos grub len chog bkra shis brjod: sa ma ya: e ma: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang bzlog me yi spu gri bzhag: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: rims yams gnyan nad tre tre hoḥ rgya nad bdun drug khong lhog dang : bcos lta ma mchis nad rigs dar: de dag bzlog pa'i gdams pa nyid: yang gsang spu gri'i 'khor lo can: gu ru bdag gi thugs bcud de: spel bar 'phang nas gter du sbas: zab rgya gdams pa bzhi yi skor: gzhan las ma grags khyad par 'phags: ma 'ongs nyi shu la nye dus: pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: dur khrod tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: las kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro dang : dge bsnyen bzhi yis rgya 'di srungs: ma yengs bya ra lhang lhang tshugs: bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: dam rgya: kho bo o rgyan gter bdag gling pas me sprel lo 'bri gung ti sgro'i tshogs khang nas gsang gter du bgyis te/ lo drug gsang rgya bsdams nas glang lor pad+ma sbas tshal nas nam mkha' 'brug grags su sangs rgyas lhums zhugs kyi bod zla gsum pa'i tshes bzhi la shog ser nas zhal bshus pa nyin cig 'grub bo/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: go cha'i lha bzlog dgra bgegs dpung 'joms bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bzlog pa'i phrin las le'u byung ba: go cha'i lha bzlog bya ba ni: ka) hūm̐: dbang drag me phreng khro rgyal yab yum gyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rab 'byams dpal: thugs rjes rmad byung dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams:

thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo drag rtsal gyi: 'og min dbyings rig zang thal 'od lnga'i klong : snang mtha' bde gshegs zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: dug lnga bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: ma rig gnyis snang bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: dung khang gnam lcags 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen yab yum sras dang 'khor: lnga bcu rtsa dgu 'jigs byed sku yi lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: longs spyod zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas nas: dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum sras dang 'khor: dgu bcu rtsa drug drag sngags gsung gi lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: 'gyur med zab gsang rdo rje'i gzhal yas nas: rdo rje gtum po yab yum sras dang 'khor: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad yang dag thugs kyi lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: sprul pa chos 'byung ye shes gzhal yas nas: thugs dam khros ma sde lnga rigs dang 'khor: bdun cu rtsa gnyis rbod gtong ma mo'i lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: drag rtsal me rlung 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas: yak+sha me dbal che btsan drag po'i 'khor: sde dpon sum cu 'jig rten mchod bstod lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: las bzhi lhun grub 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas: stobs ldan drag rtsal sras mchog rigs bzhi'i dpal:

sngags bdag bco brgyad dmod pa'i drag sngags lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i gzhal yas nas: dbyings kyi bka' srung bswe yi lha mo bzhi: las kyi ma mo dge bsnyen sde bzhir bcas: dam tshig bzhin du ma g.yel las la ya: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces thugs dam bskul lo sa ma ya: de nas bzlog pa ni: hūm̐: che mchog drag po thugs dam yab yum gyis: zhing khams rgyan rdzogs dbyings kyi ye shes bcu: snang mtha' bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i nad gdon bzlog tu gsol: 'jigs byed 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyis: rgya nad rgyu gzer dal yams bzlog tu gsol: dbang chen rngam drag gsung gi lha tshogs kyis: btsan sri rta nad btsan thab bzlog tu gsol: yang dag gtum po thugs kyi lha tshogs kyis: smyo 'bog snying gzer rlung nad bzlog tu gsol: dregs byed khro bo rbod gtong lha tshogs kyis: mtshon 'khrugs nad dal dmar yams bzlog tu gsol: stobs ldan yak+sha dregs 'dul lha tshogs kyis: lha srin spyi g.yos chad pa bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yas me long badz+ra kī la ya: zhe sdang lha bu'i bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yon mnyam nyid rat+na kī la ya: nga rgyal phung po'i bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: zhabs g.yas sor rtogs pad+ma kī la ya: 'dod chags nyon mongs bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: zhabs g.yon bya grub karma ki' la ya: phrag dog 'chi bdag bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: ye shes las kyi sprul pa bye ba 'bum: sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sku sprul gshed chen bcu gnyis kyis: lus kyi bar chad dgra bgegs zlog:

gsung sprul khams brgyad me 'brug gis: ngag gi bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: thugs sprul dbang mo nyer brgyad kyis: yid kyi bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: yon tan sman mo nga brgyad kyis: rtsa rlung bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: phrin las sde dpon sum cu yis: thugs kyi bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: phur 'debs ma mo bcu gnyis kyis: sgrub pa'i bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: sngags bdag dmod pa bcu gnyis kyis: dngos su bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs zlog: ga) hūm̐ bh+yoḥ phyi khyams mu ran skyong ba yi: dpal gyi bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis: dbyings kyi ma mo 'khrugs pa zlog: 'jigs byed ging chen bco brgyad kyis: dug gsum 'khrugs pa'i bar chad zlog: 'bar ma gnod sbyin ma brgyad kyis: 'jig rten srid pa'i gdug rtsub zlog: sa bdag ma mo so gnyis kyis: dbang chen sde bzhi'i gnod 'tshe zlog: ma mo bdun dang bran mo bzhis: gza' klu 'khrugs pa'i bar chad zlog: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi yis: las mkhan rgyug log byed pa zlog: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i mas: mi nad phyugs nad dal yams zlog: bka' skyong bswe yi lha mo bzhis: log lta gshe skur byed pa zlog: gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi yis: zab chos spel ba'i sgab 'dre zlog: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: 'dul bya'i phrin las 'gags pa zlog: srid pa'i lha gnyan che dgu yis: rtswa 'bu sad ser than chen zlog: yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad kyis: mi kha phung sbyor gros ngan zlog: mgon bstan srung ma thams cad kyis: chag che nyam nga ma lus zlog: ces zlog mtshams so sor gdab bo: las 'phro skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lo 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor sbas yul bdud 'dul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las dag par phab pa'o/

sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: yang bzlog spu gri dmar po bzhugs so: thod phreng khro rgyal stobs 'dus dpal la 'dud: sa ma ya: dbang rdzogs dam ldan bsgrub par brtson pa la: ban dgra glang snying zhe sdang can dag gis: gtad khram rbod zor rlung 'khor hom chog dang : phung sel log ngan sbyor ba brtsams pa kun: rang la mi tshugs gshed du dbab pa'i dus: rab ni stong nyid lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan: mtshan ma'i rdzas sngags drag po pho nya sogs: chos nyid klong du 'ub chud ris mi snyoms: skye 'gro nam mkha'i 'gro ba a thang chad: phur thogs stong dang 'gras kyang gnod mi thub: 'bring ni yi dam bsnyen pa bskyed rim thob: mi shigs rdo rje'i mkhar nang tshud dang mtshungs: tha ma nyon mongs rnam rtog dbang gyur pa: rdzas sngags 'khor lo ting 'dzin zung du 'jug: dbang dang byin rlabs gzhan rkyen yul la bstan: rbod gtong me 'dra zlog pa chu 'dra bas: yang bzlog spu gri 'khor lo 'di kho na: de la bdag nyid khro rgyal stobs 'dus sku: drag po rigs lnga go cha'i lha rnams rdzogs: sku che yan lag rags shing stong khams gang : ri rab ltar brjid che btsan 'gran zla bral: lha srin sde brgyad 'joms byed tsha ngar can: me dpung klong bzhugs ha hūm̐ phaṭ sgra sgrog: snang srid thams cad yom yom shig shig 'gul: lha srin sde brgyad pho nya dregs pa can: las kyis rbad pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams: rang la gnod byed 'byung po thams cad kun: sngangs 'dar yed yed mig ni hrig hrig 'dug: dbal zil ma bzod srog snying lhud lhud phyung : dpal chen thugs srog hūm̐ gi dbyings su bsdu: gcer bu byang thang lhag pas gdung ba ltar: srog bral 'dar yed ci bgyis bka' nyan cing : ban dgra'i lha srung rang gshed bzlog par dmigs: drag sngags sham bu spu gri'i sngags 'di gdags: bh+yo mā ra ya rbad: hūm̐ ban+de sha ya myog:

mya lo sha ya rbad: ti lo sha ya rbad: ni lo sha ya rbad: ban+de brag tshal pa srog rtsa chod: snying rtsa chod: rtsad nas chod: drungs nas phyungs: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la: rbod gtong phur kha'i gnod pa thams cad dam nyams dgra la a mu ka phyes: phye mar phur ya dzaḥ shing tring mā ra ya rbad: phyi dro dgong kha dmar thag char: brgya stong bzlas shing drag tu gcun: phas kyi rbod gtong ma mgon sogs: che rgyud dregs pa'i rtsub 'gyur lan: ma ma kro ta tsit+ta bai: kā la kā li rū pa oṃ: gsal brtan thugs rjes stobs ldan pa'i: hūm̐ gis rasmis gang yin de: mdun du bos la mchod cing bstod: dgyes tshul tsit+ta a bhe ṣa: drag po hūm̐ gi sgra chen sgrog: badz+ra pā ṇi he ru kaḥ 'bar ba drag po'i 'od zer ni: tsha ngar lci 'thas ka gdung tsam: grangs med 'phros pa rbod gtong mnan: rlung dkyil thug par rab tu gzir: slar la byad ma'i gshed du 'phang : khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas nas kyang : dmigs bya rdul du brlag par bya: thun bar bden stobs thal rdeb bya: na mo: bla ma sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen: chag chen nyam nga rmi ltas rtsub: rbod gtong rbad 'dre zor thun hom: byad phur gtad khram phung sel ngan: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang : stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs: sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi: bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: nṛ tri sha truṃ hur thum dzaḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭḥ lag g.yas gnam la lag g.yon sa: ri rab 'jigs nus stobs dang ldan: nyi zla me chu 'phrod pa'i bar: dgra bgegs rdul phran brlags par dmigs: bden stobs thal rdeb lan gsum dang :

drang srong lok+t+ri'i dmod pa brjod: rjes ni stong nyid ngang la bzhag: 'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis: drang srong dmod pa la dbang ba'i: mthu mkhan stong dang 'gras gyur kyang : dbyings nyid thugs rje rab 'bar ba: nam mkha' 'dra ste tshugs mi srid: slar yang kho rang gshed du 'bebs: byad ma rtsad phung brlag par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang pad+ma yis: he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du: slob dpon rom+bu gu h+ya la: drag sngags mthar thug yang bzlog zhus: bdag gis bod du gnang ba byas: phyi rabs don du gter du sbas: las can thugs kyi sras dang sprod: snying gi bu min gzhan la gsang : 'chal na rang gi gshed du 'ong : mtshon gyi sgro ba kha bsdams la: shin tu 'tsho shes snying la zhog: las kyi ma mo'i bka' 'di srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lo 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas gdan drangs shing*/ chu glang lor sbas yul bdud 'dul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po'i gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi'i gtor 'bul bzhugs so: pad+ma drag po khro bor 'dud: gter srung sde bzhi'i mchod thabs ni: bswe phor zangs snod gang rung du: dpal gtor bzhi bshams dkar dmar brgyan: skyems phud mchod pa ci 'byor bshams: yid gsal bdag bskyed 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gro lod sku: gtum rngam rdo rje phur pa bsnams: stag steng brjid cing dpa' ba'i sku: sprul 'khor ye shes drag po bsgom: mdun du khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i dbus: lha klu bdud btsan sha za rnams: mngon rtogs rtag ltar myur du gsal: hūm̐: lha btsan dmag dpon myur mgyogs can: sku mdog dmar smug zhi ba'i chas: dar thod dkar zhing sku mdog dkar:

zhags dkar 'dzin zhing rta dkar zhon: sprul pa mi dkar bye ba 'bum: yang sprul gcan spyang dkar po 'gyed: hūm̐: mi bdud 'byams pa khrag mdog nag: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dgra satwa dang : spu gri ru mtshon nag po g.yab: rta nag bzhon cing mi nag 'gyed: yang sprul dom nag grangs med ston: hūm̐: btsan rgod a bswe mi dmar ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis srog bdag gzugs: btsan dar spu gri zhags pa dang : mche gtsigs dgra bo'i glo snying rol: rta dmar bzhon cing mi dmar 'gyed: yang sprul zangs 'phar lhang lhang zug: hūm̐: klu bdud nā ga kha thun ni: mthing nag mun pa'i tsha ngar can: phyag gnyis sbrul zhags sdig pa dang : chu srin rgyal mtshan dug zor 'dzin: rta sngon bzhon cing mi sngon 'gyed: yang sprul dug sbrul sa gzhi khengs: shan pa gnod sbyin sde bzhi'i tshogs: sngon tshe gzho stod ti sgro ru: ban bon rgyud bsrung khas blangs bzhin: dmar gyi gtor ma sha khrag dang : mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bskul rbad bka' bcol bzhin: zab gsang bstan pa rgyas pa dang : rgyu sbyor bar chod rkyen sel ba: lo nyes sad ser zhi ba dang : 'byor drug bstan pa rgyas pa dang : phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: bka' yi tha tshig gnad nas bskul: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnams: ma thogs myur du 'grub par mdzod: oṃ bswo a tri kha thun na tri sha ru tri nā ga ṇa gur dza dzaḥ i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

zhes gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: rgyun mchod chos skyong sgrub thabs 'di: phrin las nam mkha'i glog las myur: ban bon gnyis kyi srung ma'i phyir: gro lod pho brang brag la sbas: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter srung gis dngos su gzugs bstan nas bskul phyir/ 7karma las 'brel gling pas bris pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gter srung las kyi ma mo'i mchod thabs bzhugs so/ n-isbyaṃ rgya nam̐: gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: las kyi ma mo'i mchod thabs ni: rin chen snod mchog gang rung du: bshos bu zur gsum smad zlum la: bshos bu bzhi dang sman leb dang : bum pa bcas la dkar dmar brgyan: gser skyems dang bcas bshams par bya: rol mo'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung rig pa'i dbyings klong dbus: dur khrod tshogs khang ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas: ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: zab gsang ye shes dgyes pas gnas 'dir bzhugs: dam rdzas mchod gtor gser skyems gnyan po bzhes: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: ma yengs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: bh+yoḥ ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs ya la la: sku la dar dkar go zu gsol: rin chen thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan pu ru ru: phyag g.yas sna tshogs mda' dar 'dzin: g.yon pas 'phrul gyi me long bsnams: rat+na mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phyang ldan: klu yi chu rta sngon po chibs: sga srab dar stan khrigs se khrig: rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i shugs 'chang ma: gsang ba gter gyi grogs mdzad ma: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ma: las bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grog:

ka cha dkor nor gnyer du gtad: dus drug srung zhing phyi la 'brongs : zab chos bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: sngon tshe gu ru'i bka' bzhin du: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ gu h+ya ḍāk+ki yo gi ni ma mo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan gter bdag gling pas 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: mkha' 'gro'i gtor 'bul bzhugs so: thun mtshams mkha' 'gro'i gtor 'bul ni: bhan+dha'i nang du 'bru zan gyi: gtor ma rdo rje pad+mas mtshan: kyu gu ril bu dkar dmar brgyan: sha mar khu ba sgog btsong spod: shing 'bras zas sna chang gi lums: bdud rtsi sman dang rak+tas bran: me rlung bzhu btul bdud rtsir brlabs: thod rnga 'bir zhing dbyangs dang bcas: hūm̐: ma skyes rdzogs pa chos dbyings las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i sku: ma gcig dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro bzhengs: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: kun kyang ljang 'od rlung shugs can: rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo: sna tshogs cod pan pu ru ru: rgyan drug dril g.yer si li li: rol mo glu dbyangs di ri ri: snang srid 'gul ldeg khyams se khyam: 'od dang zer du spungs se spung: dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs lhags se lhag: bde ba'i chu rgyun na ra ra: 'du 'bral med par dungs se dung: ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs: dam rdzas rmad byung a mṛ ta: 'dod yon longs spyod gter chen po: 'khor ba rgyu bsgral rak+ta dang: tshogs kyi 'dod yon dpag med pa: ro bcud mdangs ldan zad mi shes: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'byung ba bzhi yi bcud dang zhag: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: snang srid sha khrag drod dbugs mdangs:

bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du sdus: dbyer med nyams rtogs rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: log rtog bdud rigs snang ba sgyur: snang srid chos la 'god par mdzod: nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sol: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes ḍāk+ki phrin las kyi rtsa ba tshogs gtor yin pas: sgrub la las sbyor gyi skabs su: dus drug gi thun bzhir ma chag par nan tan du bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bka' srung bswe yi lha mo'i bskul byang dug gi spu gri bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bka' srung bswe yi lha mo bzhi'i: bskul byang dug gi spu gri bstan: bswe phor nang du 'bru can gyis: gtor ma gtso 'khor bcu drug la: bsad pa'i sha khrag liṅgas brgyan: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung por dmigs: gsur chen sbyar zhing bshugs pa gtser: dbang drag 'bar ba'i nga rgyal gyis: ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul du: bskul zhing las la bsngags pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na: nyi ma lho nub mtshams shed na: me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas: bswe yi sku mkhar gru bzhi nas: srin po pho mo'i gdan steng na: sa bdag bswe yi lha mo bzhi: gcig dang 'dra ba'i mched bzhi bzhugs: gcig ni bswe yi rna cha can: bswe yi thul pa skya bo gsol: gcig ni byi ru'i gdong ral can: khrag gi ral ka sku la gsol: gcig ni rma bya'i thul pa lhub: zangs kyi rna cha khro lo lo: gcig ni bswe yi dngul chung can: dung gi rna cha khro lo lo: kun kyang mi lpags thul chung gsol: ral pa me 'bar skar 'khrugs ma:

khrag gi lce ring so sgrogs ma: bswe yi phur pa si li li: zangs kyi mdung dmar chem se chem: a bhi ra tsa mthu mo che: mthu chen mos pas so sor bzhag: gcig ni bal yul mthing du bzhugs: rdo rje ya byin 'phrul mo che: gcig ni tsha ba rong na bzhugs: rdo rje de byin dbang mo che: gcig ni rma bya'i seb na bzhugs: rdo rje bswe byin rdzu 'phrul can: gcig ni snye nam 'gram na bzhugs: rdo rje phag byin mthu mo che: kun kyang las la mnga' mdzad ma: thugs rje mi bzad sku sprul pas: dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du brlag: dbang drag 'bar ba'i bka' bzhin du: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sdang ba'i dgra la mthu ma chung : brnag pa'i las la rtsal ma zhan: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'di: snying nas drongs la spyi la chom: rnam shes kun rig khrid la shog: dbang du sdus shig lha mo'i tshogs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bstan pa gnyan po srung du gsol: bh+yoḥ bdud yul bstan pa smug nag la: nag mo bam log bu mo ni: lcags kyi mon mo spyi ring ma: mig nas gser gyi nyi zla 'gyu: mthing gi ral pa sha ra ra: gser gyi zor ba zhags pa bsnams: bdud rta nag po zhags pas brgyan: 'khor du 'chi bdag nag mos bskor: gza' yol rdul phran steng shed nas: gza' chen spen pa'i bu mo ni: bswe yi mon mo spyi ring ma: mig nas bswe yi nyi zla 'gyu: mun nag ral pa sha ra ra: bswe yi lcags kyu drwa ba thogs: gza' rta zhur po zhags pas brgyan: gza' bdud nag po stong gis bskor: btsan yul nag po klong srid nas: skyes bu long btsan bu mo ni: zangs kyi mon mo spyi ring ma: mig nas zangs kyi nyi zla 'gyu: dmar nag ral pa sha ra ra: zangs kyi lcags kyu mdung dmar bsnams: btsan rta dmar po zhags pas brgyan: 'chi bdag btsan dmar stong gis bskor: pho brang chu mtsho klu yul ni: chu srin rgyal po'i bu mo ni:

g.yu yi mon mo spyi ring ma: mig nas g.yu yi nyi zla 'gyu: mthing gi ral pa sha ra ra: phyag gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa thogs: klu rta sngon po sbrul gyis brgyan: chu bdud sngon po stong gis bskor: kun kyang dbang gi bswe khrab gsol: rngam pa'i bshugs glu tsi ri ri: stong gsum dmigs pa yud kyis bskor: myur mgyogs srog gzan mon mo bzhi: sa bdag bswe mo'i bka' nyan ma: 'dir byon sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la ya: myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yoḥ shar gyi brag rim stong gi bdag: mon mo'i lus la spre'us mgo: sku la g.yag thul sngon po gsaul: lcags kyi sder mo me ltar 'bar: reg pa tsam gyis dbugs 'phrog ma: lho yi char 'gram ngar gyi bdag: mon mo'i lus la sbrul gyi mgo: rma bya'i mdangs kyi stong thul can: dug lce nag po phyar nas ni: dbang po'i dwangs ma mig 'bru ma: nub kyi brag srin 'od chen bdag: mon mo'i lus la sbal pa'i mgo: dred thul nag po snyan rtses bskor: kha nas 'brum bu'i khrag gtor ma: zhe sdang drag po'i mche sder gyis: su dang 'phrad kyang srog gcod ma: byang gi thang brag dug rtse'i bdag: mon mo'i lus la 'ug pa'i mgo: zhing lpags rlon pa'i stong thul can: bshugs glu len cing brla rkun ma: sder mo ral gri rno ba'i so: dam nyams dgra bo'i srog gcod ma: kun kyang gsang mtshan 'dre sde ma: sa bdag chen po'i las mkhan te: myur mgyogs mthu chen bdud mo bzhi: 'dir byon sha khrag dmar gyis mchod: sngon gyis tha tshig ma g.yel bar: dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la ya: mngag pa'i las la bang ma bul: rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dbang drag 'bar ba'i bka' nyan ma: tsha ba'i ma mo bcu gnyis po: dam rdzas sman raka gtor mas mchod: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs:

bstan pa bshig pa'i dam nyams 'di: bsgral ba'i las la rtsal ma zhan: snying khrag 'thung la hab ma chung : srog dbugs sdud la rngam ma zhan: srog gcod dbugs longs 'dus byas shigs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ khyod kyi ming po las mkhan ni: bswe yi skyes bu mched sde bzhi: shar phyogs srid pa'i yul rtse nas: srin po'i tshogs kyi rgyal po ni: bswe yi gyad chen 'jigs su rung : chibs su bswe yi gyi ling chibs: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: khyod kyi bshan pa lag ring ni: bswe yi mi mo gdong bzhi pa: lag na mdung dmar chems se chem: skya rengs dmar po'i la ru phyin: de tsam dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla mdangs bcad pa'i dus la bab: snying rtsa dmar po rtsad nas chod: bh+yoḥ lho phyogs mun pa'i smag rum nas: gshin po'i rgyal po mthing 'dab can: gshin rje chos rgyal stag gi mgo: chibs su bswe yi khyung chen chibs: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: khyod kyi bshan pa lag ring ni: mon pa lag ring chen po bzhi: phyag na lcags kyi tho chen thogs: zhags pa nag po klad la bskor: mon pa nam gyi phyed la rgyugs: de tsam dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla mkhar bshig pa'i dus la bab: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: bh+yoḥ nub phyogs dregs pa'i yul rtse nas: ya bdud tshom gyi rgyal po ni: bswe yi sog po gdong ring rngam: chibs su bswe yi bya glag chibs: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: khyod kyi bshan pa lag ring ni: bswe yi bya khra chen po bzhi: g.yu yi gshog pas stong khams khengs: gshog rtsal dgra bo'i sgra la shal: mchu bim dgra bo'i brla la 'bug: sder mo dgra bo'i snying la shad: grib so nag po'i rta ru zhon: bla mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: bsad rtags don snying mngon du phyungs:

bh+yoḥ byang phyogs dregs pa'i yul rtse nas: gnod sbyin tshogs kyi rgyal po ni: bswe yi sog po mi ring ste: ral pa dmar po ha ri'i mig: chibs su bswe g.yag kham pa chibs: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: khyod kyi bshan pa lag ring ni: bswe yi spyang mo mche ba gtsigs: nyi ma zla ba'i zer la zhon: nyams pa'i snying khrag hub kyis 'thung : bla tshe srog dbugs bstan dang phrol: bh+yoḥ bswe yi skyes bu mched sde bzhi: kun kyang sha khrag srog la rngam: bswe mkhar smug po'i nang nas bzhengs: bswe khrab dmar po si li li: tshems khrab 'bar ba'i gdong dmigs nas: bswe yi mdung thung sha ra ra: zhabs la bswe lham long khrab gsol: mche ba spu gri gtams pa 'dra: spu gri shad shad snying la shad: phyag na bswe yi mdung thung bsnams: bswe yi khrab phur chi li li: gzhu mo'i rgyud las spel ba'i mda': dgra bo'i snying la gzer chen phob: khong nas mtshon gyi gzhu mdung ma: kha nas bswe mda' dmar po 'phen: khrag mda' khrag phur char ltar phob: dgra bo'i khong du dug mda' g.yos: dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed du gshegs: nyams pa'i srog la mā ra ya: bla ma la smad sngags la gshe: rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dgra: pho rgyud mo rgyud bu rgyud bcas: bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog: lo dang zla bar bzhag thabs med: bsad rtags don snying da lta longs: dus la bab po sa ma ya: gal te las 'di ma bsgrub na: rang gi 'bras bu brlag par 'gyur: khyod la mthu yod rdzun du thal: re ba'i bsam pa gting nas bcad: de bas nus rtsal mngon phyungs la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: shu la da ri dza dza ni: yo gi shwa rī ni: badz+ra tsit+ta pū tri ya ba ni mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces bskul mngon rtogs rtags dang bcas: stong gsum dmag gis 'ur gyis bkang : dgra bo'i bla srog rtsad nas bcad: yul zhing gnas brten dang bcas pa:

ming tsam med par rdul du brlag: dregs pa dam las mi 'da' ba'i: dpa' gtum drag po'i zer gyis gnon: kun kyang rang rig sems las byung : chos nyid rol pa'i dpal du blta: de yis 'khu ldog mnga' mi nus: las rnams thogs pa med par 'grub: gnad kyi snying dril man ngag 'di: bstan pa srung ba'i mtshon char bzhag: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las dag par zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gtum mo'i don khrid rlung sems rang grol bzhugs so: zag med bde chen he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: gsang sngags snying po gu ru'i thugs sgrub las: gsang dbang don khrid steng sgo'i chos drug bstan: gtum mo sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal dang : grong 'jug 'pho ba rnam grol mchog gi lam: skal ldan tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs: gu ru'i gsungs bzhin mtsho rgyal bdag gis 'god: gab 'khrugs sbas dang bcings pa 'di la med: dmar khrid zhun tig kun gyi nying khu 'di: las can shes rab ldan dang 'phrad par shog: bka' rgya bswe yi lha mo mched bzhir bcol: sa ma ya: nang gi rtsa rlung thig le 'dag pa'i phyir: las rlung sbyong zhing dbu ma'i mdud 'khrol ni: 'bar 'dzag bde stong lhan skyes ye shes kyis: 'khrul snang zad nas longs sku'i nyams rtsal rdzogs: rtsa gegs mdud grol rlung gegs 'gro 'ong chad: thig le 'dzag med 'ching ste rnam kun mchog: dgos 'byin gzhan lus pho mo'i rlung bsres pas: bde stong nyams 'bar ye shes stobs rtsal rdzogs: nyams rtogs rtsal 'bar phyogs med mkhyen pa rgyas: nga nyid longs skur sgrub pa'i gdams pa yin: jo mo mtsho rgyal ma yi snying la 'phur: bde chen nang sgrub le'u gnyis pa'o:

de la gtum mo'i me khrid ni: dben par mthun rkyen yo byad bsags: khrus dang bsku mnye stobs bskyed sogs: che ba rgyal po lta bu'i chos: yin phyir bza' btung longs spyod sogs: thig le rgyas pa'i sman sbyor 'bad: rtsa ba srog rtsol gtum mo ni: srog ces g.yas g.yon las kyi rlung : rtsol ba'i gnad kyi lam bkag ste: ye shes rlung 'gyur dbu mar gzhug: de la bde ba'i 'bebs gdan steng : nam mkha'i rlung ni dbu ma ru: 'jug phyir lus kyi cha bsrangs te: chu yi rlung la lce rkan sbyar: me rlung mgrin pa cung zad dgug: rlung gi rlung la tsog pu ru: sgom thag bcing ba nywa bzhi bsgrim: sa rlung pus mo 'dzings 'khyud bsdam: ye shes rlung la rkang pa bsnol: dug gsum rlung ro phyin phyin 'bud: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rlung lnga bsnol ba'i dal: nyi zla pad+ma g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : ye shes mkha' 'gro ljang 'od mdangs ldan ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar stabs 'gying tshul ldan: zhal 'dzum mdzes shing rat+nas dbu la brgyan: thor tshugs dar dpyangs zar bus sku rgyab khebs: rus pa'i rgyan 'phyangs nu ma bha ga rgyas: phyag g.yas rlung zhags g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen se mo do: gcer mo 'gying stabs bde stong lhang nger gsal: de nas bde stong 'bar 'dzag la: sku dbus zung 'jug dbu ma ni: yar mar sne mo spyi gsang thug: g.yas su thabs kyi ro ma dang : g.yon du shes rab rkyang ma ni: yar sne sna bug gnyis su zug: mar sne lte 'og dbu mar 'brel: bud med ro rkyang g.yas g.yon ldog: gsang bar rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis: lte bar drug cu rtsa brgyad dang : snying khar brgyad dang mgrin pa ru: sum cu rtsa gnyis dpral ba la: bcu drug gtsug tor rtsa bzhi ste: gyes pa'i rtsa phran bsam mi khyab: ba spu'i grangs dang mnyam par gnas: byang sems rgyu ba'i mchog dngos 'grub: kun kyang mtshan nyid bzhi ldan pa:

rtsa srog dbu ma'i ngo bo nyid: rlung srog bum pa can du bsgom: rngub dang dgang gzhil bcag cing dkrugs: slar der rngub chung re re brtsegs: sgom tshe gang thub bskyil bas chog: g.yas 'bud g.yon rngub 'khor yug bslab: dang por rtsa rlung thig le'i zug: slong tshe sdug bsran snying rus bskyed: bar du zug yal bde la sdug: le lor mi btang bar med bsgom: tha ma bde drod stobs 'bar tshe: 'dod sred bdud kyi dbang mi btang: 'dzin 'dren khrems pa'i gnad la bslab: khams dang gnyid dang 'tsho ba bsten: ma gtogs rgyun chad med pa ru: zla drug lo gcig gnyis gsum bar: 'bad pa'i rtsa thig rlung dag grol: thig le'i srog ni sum mdor a: dpral bar haṃ yig dngul chu ltar: rlung gnad 'jam rlung ro rkyang rgyud: dbu mar 'bar zhing 'khor lo rnams: rim par mdud dkrol bde rgyun dbab: dkar dmar zhu bdes lus kun gtams: de ltar dkar dmar stobs rgyas pa'i: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas: me yi ḍāk+ki gar stabs 'khyugs: bde drod nyams 'bar me dpung mched: snod kyi 'jig rten me yi dal: bcud kyi sems can ḍāk+ki ma: sgra skad thams cad me dpung 'ur: tshig ni ha ri ni sa'i sgra: stong ra che ba nam mkha'i mtha': chung ba rta rnga tsam la bsdu: spro bsdu rig pa'i rang rtsal sbyang : a haṃ snyoms 'jug bde ba'i ngang : gnas skabs bdun gsum nyer gcig 'bad: rlung sems zin pas drod tshad rnyed: rang lus pad+ma ḍāk+ki ni: khro gtum rgyan rdzogs lcags sreg ltar: tsha ngar ldan pa zhag gsum bsgom: de nas lte 'og me yi dal: gru gsum a thung tsha rngam can: gnam lcags thog 'dra mtho gang bar: rtse gcig sems gtad zhag gsum bsgom:

༈ dang po rtsa rlung gsol 'debs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka dag rdor 'chang chos sku 'od mi 'gyur: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: longs sku'i rtsal snang ston pa rdo rje sems: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku 'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rtsa gsum gar dbang mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nus rtsal brtul zhugs sangs rgyas ye shes rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: las 'phro gter 'byin karma las 'brel gling : gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku rig 'dzin rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: grub brgya'i spyi mes thugs mchog rdo rje la/ gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rlung sems dbang thob dri med gling pa la/ gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

'gro 'dul kong smyon kra ti sngags 'chang la/ gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lung zin sgam po bzang po rdo rje la/ gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las dbang phyug la/ gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rten 'brel mnga' bsgyur zab rgya'i gter srung la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par by-in gyis rlobs: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: de nas a shad dmar la tsha: rim gyis tshwa tshwas snying kha'i man: de nas mgrin pa spyi bo dang : lus kyi nang khengs ba spu'i sgor: tshwa tshwa'i zhun ma rab tu khol: ye shes ḍāk+ki dmar nag gtum: me dpung 'ur 'ur bdud tshogs bsreg: phyi 'dzin nang 'dzin spel ma ru: brdab chung brgya dang brgyad du bya: mgo dang sked bskor dpung pa gcu: lag pa brkyang shad skum dang brdeg: ha ring ha thung 'bebs chung brdab: zhag bdun nam ni bcu bzhir 'bad: lus drod me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur: de nas 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lnga: mgo bo dgye sgu mjing pa shad: lag pa brkyang bskum bzhag sha brdab: ro stod drag skor g.yas g.yon bskor: sked pa g.yas g.yon 'khor lor bskor: rkang pa phra shad brkyang bskum bya:

drag 'bebs ha sprugs lhab lheb bya: de nas 'byung bzhi 'khrul 'khor ni: mda' 'gengs lag bsnol rkang bsnol 'bebs: gzhi 'phra mi khri sgril log bya: 'bebs shing rtsal sprug drag po bya: ka dag ngang du lhan ne bzhag: gnad kyi 'gag dam hūm̐ gis spyi bor 'dren: phyir 'dzin ngang nas phri lir khyab par bkram: seṅge rnam rol rba rlabs gnad dang thim: khrems rtags lus bde dub cing gsal stong 'char: gsang bar rlung sems zin pa dang : bde nyams kha zas sred pa dag: rlung log thig le 'dzag pa dang: 'dod chags mi bzod nad kun bskyed: lte bar zin na drod 'bar zhing : kha zas 'ju la lus stobs bskyed: log na pho ba'i nad kun bskyed: snying khar zin na shes rab dang : rtogs pa bskyed zhing rlung log la: smyo 'bog yid mi bde ba 'byung : mgrin par zin na ngag snyan zhing : rtsom mkhas tshig bcad mang po brdol: log na rims nad mang du 'byung : dpral bar zin na 'od gsal 'char: rims sogs tshad pa'i nad kun sel: log na grang nad tha dag bskyed: spyi bor slebs pas rtogs pa dang : nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams 'char te: snang ba thams cad gtad med grol: log na mgo bo na sogs 'byung : de nas 'bar 'dzag yas dbab kyis: dpral bar babs pas dga' ba bskyed: lha bu'i bdud bcom yul snang dag: mgrin par babs pas mchog dga' bskyed: nyon mongs bdud bcom zhen 'dzin dag: snying khar babs pas lhan skyes dga': phung po'i bdud bcom gnyis zhen dag: lte bar babs pas dga' bral myong: 'chi bdag bdud bcom gang la'ang: zhen pa med cing bde stong grol: de nas mas brtan dga' ba bzhi: gsang gnas phyir 'phros 'khor ba'i rgyu: nor bu dgra la shor dang mtshungs: lte bar ldog pas sprul skur thob: snying khar slebs pas longs skur thob: mgrin par slebs pas chos skur thob: dpral bar slebs pas ngo bo nyid: spyi bor slebs pas bde chen sku:

sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can: mngon par shes pas phyogs med 'char: rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston nus: rtsa gegs 'khor lo drug mdud grol: rlung gegs dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong chad: thig le zag pa med par 'gyur: las rlung zad nas sgom pa ni: nyin mtshan 'dres na rmi lam 'gag: rmongs pa ma yin bde stong gsal: 'phos tshe sku gsum zhing khams bgrod: rlung sems gang du gtad pa der: 'jug par nus shing rang dbang thob: sa ma ya: stong ra lus nang sgong lkog ltar: 'byung ba'i dug lnga pho smad na: 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lang long bsam: hūm̐ zhes rngub cing bskyil ba yis: spyi bor phyur phyur thon dmigs la: hūm̐ ring khong 'dren lcog tshad 'phang: yang yang 'bad pa'i dug slong ste: 'dar sprug stod gzer rmi lam 'khrugs: mgo sbrid nyams snang sna tshogs 'byung: dug phyin spyi bor rlangs sngo dmar: sgra 'od dang bcas thon par 'gyur: zhag bdun tsam na za zi 'phyo: dri med nyin phyed sum cha tsam: zan ni za yun tsam du 'byung: de rjes mgo yang dug thon pas: 'byung ba lnga yi yon tan 'char: sa yis ting 'dzin 'bral mi phod: chu yis mdog snum kha dog dwangs: me yis bde drod bkrag mdangs che: rlung gis shugs chen zo mdog bde: nam mkhas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i: snang ba rang sar grol bar 'gyur: ji ltar kha zas dug 'dres bzhin: zas bcud mi mngon nad ro bslang : nyon mongs dug dang bcas kyi bar: skyon dang yon tan 'dres mar 'char: dug bral kha zas sman 'gyur bzhin: dug phyin yon tan ci bzhin mngon: sa ma ya: rtsa rlung thig le la brten nas: ye shes bskyed phyir lus drang bas: rtsa drang rlung drang dbu mar tshud: thig le 'bar 'dzag rang bzhin gyur: bde ba 'char ba'i lus gnad bsrangs: lus lha'i stong ra sgong lkog ltar: bsgoms pa'i rtsa zug mi 'byung zhing: drag par 'bud cing dal bus rngub: dal bus btang bas rlung zug med:

lus dregs chu yi bkru bya zhing: zhun chen mar rnying bsku mnye bya: me dang lan tshwa bud med dang: ngal dub sngo rigs tshwa sgog spang: rta rgyug dung 'bud pang 'degs sogs: rtsa chad rngul thon las rnams spang: de yis thig ler zug mi 'byung: tsha ba'i nad la haṃ bsil dbab: grang ba'i nad la gtum mo sbar: spyir ni na sar stong nyid bsgom: sgyu lus sbyangs te rlung bzung zhing: rgyun du 'od gsal ngang la bzhag: gegs grol rkyen dag yon tan rdzogs: g.yas su rgyu ba las kyi rlung: g.yon du rgyu ba ye shes rlung: mnyam pa byang chub sems rlung ste: g.yon nas bzung zhing g.yas nas 'bud: dug lnga skyes tshe g.yas nas btang: dad mos bzang por g.yon nas rngub: bud med la ni go ldog go: 'od gsal ngang nas 'jam rlung ni: bar ma chad par rtag tu bsten: skyon dag yon tan shugs la rdzogs: myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: 'pho ba sku gsum klong grol bstanaḥ de la rab 'bring tha gsum las: rab ni chos sku brten med du: yid la ci yang mi bya bar: 'od gsal sgom pa'i ngang la bzhag: 'pho dang grol ba dus mnyam 'byung : 'bring ni longs sku'i zhing khams lnga: gang 'dod mdog gsal 'od zer gyi: thag pa mig g.yon nas zug par: brgyud de zhing khams der bgrod dmigs: gnyis su med pa'i bud+dha'o: tha mar sprul sku'i 'pho ba la: rtsal sbyong drang srong tsog pu'i ngang : sku dbus dbu ma rba lcag tsam: mar sna gsang bar sgong mthil ltar: rtse mor spyi bor gdengs kha che: gsang bar rlung gi yaṃ sngo skya: sny-ing khar g.yung drung dmar po'i steng : rnam shes hūm̐ mthing rno ngar ldan: spyi bor k+ṣaḥyig nag pos bkag: steng rlung kha nas ma shor bar: hūm̐ sgra'i tshul gyis sna nas bus: phyir 'dzin ngang du ci thub bzhag: ma thub gong bzhin yang yang bskyar: mig btsums spyi bor rtse gcig spar: yaṃ yig rlung gi shugs ldan pa'i:

g.yung drung 'khor zhing hūm̐ btegs te: k+ṣaḥyig yar la rgyangs rgyangs gyur: 'byong rtags spyi bo'i rtsa yang 'phar: tshangs bug 'phar dang chu ser rdol: khrag thon lus 'dar 'khyor 'gyel sogs: byung tshe 'phro bcad slad nas kyang: bco lnga nam byung tshar re spar: des ni nam dgos don 'grub 'gyur: thal na k+ṣaḥs bkag steng rlung mnan: 'og lhod yaṃ rlung zhi bar bsam: rlung bcos bya zh-ing rkang mthil rdung: nam zhig 'chi rtags tshang ba'i tshe: tshe 'di'i zhen chags rbad kyis bcad: rigs drug 'khor ba'i mngal sgo bkag: smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab: bar chad med par skad cig 'grub: rlung sems dbyer med drag tu bsdu: gang 'dod gnas su 'pho bar nus: hūm̐ yig bla ma'i thugs kar bstim: gnyis med mngon par byang chub grol: sa g.yo 'ja' zug nam mkha' dwangs: 'phos ma thag tu myang 'das kyi: sa zin sku gsum klong du grol: phyir dmigs 'dun blo spu tsam yang : skyes na 'grub pa ma yin no: gzhan la gdab na sgo dgu bkag: dmyal ba gshang lam yi dwags chu: dud 'gro kha dang mi yi sna: lha min rna ba lha yi mig: hūm̐ yig mthing nag re res bkag: gong ltar rtsa gsum thugs kar 'pho: je mtho je mthor dbyings su bstim: bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab: ngan song sgo khegs lam sna zin: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas gdams pa'o: sa ma ya: e maḥ zab gsang gnad kyi mar byang 'phreng : ma hā gu ru'i bka' lung bzhin: bud med mtsho rgyal bdag gis bkod: phyi rabs don du gter du sbas: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: dam rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las dag par phab pa'o// // 'di ga'i gter gzhung ma dpe go rim 'khrugs pa dang chad 'dzud mchan bu dkyus su shor ba sogs nor 'khrul mang bar 'dug pa dag tshig don la dpyad nas gtsang zhus byas khul lags kyang nor ba 'dug na mkhyen dpyod ldan pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol zhes sgo sprul gu h+yas so//

// ༄༅/ /bla ma pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gtor zlog 'don cha'i zin bris dbang po'i lde mig bzhugs/ drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /gsang chen me ri 'bar ba ru/ thugs rdo rjes dregs pa snying 'byin chen po sgrub pa'i tshe phyi nang 'jig rten lha 'dre ma rungs pa rnams kyis sku la thog phab pa sogs nyams tshad mang po byas/ slob dpon la ci yang ma nyes kyang yul thams cad du nad la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa mang po byung*/ de'i dus su mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyis lung nas slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas khro rgyal drag po me phreng bskul nas lha 'dre sogs dam la btags te srog snying phul nas/ drag po khrag 'thung du grags/ de yang ma 'ongs pa'i dus nad ngan dar ba'i dus su phan par dmigs nas/ bla ma drag po'i phrin las lnga brtsams khyad par gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi skor rnams mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger btab nas ma hā gu ru'i rab tu gnas par mdzad nas rgya rim pa gsum gyis bcad nas tshogs khang gi logs su sbas/ de rnams sngon byung gi rim pa'o/ de yang gu ru'i lung ltar gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi skye ba tha ma o rgyan gter bdag gling pas gzho stod gter sgro nas spyan drangs pa'o/ de yang deng sang gi skabs su rims nad tre tre ho zhes pa'i mi nad sna dgu dar ba'i dus su bla ma drag po'i phrin las shin tu zab pas/ sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams su len par bya ba rigs so/ bla ma drag po'i gtor zlog gi rim pa sbyor dngos rjes dang gzhung du 'jug pa las/ thog mar sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan dang*/ phrin las lnga sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs nas/ na mo: mdun gyi nam mkhar chos dbyings sogs nas/ sarba sid+dhi hrīḥswā hā: nas skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med

sogs nas skyabs su mchi: bar lan gsum/ hoḥ gdod nas dag pa sogs nas sems bskyed bar lan gsum 'don/ spyi ltar bgegs gtor/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yis: sogs kyi 'gugs zhugs lan gsum bya/ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: zhes bskrad/ srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: sogs nas mchod pa byin brlab bum pa dang rdzas sman rnams byin gyis brlabs/ brda sgo brda phyag dam bca' ni/ hūm̐: ma rig blang dor nas tsit+ta hūm̐ḥ bar sngon 'gro'o: dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod nas sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ bar 'don/ bla ma zhi ba'i las byang nas/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ zhes pa nas bstod pa'i mthar 'dzab bskul/ hūm̐: yang gsang dkyil 'khor nas srog la bab kyang mi btang ngo: bar rtsa sngags bzla/ bsnyen pa ci 'grub mthar/ nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i 'jigs brgyad kyi rgol ba thams cad zhi bar bsams la/ sham sbyar/ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wā shaṃ mā ra ya

nas rim bzhin skabs sbyar/ lhag chad bkang*/ 'dzab bstod bya/ deng sang skya rengs dang po shar: nas deng 'dir stsol: bar de nas drag po'i gzhung la 'jug pa/ hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ rgya gram: nas lha srin sde brgyad 'dul bar bskyed: bar 'don de nas go cha nang gi hūm̐: rang rig bla ma drag po rtsal: nas ma 'dres chu zla'i dbyibs ltar bsgom: bar 'don yang gzhung nas/ hūm̐: phyi rol gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad steng: nas gsal snang chu zla'i klong ltar bsgom: bar go cha'i sngags 'don/ oṃ a mi dhe wa hūm̐ hri da ya: sogs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gzhung nas de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas sogs spyan drang bar gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas : sogs dza dzaḥ bar go cha nas hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: sogs sarba pū dza hoḥ bar 'don gzhung gi bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dre rgod dang : nas phyag 'tshal pū ru sha ya hoḥ bar mchod pa hūm̐: phyi mchod gar sogs/ kha kha khā hi bar gsung go cha'i mchod pa la/ hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la sogs dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : bar bdud rtsi sman mchod sbyar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka ni skye ba med sogs sid+dhi hoḥ bar mchod/ hūm̐ dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i sogs nas skang bshags nas dngos grub stsol: bar yig brgya 'don/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma drag po he ru kaḥ sogs snang srid 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar 'don go cha'i bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje mi bskyod snang mthas sogs dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar 'daun gzhung gi hūm̐: khro chen mi bzad sogs nas las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bar 'don de nas zhi ba nas blang*/ hūm̐: yang gsang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: sogs nas srog la bab kyang mi btang ngo : zhes bar drag po'i rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ

las sngags artsig bsnyen mtshams go cha'i sgrub sngags/ oṃ a mi dhe wa hūm̐ nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bar bzlas/ de nas ging bzhi dang*/ khyung rigs lnga dang khro mo bzhi dang*/ phag sdig khyung gsum bcas rim bzhin bzlas/ de nas rtsa sngags las sngags sham bu sngags rgod rim bzhin sbyar/ oṃ she la du ging sogs srin mo 'dre rgod dam sri/ gdon spyi la bcas rtsa sngags las sngags sbyar dgos/ 'go nad dang rims yams la bsrung ba bya dgos na/ rgyas na nad 'joms par bu'i las byang bsnyen dmigs bcas rtsa sngags dang las sngags bzla/ sham bu sngags ring sbyar na do gal dang bstun/ rdzas ril bu gang dgos bsags nas phu btab bya'o/ de nas go cha'i hūm̐ sgrub 'don/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying bcas bya/ bsnyen bstod dang thun gtor 'bul/ deng sang skya rengs nas dngos grub zhu/ de mtshams rgyas pa nor lha/ dbang tshe sgrub/ yum bka' mkha' 'gro/ khyung sgrub bcas las byang rnams rim bzhin 'don la bsnyen pa bya/ ma bton kyang chog /yang na so so'i sgrub thabs gang dgos sgrub kyang chog 'dug /'di'i mtshams chos skyong gi gsol mchod bka' gter srung ma thams cad 'don pa thog mar gtor bsad byin rlob spyi ltar bya zhing*/ dbyings phyug drag mo nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs nas spyan drangs: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: sogs nas spyan 'dren dang bskang mchod bya/ bstod pa/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos sogs/ mchog gi dngos grub mchog stsol mdzod: bar 'don/ bh+yo kā li nag mo ma skyes sogs/ rtsal rdzogs shog: bar 'don/ bka' srung bswe yi lha mo'i bskul byang dug gi spu gri las/ hūm̐ bh+yo: phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na: sogs mā ra ya phaṭ: bar 'don/ gter srung ma mo'i mchod thabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ chos dbyings sogs nas i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bar btang*/ gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi la/

hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gro lod sku: sogs kha kha khā hi: bar 'don/ rgyas pa'i gtor 'bul dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor 'bul gzhung ltar gang 'os bya/ 'di'i mtshams bskang gsol chen mo spyi gzhung ltar dang*/ de nas mdun bskyed 'jug pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhe badz+ra āt+ma nas hūm̐ de steng ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ spel steng: gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra can: sogs nas las byang bdag bskyed ltar go cha nas bzung sngar ltar sbrags nas/ bsnyen mtshams bar bskyal/ bsnyen pa ci 'grub la 'bad nas bsnyen bstod dang thun gtor 'bul/ des nas tshogs la 'jug /dang po gtor bsngos kyi byin brlab bya/ tshogs byin brlab nas/ hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: sogs nas byin gyis brlab/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: sogs sa mā ya dza dzaḥ nas che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: zhes nas khā hi: bar tshogs mchod 'bul/ 'di mtshams gtor bsngos gsungs pa rang lugs kyi phyag bzhes yin/ de nas skong ba ni/ hūm̐ phyi nang spyan gzigs sogs dngos grub stsol: bar 'don skong ba rgyas pa la 'jug hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ sogs nas/ bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba 'don/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: ma rig rmongs pa'i sogs sa twa hūm̐: bshags pa rgyas pa ni/ ho: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yig brgya bzlas/ bshags pa 'bul/ tshogs tha ma lugs gcig la 'bul srol 'dug /rang lugs la gdab kha gnyis mi bya zhes mi 'bul 'dug /de nas bsad las rgyas par 'jug pa ni/ thog mar gzu dpang gser skyems bya na chog khrigs ltar/ gzhung ltar mnga' gsol bya/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung sogs nas gtor chung mtshams su 'bul/ gser skyems ni/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs gser skyems 'bul/ hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal pad+ma he ru kaḥ

sogs gsal bar bskyed/ hom bskyed/ 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya/ pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ lha dbye bdud sprad sras mchog phur bskyed bya nas bsgral ba bya/ bsad dmigs bya/ rnam shes spar/ thun rdzas sna tshogs 'debs/ ral gris gtubs zhal bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sogs khā hi: bar zhes phul/ de nas bzlog mdos rak+tas bran/ sha dum gtor chung ling ro bcas bsham/ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas sogs nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: bar 'don/ go cha'i lha bzlog dgra bgegs dpung 'joms nas/ hūm̐: dbang drag me phreng khro rgyal yab yum gyis: sogs nas phrin las mdzod/ bar bzlog gzhung nas/ hūm̐: ye shes las kyi dmag tshogs khrag 'thung pa: sogs dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: mtshams lha bzlog nas/ bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i zhes tshig drug mtshams bzlog gzhung nas/ hūm̐: bskul lo thugs dam dbyings nas bskul sogs 'grub par mdzod: bar gtor ma phul/ rtsang rak+tas bran/ hūm̐: drag po'i pho brang dur khrod gnas sogs bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bar 'don/ de nas yang bzlog me yi spu gri dmar po ni/ hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod e yi klong : sogs nas gnyan rgod lhog yams dmar bshal bzlog tu gsol: go cha'i yang bzlog ni/ hūm̐ che mchog drag po thod phreng yab yum gyis sogs nas/ dngos su bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs zlog: bar/ bzlog gzhung nas/ hūm̐: khram kha nag po gshin rje'i gdon: sogs nas rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong bzlog tu gsol: bar 'don/ go cha'i lha bzlog las/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ phyi khyams mu ran skyong ba yi: sogs nas chag che nyam nga ma lus zlog: ces bzlog par so sor mtshams gdab bo/ zhes gter gzhung nas gsungs so/ bzlog gzhung las/ hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: sogs mā ra ya nan nan: zhes zlog sngags rnams tshar mang du bzlas so/ de nas srung 'khor dang zlog dmigs bsgom pa ni/

gzhung las/ hoḥ skad cig rang nyid dpal chen khrag 'thung khro rgyal zhes sogs 'khor bar gyur/ bar srung sngags ni ma hā gu ru he ru ka sogs badz+ra rak+ṣa swā hā: bar gang mang bzlas nas dmigs pa de mtshams yang bzlog me yi spu gri 'khor lo nas/ de las bdag nyid khro rgyal stobs 'dus sku: sogs nas rang gshed bzlog par dmigs/ bar gsal/ drag sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig sogs sham bur spu gri'i sngags 'di gdags/ bh+yo mā ra ya rbad: hūm̐: ban+dhe sha ya myog: sogs nas shān+tiṃ mā ra ya rbad: bar bzla/ bzlog gzhung las/ hoḥ mdun du brub khung gi steng 'og sogs/ 'brug ltar sgrogs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma sogs zlog zlog: bar zlog sngags mang du bzla/ go cha las yang bzlog ma ma kro ta tsit+ta baṃ: kā la kā li lu pa oṃ: sogs brlag par gyur/ bar dmigs pa zlog dmigs gsung*/ bden stobs thal rdeb bya/ na mo: bla ma sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sogs nas bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭḥ bar brjod nas dmigs pa dang gsal nas thal rdeb bya yang*/ lok+t+ri pā la dang dmod pa gang gnod zlog sngags brjod/ lar srung zlog 'di la 'don lugs snga phyi 'ga' 'dug /rnying ma spyi ltar na nangs snga bdag bskyed gong bsnyen mtshams srung 'khor 'don nas srung sngags gang mang bzla 'dug /bsad las skabs bsad dmigs nas bsad sngags sham sbyar byed 'dug /bzlog pa thon mtshams zlog dmigs 'don nas zlog sngags dang gzer kha thams cad bsdams par bya'o/ de ni rnying ma spyi yi lugs yin 'dug /rang gter gtor zlog thams cad la yang bzlog pa thon mtshams srung zlog de na 'don/ yang na las byang bkra shis gong 'don srol 'dug /de rang lugs la gsungs 'dug /drag po'i las tshogs mnan sreg gang byas na phyag len chog khrigs ltar bya dgos so/ tshogs zhu ba zhu lan bya nas zhabs brtan bsam lhun bcas bya/

lhag ma'i kha bsngo gsung*/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi ma mo sogs/ bha ling+ta khā hi: bar 'don/ gu ru drag po'i dkyil 'khor du: tshogs kyi 'khor la ོ sogs/ gtor bsad 'don/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams sogs nas zlog: bar hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: sogs nas/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bar gtor ma phul/ de mtshams chos skyong gtor 'bul rigs thams cad 'don/ phrin las bcol gtor ma phul/ chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: sogs bha ling+ta khā hi: bar/ brtan skyong ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba sogs khā hi: bar 'don/ gtor chung dang bshal chu 'bul/ gtor snod 'og tu dam sri 'gugs gzhug bya/ rdor slob kyi phyag mtshan rdo rjes mnan/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: sogs mā ra ya nan: gtor snod kha yar gzed 'bru 'thor/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig sogs nas smon lam bya/ tshe 'gugs gsung*/ gtang rag mchod bstod/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang sogs/ hūm̐: mi bzad skur ston khrag 'thung la sogs bstod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs/ bzod gsol dang yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying bcas kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis sogs nas/ rgyud smin bkra shis shog: bar rdzogs rim bsdu ba rgyun du mi gsung ngo*/ bsngo ba/ hoḥ dmigs med rgya yan sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya/ hoḥ bdag blo ye nas sogs/ tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: ces bsngo zhing rgyas 'debs gang mos bya/ de yan chad dngos gzhi rgyun gyi go rim mo/ de nas rjes kyi rim pa gtor zlog 'bul ba'i nyin par/ dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi gzhung ltar mjug bzlog pa yan chod gong ltar song nas tshogs lhag ma sgor phul/ sna sel dkar gtor dang gser skyems bsham/ dkar gtor gang rigs 'don/ gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams nas:

sogs nas/ 'phen pa zor gyi sna drongs shig: bar sde brgyad gser skyems bton na legs/ de nas sgo dbye ni/ dang po shar sgo nas nub nas dbye nas g.yas bskor bya/ hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo ma sdig gdong ma: sogs nas rim bzhin sgo dbye sgo bzhi'i phyag rgya yis dbye'o/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: nas sogs mdos phyir dpag /glud rab dgos na 'dir 'don/ gzhung gi bskul 'don/ bskul gtor dang bzlog chung bzlog pa'i nang phul/ rang lugs kyi gtor rdzongs yin/ de nas chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba dang phrin las bcol/ yang na chos srung gtor rbad byed na mtha' nas yar 'don mthar bskul gang 'os ky-i gtor ma 'bul srol 'dug /bka' gter srung ma'i gtor ma thams cad gong nas rang rang thon nas 'bul srol 'dug /yang na chad mdo gis phul na chog 'dug /yang na bka' srung gtor gral la phul kyang chog /gang bde bya/ de nas za lam la gang rigs bka' brgyad dang kī la ya gang 'os 'don chog /chad mdo'i bzhengs bskul bya/ chad mdo'i gtor ma mdos 'bul phyogs la 'bul/ de nas rdo rje ser sbreng gi gral bsgrigs nas/ thog mar gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khrag 'thung sku: sogs nas/ sde brgyad dregs pa dbang du 'dus: bar gser skyems mchod/ zor ling dmigs bya gang yin la/ phaṭḥ mdun du drag po sogs lan gsum 'gugs nas/ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bar btang*/ zor rim bzhin thogs la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung thugs las sprul pa'i sras: sogs nas rim bzhin zor gsum po 'phang*/ bh+yo zlog: bar 'don/ gtor chen btegs la/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: lan gsum/ gzigs su gsol: lan gsum 'don/ rig 'dzin o rgyan chen po sogs nas/ mā ra ya rbad rbad bar zlog sngags dang dar nag g.yab mos nang du phul la/ hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: sogs/ mā ra ya bh+yoḥ zhes me nang phul/ de nas brtan ma 'don/

gtor ma phul/ rta bro bya/ khyung gis rjes gcod ni/ hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ sogs nas sgab 'dre phyi lam bcad/ gtor gzhong kha yar gzed la 'bru 'thor/ phyi mig mi lta bar yar byon/ rnam 'joms dang tshe snying bzla zh-ing log /sgo rtsar srung 'khor yod na sgo ngos sbyar/ lha rgyal ba'i 'o dod bya/ phye mar dang skyems bcas la rol/ de nas tshe 'gugs dang dngos grub len chog rgyas na pad+ma gsang thig ltar dngos grub len/ bsdu na gzhung gi / zab dbyings bla med sogs nas blang*/ gtang rag mchod bstod la/ gzhan rnying ma 'ga' yi phyag bzhes la/ las byang dang sbrags nas tshogs 'khor byed/ 'ga' res tshogs skong rkyang pa yang byed 'dug pas/ rang lugs la mchod pa kha gso nas skong bshags rang gzhung nas tshar grangs gsum tsam mthar/ mchod bstod bzod gsol/ byas nas bkra shis dang bsdu chog bsngo smon bcas gzhung ltar mtha' rgyas bya'o/ yang bzlog gsol byed na gzhung spyi ltar bya nas/ chad mdo yis phul kyang chog /bka' brgyad skong ba'i mthar bzlog bsgyur de dang sde lnga'i/

dzaḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba de gnyis gang red kyis phul na legs/ zor 'phen phyin bzhes 'bod pa yan mi dgos de min 'dra'o/ bzlog dbang zer ba yul phyogs 'ga' la byed srol 'dug pas byas na sgo dbye mtshams phyag rtags rdo rje bka' brgyad nang ngam/ pad 'byung bka' dang dmar nag me phreng gnyis gang 'os kyis mgor bzhag /yang gtor rgyag byas na gdon bgegs tshab che na/ gu drag rigs rta mgrin phur pa khros nag de thams cad gal che ba'i lha yin pas gtor ma rgyag lugs rnying ma spyir btang gi dmigs pa dang phyag bzhes la rang gis bstun nas de 'dra byed dgos so/ rang gi bzhengs bskul de 'don nas dmigs pa drag sngags dang bcas dgos 'di la zhal shes gnad chen po dga' 'dug pas shes par bya'o/ 'di yi sgo nas sri mnan byed na mnan chas gzhung ltar khyer nas zor 'phen skabs zor gyi sna la bzhag rta bro gong mnan pa byed na me chu'i rgyas 'debs bya nas rta bro 'don/ yang stod las la brten nas sbyin sreg bya dgos/ smad las la brten nas mnan pa'i las bya/ bsnyen pa la brten nas rdzas srung dang 'khor lo'i las rim bya'o/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba mnan sreg 'phang ba gang byed kyi rtsa ba bsnyen sgrub las gsum la thug pas de'i phyir sgrub gcig gis byas na las thams cad 'grub bo/ zhes gsungs so/ gter gzhung bum dbang don khrid dang dmigs pa'i dmar byang yig chung ltar nyams su len pa gal che'o/ zhi rgyas dbang drag yum bka' bcas so so'i chog khrigs ltar sgrub kyang chog 'dug pas gsal ka byed mi dgos/ gtor zlog gter gzhung skabs chos skor 'di snga 'gyur phyis 'gyur gnyis red song ba'i skabs sngon bu slob kun dga' blo gros dang ngag dbang sangs rgyas rang grol zung gis 'don 'grigs zin bris su bris pa yod pa der gzhi byas nas bka' gter thams cad cha tshang ba'i sgo nas rang chos 'di la goms 'dris che ba'i stabs kyis bla ma'i zhal lung dang sngags sgom rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar phyogs gcig tu bris pas/
