sngon gyi zin tho ltar byas na cha tshang po zh-ig mi 'dug /zin bris 'di ltar tu bton na cha tshang nges zhig yong ba yod pas phyi rabs rjes 'jug slob bu rnams kyis spyir rtsa gsum gling pa'i chos tshan thams cad la 'don stabs bde ba cha tshang po zhig yod 'dug pas de'i stabs kyis ngag khrid zhal rgyun slob mi dkon pas rang gi gter chos 'di la sgom sgrub nan cher byas pa'i sgo nas zin tho bkod pa au ḍī ming gis rang gzhan brjed tho du bris pa nyes 'gal mchis na ye shes lha la bshags shing dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ tshe sgrub pad+ma gsang thig gi: tshe dpal 'gugs dang dngos grub len chog bzhugs so: de nas tshe gtor dang tshe rdzas thogs la: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rdo rje mi 'gyur klong yangs nas: pad+ma dbang chen tshe bdag he ru kaḥ ḍāk+ki tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' spyod dag pa 'chi med gnas nas bzhengs: sngon tshe rig 'dzin gsang ba'i tshe sgrub ltar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la stsal du gsol: ngo mtshar rmad byung yid 'ong lha yi gter: 'dod pa'i re skong 'chi med bdud rtsi'i srid: kun 'byung dngos grub rtsa ba mchog stsol la: 'dzad med rgyud 'dzin smin pa'i dbang mchog bskur: zhes rtsa sngags bzlas shing dbang bskur: dngos grub kyang zhu/ de nas tshe ril thogs la: hūm̐: byin rlabs rtsa ba rgyud kun gcig bsgril ba: 'jigs bral rdo rje tshe srid 'byung ba'i rdzas: pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum ngo bo mchog: kun 'byung gdod nas zas mchog ril bu'i rdzas: dam rdzas bcud len snying po don thob shog: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ tshe chang thogs la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dbyings nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun: kun 'byung byang sems thugs dam rgyud bskul ba:

mkha' las rang byung rig pa'i bdud rtsi mchog: skal ldan rtsa rlung snang ba gong 'phel rdzas: bde drod 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ mda' dar thogs nas/ hūm̐ dzaḥ shar phyogs rdo rje rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: chu la dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas: rdo rje tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog rdo rjes rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru? mda' dar/ hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs rin chen rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: sa la dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas: rin chen tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog rat+nas rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru? mda' dar: hūm̐ baṃ: nub phyogs pad+ma rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: me la dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas: pad+ma tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog pad+mas rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru? mda' dar: hūm̐ hoḥ byang phyogs las kyi rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: rlung la dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas: karma tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog rgya gram rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ mda' dar: hūm̐ hrīḥ dbus phyogs dbyings kyi rig ma'i gtso: nam mkha' dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki ma: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: bud+dha tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog g.yung drung rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru? de nas rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rgya: longs sku mi 'gyur pad+ma'i rgya: sprul sku mi 'gyur g.yung drung rgya: ḍāk+ki mi 'gyur 'khor lo'i rgya: gter srung mi 'gyur phyag mtshan rgya: tshe srog mi 'gyur go khrab rgya: ye shes mi shigs stong nyid rgya: rim bdun sra brtan 'jigs med kyis: skal ldan tshe srog brtan gyur cig: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ

rtsa sngags rgyas gdab ste rab gnas 'thor: zab gsang pad+ma thugs bcud kyi: 'chi med rdo rje'i go khrab 'di: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya srung rol pa skya bdun rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ gis rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa'i mgul 'od gsal rdo rje'i phug nas gdan drangs pa shog ser kyus mtho gang zheng sor bzhi nas bkra shis nyin par phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༁ྂ: bla ma pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gtor zlog 'don cha'i zin bris dbang po'i lde mig bzhugs/ drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /gsang chen me ri 'bar ba ru/ thugs rdo rjes dregs pa snying 'byin chen po sgrub pa'i tshe phyi nang 'jig rten lha 'dre ma rungs pa rnams kyis sku la thog phab pa sogs nyams tshad mang po byas/ slob dpon la ci yang ma nyes kyang yul thams cad du nad la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa mang po byung*/ de'i dus su mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyis lung nas slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas khro rgyal drag po me phreng bskul nas lha 'dre sogs dam la btags te srog snying phul nas/ drag po khrag 'thung du grags/ de yang ma 'ongs pa'i dus nad ngan dar ba'i dus su phan par dmigs nas/ bla ma drag po'i phrin las lnga brtsams khyad par gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi skor rnams mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger btab nas ma hā gu ru'i rab tu gnas par mdzad nas rgya rim pa gsum gyis bcad nas tshogs khang gi logs su sbas/ de rnams sngon byung gi rim pa'o/ de yang gu ru'i lung ltar gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi skye ba tha ma o rgyan gter bdag gling pas gzho stod gter sgro nas spyan drangs pa'o/ de yang deng sang gi skabs su rims nad tre tre ho zhes pa'i mi nad sna dgu dar ba'i dus su bla ma drag po'i phrin las shin tu zab pas/

sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams su len par bya ba rigs so/ bla ma drag po'i gtor zlog gi rim pa sbyor dngos rjes dang gzhung du 'jug pa las/ thog mar sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan dang*/ phrin las lnga sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs nas/ na mo: mdun gyi nam mkhar chos dbyings sogs nas/ sarba sid+dhi hrīḥswā hā: nas skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med sogs nas skyabs su mchi: bar lan gsum/ hoḥ gdod nas dag pa sogs nas sems bskyed bar lan gsum 'don/ spyi ltar bgegs gtor/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yis: sogs kyi 'gugs zhugs lan gsum bya/ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: zhes bskrad/ srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: sogs nas mchod pa byin brlab bum pa dang rdzas sman rnams byin gyis brlabs/ brda sgo brda phyag dam bca' ni/ hūm̐: ma rig blang dor nas tsit+ta hūm̐ḥ bar sngon 'gro'o: dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod nas sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ bar 'don/ bla ma zhi ba'i las byang nas/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ zhes pa nas bstod pa'i mthar 'dzab bskul/ hūm̐: yang gsang dkyil 'khor nas srog la bab kyang mi btang ngo: bar rtsa sngags bzla/ bsnyen pa ci 'grub mthar/ nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i 'jigs brgyad kyi rgol ba thams cad zhi bar bsams la/ sham sbyar/ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wā shaṃ mā ra ya nas rim bzhin skabs sbyar/ lhag chad bkang*/ 'dzab bstod bya/ deng sang skya rengs dang po shar: nas deng 'dir stsol: bar de nas drag po'i gzhung la 'jug pa/ hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ rgya gram: nas lha srin sde brgyad 'dul bar bskyed: bar 'don de nas go cha nang gi hūm̐: rang rig bla ma drag po rtsal: nas ma 'dres chu zla'i dbyibs ltar bsgom: bar 'don yang gzhung nas/ hūm̐: phyi rol gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad steng:

nas gsal snang chu zla'i klong ltar bsgom: bar go cha'i sngags 'don/ oṃ a mi dhe wa hūm̐ hri da ya: sogs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gzhung nas de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas sogs spyan drang bar gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas : sogs dza dzaḥ bar go cha nas hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: sogs sarba pū dza hoḥ bar 'don gzhung gi bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dre rgod dang : nas phyag 'tshal pū ru sha ya hoḥ bar mchod pa hūm̐: phyi mchod gar sogs/ kha kha khā hi bar gsung go cha'i mchod pa la/ hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la sogs dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : bar bdud rtsi sman mchod sbyar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka ni skye ba med sogs sid+dhi hoḥ bar mchod/ hūm̐ dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i sogs nas skang bshags nas dngos grub stsol: bar yig brgya 'don/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma drag po he ru kaḥ sogs snang srid 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar 'don go cha'i bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje mi bskyod snang mthas sogs dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar 'daun gzhung gi hūm̐: khro chen mi bzad sogs nas las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bar 'don de nas zhi ba nas blang*/ hūm̐: yang gsang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: sogs nas srog la bab kyang mi btang ngo : zhes bar drag po'i rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags artsig bsnyen mtshams go cha'i sgrub sngags/ oṃ a mi dhe wa hūm̐ nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bar bzlas/ de nas ging bzhi dang*/ khyung rigs lnga dang khro mo bzhi dang*/ phag sdig khyung gsum bcas rim bzhin bzlas/ de nas rtsa sngags las sngags sham bu sngags rgod rim bzhin sbyar/ oṃ she la du ging sogs srin mo 'dre rgod dam sri/ gdon spyi la bcas rtsa sngags las sngags sbyar dgos/

'go nad dang rims yams la bsrung ba bya dgos na/ rgyas na nad 'joms par bu'i las byang bsnyen dmigs bcas rtsa sngags dang las sngags bzla/ sham bu sngags ring sbyar na do gal dang bstun/ rdzas ril bu gang dgos bsags nas phu btab bya'o/ de nas go cha'i hūm̐ sgrub 'don/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying bcas bya/ bsnyen bstod dang thun gtor 'bul/ deng sang skya rengs nas dngos grub zhu/ de mtshams rgyas pa nor lha/ dbang tshe sgrub/ yum bka' mkha' 'gro/ khyung sgrub bcas las byang rnams rim bzhin 'don la bsnyen pa bya/ ma bton kyang chog /yang na so so'i sgrub thabs gang dgos sgrub kyang chog 'dug /'di'i mtshams chos skyong gi gsol mchod bka' gter srung ma thams cad 'don pa thog mar gtor bsad byin rlob spyi ltar bya zhing*/ dbyings phyug drag mo nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs nas spyan drangs: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: sogs nas spyan 'dren dang bskang mchod bya/ bstod pa/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos sogs/ mchog gi dngos grub mchog stsol mdzod: bar 'don/ bh+yo kā li nag mo ma skyes sogs/ rtsal rdzogs shog: bar 'don/ bka' srung bswe yi lha mo'i bskul byang dug gi spu gri las/ hūm̐ bh+yo: phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na: sogs mā ra ya phaṭ: bar 'don/ gter srung ma mo'i mchod thabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ chos dbyings sogs nas i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bar btang*/ gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gro lod sku: sogs kha kha khā hi: bar 'don/ rgyas pa'i gtor 'bul dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor 'bul gzhung ltar gang 'os bya/ 'di'i mtshams bskang gsol chen mo spyi gzhung ltar dang*/ de nas mdun bskyed 'jug pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhe badz+ra āt+ma nas hūm̐ de steng ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ spel steng: gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra can: sogs nas las byang bdag bskyed ltar go cha nas bzung sngar ltar sbrags nas/

bsnyen mtshams bar bskyal/ bsnyen pa ci 'grub la 'bad nas bsnyen bstod dang thun gtor 'bul/ des nas tshogs la 'jug /dang po gtor bsngos kyi byin brlab bya/ tshogs byin brlab nas/ hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: sogs nas byin gyis brlab/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: sogs sa mā ya dza dzaḥ nas che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: zhes nas khā hi: bar tshogs mchod 'bul/ 'di mtshams gtor bsngos gsungs pa rang lugs kyi phyag bzhes yin/ de nas skong ba ni/ hūm̐ phyi nang spyan gzigs sogs dngos grub stsol: bar 'don skong ba rgyas pa la 'jug hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ sogs nas/ bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba 'don/ bshags pa ni/

hūm̐: ma rig rmongs pa'i sogs sa twa hūm̐: bshags pa rgyas pa ni/ ho: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yig brgya bzlas/ bshags pa 'bul/ tshogs tha ma lugs gcig la 'bul srol 'dug /rang lugs la gdab kha gnyis mi bya zhes mi 'bul 'dug /de nas bsad las rgyas par 'jug pa ni/ thog mar gzu dpang gser skyems bya na chog khrigs ltar/ gzhung ltar mnga' gsol bya/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung sogs nas gtor chung mtshams su 'bul/ gser skyems ni/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs gser skyems 'bul/ hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal pad+ma he ru kaḥ sogs gsal bar bskyed/ hom bskyed/ 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya/ pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ lha dbye bdud sprad sras mchog phur bskyed bya nas bsgral ba bya/ bsad dmigs bya/ rnam shes spar/ thun rdzas sna tshogs 'debs/ ral gris gtubs zhal bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sogs khā hi: bar zhes phul/ de nas bzlog mdos rak+tas bran/ sha dum gtor chung ling ro bcas bsham/ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas sogs nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: bar 'don/ go cha'i lha bzlog dgra bgegs dpung 'joms nas/ hūm̐: dbang drag me phreng khro rgyal yab yum gyis: sogs nas phrin las mdzod/ bar bzlog gzhung nas/ hūm̐: ye shes las kyi dmag tshogs khrag 'thung pa: sogs dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: mtshams lha bzlog nas/ bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i zhes tshig drug mtshams bzlog gzhung nas/ hūm̐: bskul lo thugs dam dbyings nas bskul sogs 'grub par mdzod: bar gtor ma phul/ rtsang rak+tas bran/ hūm̐: drag po'i pho brang dur khrod gnas sogs bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bar 'don/ de nas yang bzlog me yi spu gri dmar po ni/ hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod e yi klong : sogs nas gnyan rgod lhog yams dmar bshal bzlog tu gsol: go cha'i yang bzlog ni/

hūm̐ che mchog drag po thod phreng yab yum gyis sogs nas/ dngos su bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs zlog: bar/ bzlog gzhung nas/ hūm̐: khram kha nag po gshin rje'i gdon: sogs nas rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong bzlog tu gsol: bar 'don/ go cha'i lha bzlog las/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ phyi khyams mu ran skyong ba yi: sogs nas chag che nyam nga ma lus zlog: ces bzlog par so sor mtshams gdab bo/ zhes gter gzhung nas gsungs so/ bzlog gzhung las/ hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: sogs mā ra ya nan nan: zhes zlog sngags rnams tshar mang du bzlas so/ de nas srung 'khor dang zlog dmigs bsgom pa ni/ gzhung las/ hoḥ skad cig rang nyid dpal chen khrag 'thung khro rgyal zhes sogs 'khor bar gyur/ bar srung sngags ni ma hā gu ru he ru ka sogs badz+ra rak+ṣa swā hā: bar gang mang bzlas nas dmigs pa de mtshams yang bzlog me yi spu gri 'khor lo nas/ de las bdag nyid khro rgyal stobs 'dus sku: sogs nas rang gshed bzlog par dmigs/ bar gsal/ drag sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig sogs sham bur spu gri'i sngags 'di gdags/ bh+yo mā ra ya rbad: hūm̐: ban+dhe sha ya myog: sogs nas shān+tiṃ mā ra ya rbad: bar bzla/ bzlog gzhung las/ hoḥ mdun du brub khung gi steng 'og sogs/ 'brug ltar sgrogs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma sogs zlog zlog: bar zlog sngags mang du bzla/ go cha las yang bzlog ma ma kro ta tsit+ta baṃ: kā la kā li lu pa oṃ: sogs brlag par gyur/ bar dmigs pa zlog dmigs gsung*/ bden stobs thal rdeb bya/ na mo: bla ma sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sogs nas bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭḥ bar brjod nas dmigs pa dang gsal nas thal rdeb bya yang*/ lok+t+ri pā la dang dmod pa gang gnod zlog sngags brjod/ lar srung zlog 'di la 'don lugs snga phyi 'ga' 'dug

/rnying ma spyi ltar na nangs snga bdag bskyed gong bsnyen mtshams srung 'khor 'don nas srung sngags gang mang bzla 'dug /bsad las skabs bsad dmigs nas bsad sngags sham sbyar byed 'dug /bzlog pa thon mtshams zlog dmigs 'don nas zlog sngags dang gzer kha thams cad bsdams par bya'o/ de ni rnying ma spyi yi lugs yin 'dug /rang gter gtor zlog thams cad la yang bzlog pa thon mtshams srung zlog de na 'don/ yang na las byang bkra shis gong 'don srol 'dug /de rang lugs la gsungs 'dug /drag po'i las tshogs mnan sreg gang byas na phyag len chog khrigs ltar bya dgos so/ tshogs zhu ba zhu lan bya nas zhabs brtan bsam lhun bcas bya/ lhag ma'i kha bsngo gsung*/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi ma mo sogs/ bha ling+ta khā hi: bar 'don/ gu ru drag po'i dkyil 'khor du: tshogs kyi 'khor la ོ sogs/ gtor bsad 'don/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams sogs nas zlog: bar hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: sogs nas/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bar gtor ma phul/ de mtshams chos skyong gtor 'bul rigs thams cad 'don/ phrin las bcol gtor ma phul/ chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: sogs bha ling+ta khā hi: bar/ brtan skyong ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba sogs khā hi: bar 'don/ gtor chung dang bshal chu 'bul/ gtor snod 'og tu dam sri 'gugs gzhug bya/ rdor slob kyi phyag mtshan rdo rjes mnan/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: sogs mā ra ya nan: gtor snod kha yar gzed 'bru 'thor/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig sogs nas smon lam bya/ tshe 'gugs gsung*/ gtang rag mchod bstod/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang sogs/ hūm̐: mi bzad skur ston khrag 'thung la sogs bstod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs/ bzod gsol dang yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying bcas kyis brtan bzhugs bya/

bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis sogs nas/ rgyud smin bkra shis shog: bar rdzogs rim bsdu ba rgyun du mi gsung ngo*/ bsngo ba/ hoḥ dmigs med rgya yan sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya/ hoḥ bdag blo ye nas sogs/ tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: ces bsngo zhing rgyas 'debs gang mos bya/ de yan chad dngos gzhi rgyun gyi go rim mo/ de nas rjes kyi rim pa gtor zlog 'bul ba'i nyin par/ dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi gzhung ltar mjug bzlog pa yan chod gong ltar song nas tshogs lhag ma sgor phul/ sna sel dkar gtor dang gser skyems bsham/ dkar gtor gang rigs 'don/ gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams nas: sogs nas/ 'phen pa zor gyi sna drongs shig: bar sde brgyad gser skyems bton na legs/ de nas sgo dbye ni/ dang po shar sgo nas nub nas dbye nas g.yas bskor bya/ hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo ma sdig gdong ma: sogs nas rim bzhin sgo dbye sgo bzhi'i phyag rgya yis dbye'o/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: nas sogs mdos phyir dpag /glud rab dgos na 'dir 'don/ gzhung gi bskul 'don/ bskul gtor dang bzlog chung bzlog pa'i nang phul/ rang lugs kyi gtor rdzongs yin/ de nas chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba dang phrin las bcol/ yang na chos srung gtor rbad byed na mtha' nas yar 'don mthar bskul gang 'os ky-i gtor ma 'bul srol 'dug /bka' gter srung ma'i gtor ma thams cad gong nas rang rang thon nas 'bul srol 'dug /yang na chad mdo gis phul na chog 'dug /yang na bka' srung gtor gral la phul kyang chog /gang bde bya/ de nas za lam la gang rigs bka' brgyad dang kī la ya gang 'os 'don chog /chad mdo'i bzhengs bskul bya/ chad mdo'i gtor ma mdos 'bul phyogs la 'bul/ de nas rdo rje ser sbreng gi gral bsgrigs nas/ thog mar gser skyems ni/

hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khrag 'thung sku: sogs nas/ sde brgyad dregs pa dbang du 'dus: bar gser skyems mchod/ zor ling dmigs bya gang yin la/ phaṭḥ mdun du drag po sogs lan gsum 'gugs nas/ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bar btang*/ zor rim bzhin thogs la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung thugs las sprul pa'i sras: sogs nas rim bzhin zor gsum po 'phang*/ bh+yo zlog: bar 'don/ gtor chen btegs la/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: lan gsum/ gzigs su gsol: lan gsum 'don/ rig 'dzin o rgyan chen po sogs nas/ mā ra ya rbad rbad bar zlog sngags dang dar nag g.yab mos nang du phul la/ hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: sogs/ mā ra ya bh+yoḥ zhes me nang phul/ de nas brtan ma 'don/ gtor ma phul/ rta bro bya/ khyung gis rjes gcod ni/ hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ sogs nas sgab 'dre phyi lam bcad/ gtor gzhong kha yar gzed la 'bru 'thor/ phyi mig mi lta bar yar byon/ rnam 'joms dang tshe snying bzla zh-ing log /sgo rtsar srung 'khor yod na sgo ngos sbyar/ lha rgyal ba'i 'o dod bya/ phye mar dang skyems bcas la rol/ de nas tshe 'gugs dang dngos grub len chog rgyas na pad+ma gsang thig ltar dngos grub len/ bsdu na gzhung gi / zab dbyings bla med sogs nas blang*/ gtang rag mchod bstod la/ gzhan rnying ma 'ga' yi phyag bzhes la/ las byang dang sbrags nas tshogs 'khor byed/ 'ga' res tshogs skong rkyang pa yang byed 'dug pas/ rang lugs la mchod pa kha gso nas skong bshags rang gzhung nas tshar grangs gsum tsam mthar/ mchod bstod bzod gsol/ byas nas bkra shis dang bsdu chog bsngo smon bcas gzhung ltar mtha' rgyas bya'o/ yang bzlog gsol byed na gzhung spyi ltar bya nas/ chad mdo yis phul kyang chog /bka' brgyad skong ba'i mthar bzlog bsgyur de dang sde lnga'i/ dzaḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba de gnyis gang red kyis phul na legs/ zor 'phen phyin bzhes 'bod pa yan mi dgos de min 'dra'o/

bzlog dbang zer ba yul phyogs 'ga' la byed srol 'dug pas byas na sgo dbye mtshams phyag rtags rdo rje bka' brgyad nang ngam/ pad 'byung bka' dang dmar nag me phreng gnyis gang 'os kyis mgor bzhag /yang gtor rgyag byas na gdon bgegs tshab che na/ gu drag rigs rta mgrin phur pa khros nag de thams cad gal che ba'i lha yin pas gtor ma rgyag lugs rnying ma spyir btang gi dmigs pa dang phyag bzhes la rang gis bstun nas de 'dra byed dgos so/ rang gi bzhengs bskul de 'don nas dmigs pa drag sngags dang bcas dgos 'di la zhal shes gnad chen po dga' 'dug pas shes par bya'o/ 'di yi sgo nas sri mnan byed na mnan chas gzhung ltar khyer nas zor 'phen skabs zor gyi sna la bzhag rta bro gong mnan pa byed na me chu'i rgyas 'debs bya nas rta bro 'don/ yang stod las la brten nas sbyin sreg bya dgos/ smad las la brten nas mnan pa'i las bya/ bsnyen pa la brten nas rdzas srung dang 'khor lo'i las rim bya'o/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba mnan sreg 'phang ba gang byed kyi rtsa ba bsnyen sgrub las gsum la thug pas de'i phyir sgrub gcig gis byas na las thams cad 'grub bo/ zhes gsungs so/ gter gzhung bum dbang don khrid dang dmigs pa'i dmar byang yig chung ltar nyams su len pa gal che'o/ zhi rgyas dbang drag yum bka' bcas so so'i chog khrigs ltar sgrub kyang chog 'dug pas gsal ka byed mi dgos/ gtor zlog gter gzhung skabs chos skor 'di snga 'gyur phyis 'gyur gnyis red song ba'i skabs sngon bu slob kun dga' blo gros dang ngag dbang sangs rgyas rang grol zung gis 'don 'grigs zin bris su bris pa yod pa der gzhi byas nas bka' gter thams cad cha tshang ba'i sgo nas rang chos 'di la goms 'dris che ba'i stabs kyis bla ma'i zhal lung dang sngags sgom rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar phyogs gcig tu bris pas/

sngon gyi zin tho ltar byas na cha tshang po zh-ig mi 'dug /zin bris 'di ltar tu bton na cha tshang nges zhig yong ba yod pas phyi rabs rjes 'jug slob bu rnams kyis spyir rtsa gsum gling pa'i chos tshan thams cad la 'don stabs bde ba cha tshang po zhig yod 'dug pas de'i stabs kyis ngag khrid zhal rgyun slob mi dkon pas rang gi gter chos 'di la sgom sgrub nan cher byas pa'i sgo nas zin tho bkod pa au ḍī ming gis rang gzhan brjed tho du bris pa nyes 'gal mchis na ye shes lha la bshags shing dge bas gro kun rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi spros bcas sgrub chen gyi stong thun rab 'jigs khro bo rol pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// pad+ma las 'khrungs sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /drag tu khros pa dmar nag me yi phreng*/ /dbyer med rang rig bla mar gus btud nas/ /stong thun khro bo'i gad rgyangs 'dir sgrog bya/ de la thog mar ma traṃ bsgral chog gi gong du rdo rje slob dpon nam rgyal thebs kyi gtso bos zhwa chos bcas 'di skad do/ kyai skal ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las su rung zhing*/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan por 'du bar 'os pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams legs par gsan du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa mchog gi lam la zhugs pas gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi skabs su thabs snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje sdom pa chen po las mi 'da' bas na bdag cag gi ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa chen po shākya seṅges kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje'i mdzad pa chen po bcu gnyis bstan pa'i bye brag ser skya'i khab tu rdo rje btsun mo'i sgyu ma chen po 'khor brgyad khri dang bcas pa la chags chen rdo rje'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'dod yon la dgyes dgur rol pa'i tshul gyis thabs kyi brtul zhugs mthar phyin par mdzad pas rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drug pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir dzam+bu gling gi yul dbus rdo rje gdan byang chub shing drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i snga rol du mi bsrun pa'i bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyi g.yo sgyus brid pa la mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro bo dang*/

pad+ma'i pho nya sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ stobs bcu'i nus stobs rdo rje'i khro bo mi g.yo ba'i dpung gis bdud dpung mi 'khrugs phrag gcig dpa' bkong bas bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug chen po mngon du bstan nas rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi rgyud sde bsam mi khyab pa rdo rje'i rigs can gyi 'dus pa la bstan pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa rang gi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang sbyar na brda don rtags gsum gyi ru tra bsgral ba ni gsang sngags bstan pa'i chu mgo brdol ba'i gleng gzhi ste/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser: bdud po ma traṃ ru tra drag pos bsgral: srin mo ma tshogs rnams la sbyor ba mdzad: gsang sngags bstan pa dang po de nas byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang bsgral bya'i ru tra la rnam pa gsum/ lhan skyes don gyi ru tra/ mtshan ma brda yi ru tra/ btags pa ming gi ru tra bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ bgegs kyi bgegs te bgegs chen po/ /dug lnga'i rtog pa nyid las skyes/ /phyed dang gsum gyi dur khrod na/ /gzhi rtsa ngag dang lus sems so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum las/ dang po bdag rtog gzung 'dzin las skyes pa'i dug lnga'i ru tra chen po'i 'khor du nyon mongs brjod kyis mi lang ba dang bcas pas khams gsum gyi grong khyer la dbang byed pa 'khrul pa'i tshang bcas te 'gro kun la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mi zad pa bskyed de chos kyi bdag 'dzin ma traṃ ka ru tra sems can gyi lus la gnas/ gnyis pa tshogs brgyad gang zag gi bdag 'dzin kha traṃ ka ru tra sems la gnas/ gsum pa mi bden 'khrul pa'i bdag 'dzin a kar+ṣa ru tra sems can gyi ngag la gnas so/ gnyis pa mtshan ma brda yi ru tra ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus dpag tu med pa na bskal pa kun tu dga' bya bar sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i bstan pa la dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu'i slob ma thar pa nag po zhes bya bas slob dpon gyis bstan pa'i gsang ba'i gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi lta ba ma rtogs par/

sbas pa'i gsang ba sbyor sgrol brlang por spyad pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bskal pa bcu gnyis dang*/ lha sngags rang rgyud du bzlas sgom byas pas rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yi dwags srin po chen po'i gzugs su bskal pa brgyad du skyes nas gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun man chad dbang du byas shing gdug pa can mtha' dag bran du bkol bas dpal chen pos bsgral 'os kyi skal ldan du gyur pa dang*/ gsum pa btags pa ming gi ru tra ni gzhir gnas rang byung gi ye shes rang ngo ma rig pas khams gsum du 'khyams pa'i dug gsum gyi rang gzugs mtshan rtog gis bcings pa'i gdug can 'byung po'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa rnams bsgral bya ru tra'i mtshan nyid do/ dbyings ye gnyis med du rtogs pa ni/ srid zhi'i spyi dpal chen po khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dgongs pa tshad du 'khrol ba'i ye shes klong dgu mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i khyab bdag tu bzhengs pa dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka yab yum sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams sgrol byed yin la/ de yang dpa' bo chen po de rnams kyis sngon gyi dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad tshad med pa'i thugs rje skyes te mi gsang ba'i gsang ba chen po'i phrin las drag po'i mngon spyod kyis/ ru tra gdug pa can 'khor dang bcas pa bsgral zhing gnas spar te chos skyong ba'i ma hā kā lar dbang bskur/ ma 'ongs par thal bas khebs pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas thal ba'i dbang por 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan/ de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i pho thams cad thugs rje'i thabs kyis bsgral zhing bstan pa srung ba'i las bsgos/ slas kyi 'khor bdud kyi bu mo myos byed ma sogs ma chags thabs kyi sbyor bas yid 'phrog ste gnas yul sgo ma dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs su sprul te bran du byas/

ru tra'i phung po 'dzam gling du bor bas yul chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dur khrod chen po brgyad du byin brlabs/ de dag rnams su rang byung gi ma mo mchod rten zhing skyong klu dang sprin legs pas brgyan zhing skal ldan la nyams rtogs spel ba/ skal med rnams tshar gcod pa'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs te ru tra'i 'dod chags bzhi la dgongs pa'i rgyud sde bzhi/ rnam shes brgyad la dgongs pa'i sgrub chen bka' brgyad/ nyon mongs lnga la dgongs pa'i rigs lnga he ru kaḥ gdul bya rtsa ba'i dngos po smin pa'i phyir sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sprul nas khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs dang*/ ltas chen po bco lnga spros te sgrol byed cho 'phrul chen pos srid rtsa bcad de rdo rje theg pa'i skal ldan yongs su smin pas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa ni sgrol ba'i tshul te de ltar sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar bzhin rjes 'jug gdul byas nyams len du sbyor dgos pa'i tshul/ shing rta chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas/ phyi nang gsang ba bsrung bya ste/ /srin po'i rgyal po tshul bzhin mnan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi brtag bslang sbyang bzung dang*/ phyi nang bar gyi mtshams bcad dang*/ nang mtshams ma traṃ bsgral ba'i las rim dpal chen po'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'jug pa dang*/ ma traṃ bsgral ba'i khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang sgrub na bkra shis pa dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi bgegs kyi rgyal po rnams bsgral bas bgegs gzhan gyis bar chad mi nus shing dngos grub gnyis myur du thob pa'i dgos pa yod pas rnal 'byor pa rnams pad+ma khrag 'thung rol pa'i lha yi gsal snang dang nga rgyal brtan pos ma traṃ bkug bsgral sogs gzhung chen po'i sgom don gsal 'debs bzhin pas cho ga'i bya ba la 'jug par zhu/ ༈

sgrub pa po rnams gnas su bkod pa'i skabs/ da lam theg pa kun gyi yang rtse/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi nying khu/ ngo bo gu ru rin po che'i thugs sgrub bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung zhes dmar nag khyung zhon gyi rnam par sgrub pas/ sku yi go cha la drag po lha lnga sogs dpal chen yongs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor tshom bu tshogs sgrub bya ba yin la/ de yang sbyang gzhi 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin lha'i dkyil 'khor du gnas kyang*/ sbyang bya gnyis 'dzin chags sdang gi rnam pa bral bya'i tshul du bsgribs pa nyid/ sbyong byed zhi khro dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam pa lam du byas pas/ sbyangs 'bras gdod nas bzhugs pa'i zung 'jug gi phyag rgya mngon du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can dang mthar thug gi theg pa gsang sngags bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i dgongs pa rjes su 'brel bas gsang ba yongs rdzogs chen po'i rgyud las/ rgyud don gsal ba'i sgrub chen la/ /bzhi ste phun sum tshogs gzhi bzung*/ /sta gon rim pas sgrom du gzhug /dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsrang ste/ /mtha' rgyas cho gas rjes bskyang ngo*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung dgos pas/ de yang gzhung las/ drag po bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dur khrod dam mam rang byung phug: shing gcig drung ngam dben pa'i yul: bkra shis rgyud dang mthun pa'i sar: dmar smug sa la stegs bu bya: dkyil 'khor las rim gzhung bzhin gdab: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ༈ phyi yi gnas phun sum tshogs pa rang byung grub pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis dpal he ru ka'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs shing*/ las bzhi sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas bkra shis dge ba'i gnas/ lhun grub yid 'ong gi gnas/ 'phral rkyen sgrub pa'i gnas rnams kyi mtshan nyid kun ldan du/ nang gi gnas phyi nang snod bcud rang lus dang bcas pas gdod nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yi 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa yin par shes pas dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med lha'i rang bzhin du shes pa dang*/

gsang ba'i gnas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos nyid de kho na nyid du lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang na gnas kyang chos kyi dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du gnas par rtogs pa dang*/ ༈ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje slob dpon lta ba gnyis su med pa'i gdeng dang ldan/ sgom pa bskyed rdzogs las su rung zhing spyod pa sa ma ya 'bum sde rnam par dag /dbang dang man ngag gi bka' bab/ theg pa rim dgu'i don thugs su chud/ ngang rgyud ring zhing phan sems che ba/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na zhes bya ba dang*/ ༈ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bde chen rgyud la bskyed pa'i gzungs ma lus ngag yid gsum mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rigs lnga'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i 'khor rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi gtso bo bzhi yum dang bcas pa/ don gnyis phrin las sgrub pa'i 'khor rgyal thebs kyi ston pa bzhi/ bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'khor rdo rje spyan pa/ rdo rje mtshams pa ging dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i zhal zas sbyor ba'i 'khor rdo rje drod 'dzin/ byan pho byan mo dang bcas pa/ dad 'dus thugs rjes bzung ba'i 'khor rdo rje'i mched dang lcam dral/ phyi nang brda sbyor byed pa'i 'khor rdul phyags skyes bu ste/ thams cad kyang bsags pa sngon du song ba'i skal ba can/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog chung ba/ dad pa dang brtson 'grus che ba/ lhag par rgyal thebs rnams kyang dbang dang dam tshig ldan zhing thos bsam gyis rgyud dag pa/ de kho na nyid la blo sbyang ba sha stag lags pa dang*/ ༈ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ thog mtha' dbus med dus bzhi mnyam pa chen po'i ngang las/ zla ba dgu pa la dpes mtshon na/ gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul du yum la drin lan bsab pa'i mdo gsungs nas slar yang 'dzam bu gling gi skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du rdzu 'phrul gyis babs pa dang*/

slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas bal yul yang le shod du thugs dam yang phur gyi sgo nas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad de dus chen tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcur gza' skar sbyor byed sogs lta bu kha bsgyur/ dus tshes dge zhing shis par/ ༈ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa/ 'tsho ba zas/ nad zlog sman/ dgra zlog mtshon sogs phyi'i yo byad/ rten rdzas sgrub rdzas/ rgyan rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dbang gi rdzas te nang gi yo byad/ ta na ga na/ shes rab snying rje ste gsang ba'i yo byad du bshad pa spyi dang*/ pho brang nang rten thun mong ma yin pa/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ dbus su bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang : drag po'i sman rdzas rnams kyang blugs: dar dmar kha bcad dar nag gdugs: bum pa cha tshang tsa ka li: sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang mchod: spyan gzigs la sogs tshang bar bshams: zhes gsungs so/ spros bcas rten sgrub pa'i mchod rdzas ma tshang ba med par 'du byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo bkra yal le/ snang gsal gyi mar me 'od lhag ge /bdug spos gyi dri bzang ngad thul le/ rdo rje'i mched lcam spro dga' dang byin rlabs thibs se 'du ba'i skabs 'dir ston pa rdo rje slob dpon nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad cing zab mo'i don ston te rnal 'byor yongs kyi dpal mgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rdo rje'i khri chen po la bzhugs par gsol/ rigs bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs dang dzap bsnyen bgrang ba'i rgyal tshab chen po bzhi phyogs bzhi/ yab kyi dgongs pa dang bstun zhing sbyor ba'i sgyu rtsal shes pa'i gzungs ma kun tu bzang mo rnams yab kyi g.yon tu/ chos 'chad pa'i rdo rje rgyal thebs/ dngos grub kyi rdzas ster ba'i rin chen rgyal thebs/ dbang bskur ba'i bya ba byed pa dbang gi rgyal thebs/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba las kyi rgyal thebs rnams kyang phyogs bzhi/

phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i brtul zhugs can rdo rje mtshams pa nub byang*/ sgrol ba'i las dang brda la mkhas pa rdo rje'i king ka ra rnams lho nub/ g.yo sgyu med par mi ma yin mthong zhing nyul le'i bar chad bzlog nus pa'i mig rnon rdo rje spyan pa dang*/ dus sbyor dbyug gu sogs la mkhas shing phrin las kyi skabs phyed pa rdo rje drod 'dzin pa gnyis byang shar/ bag ldan gtsang sbra che zhing rnam smin la 'dzem pa'i rdo rje byan pho byan mo dang*/ nga rgyal med cing bka' bzhin sri zhu la brtson pa'i rdo rje rdul phyags pa rnams shar lho/ mched lcam snod dang ldan pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyang gral gyi bar du bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang chos spyod la brtson 'grus chung ba lus kyi skyon dang*/ smra ba mang zhing bzlas pa la mi brtson pa ngag gi skyon dang*/ zhe sdang che zhing byams pa chung ba yid kyi skyon dang*/ brjed nges che zhing bag zon chung ba dam tshig gi skyon dang*/ chang la dga' zhing gnyid che ba ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon dang*/ g.yeng ba la dga' zhing bsgom sgrub la skyo ba dad pa'i skyon te drug po rnam pa thams cad du spang zhing*/ rtogs pa che bas chos nyid dang mi phyed pa/ dad gus che bas bla ma dang mi phyed pa/ dam tshig che bas yi dam dang mi phyed pa/ brtse gdung che bas mched lcam dang mi phyed pa/ brtul zhugs che bas dam rdzas dang mi phyed pa/ sbyor sgrol brtson pas gzungs ma dang mi phyed pa/ snying rje che bas sems can dang mi phyed pa/ ting nge 'dzin gsal bas dngos grub dang mi phyed pa/ skyon dang bral bas 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang mi phyed pa ste yon tan dgu po la rnam pa kun tu brtson zhing*/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud las/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi ston pa dang : da lta sangs rgyas 'di dag la: tha dad du ni cung min brtag: rdo rje gsang ba'i grogs dag kyang : de dang rjes su mthun par blta:

sgo gsum gus pas brtson bya zhing : dam pa'i tshig las 'da' mi bya: zhes gsungs pa'i don la bslab pa sogs bka' bsgo ba'i las rnams bde blag tu bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs 'dun dang ldan pas 'dis rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po 'di: sku gsung thugs dang?gsol dgyes par bzhugs: bar brjod/ ༈ dpal gyi rtags gdab pa'i skabs su/ 'dir 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams don gyi dag pa sbyar bas lha dang gnyis su med par rtogs pa dang*/ rtags kyi phyag rgya bcings pas mkha' 'gro dam can pho mo rnams kyis sgrub pa por shes pa dang*/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing thabs kyi theg pa'i rigs su nges pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa sogs dgos pa du ma dang ldan pa'i he ru ka rol pa chen po'i chas su 'jug pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs dus na skyes bu dag: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun ngo bo: sku gsum phrin las che ba'i mchog: kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag: he ru ka yi tshul 'chang ba: brtul zhugs bzang po de la ni: ma rig log par lta ba'i tshogs: bdud bzhi'i phyogs su gtogs rnams kyis: 'tshe zhing bar du gcod pa'am: gdug cing 'da' bar nus ma yin: zhes gsungs/ de yang rtags phyag rgya'i dbang du byas na/ sngon dpal chen pos yi dwags kyi gtso bo dur khrod bdag po brtul zhing de'i chas rnams dpa' ba'i rtags su bzhes pa las byung ba/ ru tra sde gsum bsgral bas tshar gsum gyi phreng ba/ ru tra'i chung ma ma chags thabs kyis rol pas dbang du bsdus pa rak+ta'i thig le/ tshangs pa chen po bsgral ba zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ brgya byin dang de'i bzhon pa glang po che btul ba glang chen gyi ko rlon/ gza' chen nyi ma'i bu mo stag gdong spyan gcig ma btul ba stag gi sham thabs/ klu gdug pa can btul ba sbrul nag gi chun pa/

srin mo nyer bzhi btul ba thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad dbang du bsdus pa zhag gi zo ris la sogs pa byung ba yin zhing*/ brda'i dag sbyor gyi don ni/ ye shes lnga po don dam spros bral gyi dbyings su gcig pas thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu ma'i khong seng gis sbrel ba/ thugs rje ci yang 'byung ba bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad pa'i glang ko /phyin ci log bzhi dang bral ba'i sbrul chun/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang tshad med bzhi lhun la rdzogs pa'i g.yang gzhi/ khams gsum rtog pa 'joms pa'i stag sham/ ma rig rnam rtog gi bud shing ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs pa'i me dpung*/ dug lnga dbang du sdud pa'i khrag chen gyi thig le/ rgyud drug 'khor ba'i bcud tshogs gnyis kyi gsos su blang ba zhag chen gyi zo ris/ skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dug gsum sku gsum du rdzogs pa thod phreng tshar gsum/ stong pa nyid la bdud bzhi bskyod du med pa'i rdo rje'i go khrab bcas dpal gyi chas bcu ste/ rang rang gi rigs dang mthun par dpal chen po pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gsal snang dang snyems pas dpal gyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du bzhes shing*/ don gyi dag dran dang ldan par dug lnga rtsad nas gcod/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan/ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad la dbang bskur/ gdug pa can zil gyis mnan/ yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la mnga' mdzad pa pad+ma he ru ka'i lha'i tshom bu'i dgongs pa las g.yel ba med pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hrīḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'bras bu'i lam zhugs pa: rtags kyi phyag rgya bder?sku la rgyan du bzhes: bar brjod/ ༈ bsre bsnan gyi skabs su dam tshig bsgrags pa'i rjes/ slob dpon nam rgyal tshab pas/ 'o skal pa dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams thugs ma yengs par snyan lhan ner gsan 'tshal/

de yang gsang sngags dbang gi mtha' can/ dbang dam tshig gi mtha' can zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo rje theg pa'i lam thog mtha' bar gsum dam tshig la brten nas bgrod dgos te/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la brten te byung*/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu gnas/ /slad nas 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu bsgrub/ ces gsungs pa ltar dam tshig ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul yin pas gces spras su bzung 'tshal te gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ dbang srog dam tshig rjes su bzung*/ dbye na sa ya 'bum sde las/ bsdu na nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs la 'du/ /nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro/ /de phyir mig 'bras lta bur bzung*/ /nyams na slar la bshags par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar smin byed kyi dbang sngon du nod cing dbang srog dam tshig la gnas pas grol byed kyi lam la 'jug dgos/ dam tshig ni srog gi dbang po dang mtshungs la/ lam gyi rim pa gzhan rnams dbang po yan lag gzhan dang mtshungs pas 'dir yang*/ sngags kyi dngos grub ma lus pa: dam tshig nyid la brten gyur kyang : zhes gsungs pas dam tshig kho na la gces spras su 'bad 'tshal/ dam tshig gi lha ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ mnyam sbyor las/ sems can kun gyi sems gang zhig /rdo rje zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /rdo rje stong pa nyid du gnas/ /sems dpa' ye shes chen po ste/ zhes gzhi rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig mi phyed pa de nyid lam du ma nyams par ston par byed pa dang*/ nyams na bshags pa'i yul du grub la/ 'bras bu'ang de'i go 'phang grub pa spyi dpal chen po zhi ba'i skur bstan pa las gnyis su med de/ dam tshig gi bdag po dpal he ru ka ste dam las mi 'da' ba rnams la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ yid la 'dod pa thams cad bstsal/

dam las 'das na snying dbus rdo rje gnod sbyin rab tu khros pas mi zad pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed par mdzad/ dam tshig gi srung ma phra men ma bcu drug /spyan pa dbang phyug nyer brgyad rnams kyis kyang legs nyes kyis stangs 'dzin cing dge sdig gi la shan 'byed pa yin pas mngon lkog dang le lo med par/ dran pa dang shes bzhin pa'i bag yod par bsrung dgos shing*/ gang bsrung bar bya ba ni sa ma ya 'bum sde gsungs pa'ang thun mong spyi'i dam tshig nyer brgyad/ sgrub pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis rnams su 'dus te/ de yang rtsa ba'i sku'i dam tshig tu slob dpon rnam ba bzhi khong pa'i snying ltar btsa'/ rdo rje'i mched bzhi po lus dang mig ltar blta/ gsung gi dam tshig tu sngags kyi snying po lnga dang phyag brgya bzhi rgyun ma chad par nyams su len/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu spyi dang bar gsang gsang 'os gnyer du gtad pa'i gsang bcu sbas/ yan lag gi spyad bya/ mi spang ba/ dwang du blang ba/ shes bya/ bsgrub bya'i dam tshig lnga tshan lnga yal bar mi 'dor ba bsrung bas thun mong gi dam tshig rnam par dag khyad par gyi dam tshig nyer gcig ltem rkyang med par lha chos mi chos bka' chos gsum gyi sgo nas bsrung bas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnam par dag /'khor gsum byang chub sems kyi thig le nyag gcig las gud na med pas bsrung mtshams bral ba'i ye bsrungs chen por rtogs pa lta ba'i dam tshig thugs rje'i dpyang thag ldan pas dam tshig nyams su yang med cing*/ nyams pa'ang myur du 'chos par 'gyur ro/ bang mdzod 'phrul lde las/ spyir ni gsang sngags dam tshig ni/ /bsrung na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sa ma ya ni 'bum sde yod/ /ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la/ /ma bcos pa yi blo bzhag na/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ /mnyam nyid g.yo ba med pa ni/ /dam tshig thams cad bsrung ba yin/ /nyams pa'i chad pa byung ba la/

/mgon skyabs de las che ba med/ ces gsungs/ lta ba mthar phyin pa ma rtogs pa'i gang zag mos slob pas dam tshig nyams na me dang 'dra ste 'tshig /so mtshams kyi mkhar dang 'dra ste rang gzhan phung*/ dug dang 'dra ste thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ snying phyung na sman ci tsam btang yang bde bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin du sgom sgrub legs pa ci byas kyang dam tshig nyams na 'bras bu mi 'byung ba lha rnams kyang rang gshed du dbab nas tshe 'dir mi rung pa du ma 'byung zhing*/ phyi ma dmyal khams bco brgyad thams cad kyis kyang sdug bsngal do zla med pa'i rdo rje'i dmyal ba chen por skyes nas sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mdzad kyang thar pa'i dus med par 'gyur la/ nyams pa'i rgyud kyang slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin pa/ /lung ma nos pa slob dpon gyi sa bzung ba/ kha spyod dang lta spyod mi mthun pa/ gsang ba smra zhing gsang ba'i dam tshig cher mi 'dzin pa/ rgyal blon gyi bya ba sogs mi chos la gtso bo 'dzin pa/ nga rgyal dang rang mthong chang dad che ba/ chos la phyogs ris che zhing gshe skur mang ba/ bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi zur za byed pa/ gtsang dme dang rtog pa shas che bas dam bca' 'dor zhing gnyen po med pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'grogs pa/ thos pa chung zhing bla ma mkhas pa dang bral ba/ spyod pa thod rgal du byed cing gcig pur mi tshugs pa sogs dam tshig nyams pa'i snga rtags dang bcas te rgyal ba'i bka' chad du ma 'byung bar gsungs pas/ srog dang mig 'bras ltar btsa' bas dam tshig mi nyams pa bsrung zhing*/ nyams chag byung ba dag kyang rab kyis lta ba skye med kyi ngang du la bzla/ 'bring gis srog lan gsum btang ba sogs thabs la mkhas pas bshags/ tha mas kyang gnong 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pas 'chags shing phyin chad bsdoms te legs par bsrungs pa'i phan yon kyang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dra bar dgos 'dod 'byung*/

sa gzhi dang 'dra bar yon tan thams cad skyed/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar thams cad kyi go 'byed/ tshe 'dir yang ma nyams pa'i snga rtags legs pa'i yon tan du ma 'byung zhing*/ ring por mi thogs par dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po sgrub/ /phrin las bzhi po thogs med cing*/ /rtogs pa mchog gis gong du 'phel/ zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal grags pas/ zhing gzhan bskal mang sdom la gnas pa bas/ /skad cig 'dir gnas 'bras bu rdzogs par byed/ ces gsungs pas bag yod dus thung ngu re bsten yang don chen por 'gyur zhing*/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ sems la dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsgrub cing*/ mi dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsdoms nas g.yo sgyu'i skyon med pa la 'dus te/ rdo rje snying po phra ba 'byung gnas kyi rgyud las/ dam tshig sdom pa rnam bshad pa/ /kun kyang rang gi sems las so/ /de yi 'phen pa bla mas shes/ /de phyir sems la 'dris pa'i mis/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong ba dang*/ /sku gsum tshad du 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mngon par 'grub/ /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa'i mis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang*/ /de yi byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ /dus gsum lung yang ston pa dang*/ /skye shi gnyis la dbang thob 'gyur/ /grogs la brtse gdung ldan pa'i mis/ /'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba dang*/ /kun gyis snyan par grags pa dang*/ /gzugs can kun kyang byams pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba dang*/ /ma bsgrub dngos grub 'byung ba dang*/ /ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang*/ /de bzhin mchog dang thun mong 'dir/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag tu dgon par gnas pa'i mis/ /rlung sems tshad med zin pa dang*/ /snang ba grogs su 'char ba dang*/

/rang gi sems la dbang thob 'gyur/ /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa'i mi/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ /'khor 'bangs rgyas shing bsod nams ldan/ /'gro ba yongs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu dbang rdzogs byas pa'i mi/ /'gro ba'i gtso bor 'gyur ba dang*/ /kun gyis mthong ba dga' ba dang*/ /ye shes mngon sum 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlab 'gyur/ /rtag tu gtor ma'i las byed pa/ /bsod nams tshogs rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ /bar chad med cing las rnams 'grub/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro bran bzhin khol bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams bag yod dran shes dang ldan pas rtag tu dam tshig sdom pa la nan tan du bzung bar mdzod cig ༈

bzlas dmigs skabs su 'di ltar bshad par bya'o/ da lam/ mched lcam rnams bsnyen pa mi bcad par shub bur bzla bzhin du bsgom don gsal 'debs cung zad zhu ba la gsan 'tshal/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pas chos 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba thams cad bsdu na rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad par du mas 'phags pa 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa yin/ rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde bzhi dang sgo drug la sogs pa'i dbye na du ma yod pa rnams rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la 'dus te/ de'ang rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las phyi ma yin la/ de la'ang bka' gter gyi bab so gnyis las nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs shing de yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa bod du phebs nas gdul bya dus la bab pa'i tshe/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis rgyal srid dang*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ de mthun dam rdzas bcas gu ru la phul nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes sogs snying gi bu dgu la sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes nas dbang bskur bas so so'i me tog ji ltar phog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal mthong zhing thun mong gi sprul bsgyur nyi zla gdan du bting ba brag la phur pa 'debs pa sogs/ sku tshe de nyid kyi rigs kyi bdag po dang gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang brnyes pas thog drangs/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ yer pa'i grub thob brgya rtsa/ shel brag gi sngags pa sum cu/ yang rdzong rtogs ldan nga lnga/ rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma nyer lnga sogs grub thob kyi tshang chen po brdol ba yin la/ de lta bu gu ru pad+ma dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i rnam 'phrul gter ston brgya rtsa bcas mang du byon pa/ so sor yang bka' dgongs phur gsum bla rdzogs thugs gsum sogs mang du bzhugs pa las/

'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sku yi skye ba bcu gsum pa pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi nang gses byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma sgrub pa yin la/ de la'ang zhi drag gnyis las/ bla ma drag po dmar nag khyung zhon zhes bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med du sgrub pas byin rlabs dang dngos grub lhag par du che ba yin te/ gzhung las/ ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: chos pa rnams kyang chos gzugs rtags 'dzin tsam: nyams len snying rus smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra: yi dam mi sgrub rgyal 'gong the'u rang bsgrub: de yis rkyen byas stong khams ru trar skye: yi dam mi dgyes ri rab logs la gzigs: steng 'og 'khrugs shing nad mtshon char pa g.yo: chos rgyal bris pa'i ri mo shul rjes smra: ma 'ongs de dus 'gro mang skyob pa yi: yang zab snying thig mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya can: bla ma drag po sgrub pa'i las tshogs 'di: gzhan las khyad 'phags yid bzhin nor bu'i lam: tshig nyung don che myur zab snying gi byang : yang gsang 'di 'dra gzhan la sbas pa med: mtshan skar mang yang nyin mo'i skar ma gcig: me tog mang yang u dum+ba ra gcig: sems can mang yang sa bcu'i sangs rgyas gcig: sgrub skor mang yang snying gi thig le gcig: zab rgya mang yang gnad kyi gzer bu gcig: de phyir mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod ma gtogs par: yang zab gcig dril 'di 'dra shin tu dkon: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu'i lha sngags la bsten pa skal ba re bzang snyam pas/ bla ma la mos gus/ yi dam la dad spro/ mched lcam la gdung shugs/ le lo spang ba'i brtson 'grus brtan po'i sgo nas/ phyi ma hā yo ga ltar thabs kyi brjod bya thams cad rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor steng du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/

nang a nu yo ga ltar shes rab rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad phung khams skye mched rtsa rlung thig le'i dkyil 'khor du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ gsang ba a ti yo ga ltar bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen thams cad kyi rim pa rnams gnyis med zung 'jug tu gtan la phab cing*/ de gsum po re re la yang thag bcad pa/ la dor ba/ sa bzung ba gsum bskyed rdzogs gung shing dgu la brten nas nyams su len tshul rgya cher gsungs pa las/ da lam phyi'i dkyil 'khor la gtso cher brten te sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa nyams su len pa'i skabs 'dir/ bsnyen sgrub brtson pa yongs kyi rnam pa gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pa'i sgo nas yul gsum rab tu gsal nas lha gyad du gyur pa'i sku yi sgrub lugs/ lus kyis phreng ba/ ngag gis snying po/ yid kyis lha sngags ting nge 'dzin te bzla tshul gsum gyi sgo nas/ sngags dang sngags kyi gzhi/ gzungs dang gzungs kyi sgo/ rig pa dang rigs sngags kyi don shes pas 'phro 'du'i phreng ba dang bcas gsung gi sgrub lugs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dgongs pa thig le nyag gcig ngang rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin la ma yengs pa'i gnad med na 'bras bu 'byin mi nus pas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams sems sangs rgyas su shar bas lam la bgrod du med par shes/ snod bcud dkyil 'khor du shar bas 'bras bu rang byung lhun rdzogs su shes/ sdug bsngal bde chen du shar bas snang ba sna tshogs chos nyid du khyer shes/ nyon mongs ye shes su shar bas spang blang dgag sgrub rang sar grol ba'i gnad shes/ rnam rtog chos nyid du shar bas chos sku rang la ye nas gnas pa'i don shes pa ste shes pa rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rnal 'byor 'bring rnams/ stong gsum lha'i gzhal yas su gsal bas dkyil 'khor la che chung dang yangs dogs med/ phung khams lha ru gsal bas bar chad gdon bgegs kyi yul dang bral/

snod kyi 'jig rten gtor snod du gsal bas mchod gtor la bzang ngan gyi mtshan 'dzin med/ snang srid thams cad rdzas su gsal bas srung ma dam can mi dgyes pa'am mi skong ba'i skyon zad/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid du gsal ba la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma lus pa rang sems su rdzogs pa ste/ gsal ba rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos la/ bskyed rim rtag brtan ther zug tu bzung bas lha 'grub pa'i dus med/ phrin las gyer la sgom med du bzung bas gsang sngags dam med lto phyir bon gyer du song*/ sngags dang snying po rang rgyud par bzung bas byin rlabs dang nus pa'i rgyu med/ rdzas dang gtor chung bshos bur bzung zhing za 'dod dang brnab sems kyi 'bras bu'i dkor dang rnam smin gyi 'dam du chud/ 'bras bus 'jig rten rtag chad du bzung bas ru tra'i gol sar ltung ba ste sngags pa tha ma bzung ba lngas ma bcings ba ni gal che/ mdor na gsang sngags bla med la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ lta ba'i gdeng gis 'khor 'das rang sems su thag chod pa/ sgom pa'i nyams kyis snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba/ spyod pa brtul zhugs kyis gang byung lam du longs pa zhig dgos shing*/ de yang bskyed rdzogs gang gi skabs su yang blos bcos nas bsgom pa ni dpe/ gdod nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni don te/ sems nyid 'gag med kyi 'char sgo thams cad bskyed rim/ ngo bo stong nyid du khrig ger gnas pa rdzogs rim/ de gnyis gsar du bsre ma dgos pa/ gdod nas tsan+dan dang dri/ nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du 'bral med zung 'jug tu gnas pa/ ngo bo gsal stong gnyis su med pa ni don/ rang bzhin phung khams skye mched du shar ba gdod nas lha'i 'khor lor dag pa'i brda/ de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i phyir lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du phyed pa gzhi rtags te/ snang srid gzhir bzhengs su rang byung gi dkyil 'khor zhes mngon sum gyi rim gnyis thams cad de'i khongs su ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad de ltar nges pa dang*/

rgyud las/ don grub dngos grub thob pa ni/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa gtso cher sngags bzla ba la'ang*/ bum dbang dang mthun par phyi rtsol bcas tshig 'bru'i sngags/ gsang dbang dang mthun par nang lhun grub rang byung gi sngags/ sher dbang dang mthun par gsang ba skye med rdo rje'i sngags/ dbang bzhi pa dang mthun par de kho na nyid spros bral brjod med kyi sngags rnams dbang po dang mthun par nyams su len par gsungs shing*/ rtsol bcas kyi sngags la'ang spro bsdus bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ 'gog bzlas sogs yod de/ ji skad du/ ting 'dzin me dang 'dra ba la/ /bzlas brjod rlung dang 'dra bas bskul/ zhes ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pa ni bud shing dang me'i sa bon rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa la/ gsang sngags skyon dang bral ba'i bzlas brjod byed pa ni rlung gi dper mdzad pas me dang bud shing 'dzoms par rlung gis bskul na lhag par 'bar ba bzhin ting nge 'dzin dang sngags bzla ba 'dzoms pas bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu shin tu myur ba'i thabs kyi mchog yin zhing*/ de yang ngag bzlas skabs rin chen phreng ba las/ bzlas pa byed tshe long gtam kyal ka dang*/ khro dang 'thab dang shags dang 'jug 'dzin dang*/ /zhum dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnam par spangs/ /smra dang rnam rtog spros pa rnam par bcad/ /lha dang sngags las gzhan la mi bsam mo/ zhes pa ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon kyang de nyid las/ lan gcig tsam la sngags brjod na/ /'das dang 'byung dang 'byung gang yin/ /gang gi lce la smra 'gyur ba/ /de dbang bden pa thob par 'gyur/ zhes sngags kyi bden pa 'grub pas bstan srung mthu/ tshe mthud bu/ zang zing nor/ mchog gi dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par gsungs la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pas dgra gsum sod/ bdud bzhi choms/ 'gro drug gi g.yang sa chod/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga mngon du 'gyur bas dad brtson drag pos gzhan du ma yengs par/

snang ba lha/ lha rang sems/ sems stong nyid/ grags stong sngags kyi rol par shes pa'i ngang gzhung nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du la rtse gcig nyams su len par zhu/ ༈ sgrub pa grol skabs phan yon dang 'brel ba'i mar me'i smon lam ni/ de ltar bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi spros bcas sgrub chen gyi tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin tshang la bar chad med par mtha' rgyas su grub ste/ de yang spyir o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i snying po gter gyi chos la dad pa thams cad/ gu ru nyid bod du phebs pa'i skabs su zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gsungs te/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pad+ma'i chos la dad pa kun: deng sang gu ru'i zhal mthong smon lam btab: thams cad las can yin pas dga' ba sgoms: kho mo'i tshig 'di rin chen gser las dkon: zhes gsungs pas gzhung tshad ldan nas gsungs pa tshul bzhin nyams su len pa rnams gu ru nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rol rtsal yin pa'ang gsungs te/ dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la: gzhung bzhin su dang su yis spyod pa kun: thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin par nges: ma 'ongs kun gyis yid gnyis the tshom spongs: gus pas bkur bsti phu dud 'brel pa zhog: ces dang*/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ gsang sngags don gyi snying po 'di kho na: sgrub chen 'di yi ming tsam su gang 'dzin: o rgyan nga dang snying khrag gcig tu 'dres: zhes dang*/ pad+ma nga yi srog gi dwangs ma ste: dus gsum rgyal ba'i srog snying 'di kho na: dus gsum rgyal ba spyi sgrub 'di ka zab: 'di 'chang o rgyan nga dang 'bral ba med: rig 'dzin brgyad 'dus dam can bran du khol: yang zab snying po mar gyi nying khu dang :

dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus pa: thams cad thams cad ma lus 'dis 'grub ste: de la dus gsum rgyal ba spyi sgrub yin: tshig tshogs mang bas mi zab don la 'di: o rgyan nga yis thugs bcud min re kan: zhes dang*/ yang gu ru'i zhal nas/ nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong*/ /nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin/ zhes gsungs pas na the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed par bsgrubs na smos ci/ tha na glegs bam tsam dad pa'i rten du bzung yang*/ gsang ba'i rgyud chen sgrub yig gang sus 'dzin/ /de phyogs thams cad bde gshegs kun 'dus te/ /sha rul dag la sbrang ma ji bzhin no/ zhes gsungs la/ der ma zad yang dag /gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ phur pa/ phyag rdor/ rig 'dzin bla ma sogs re re'i mtshan tsam 'dzin pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i phan yon rgya cher gsungs pa thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor 'di la 'dus shing*/ de thams cad go cha'i dkyil 'khor du rdzogs tshul yang*/ dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje 'jigs: mgrin par dbang chen rta mgrin gshe: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje gtum: lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu 'bar: gsang bar yak+sha khro bo brjid: phyag g.yas badz+ra kī la ya: phyag g.yon rat+na kī la ya: zhabs g.yas pad+ma kī la ya: zhabs g.yon karma kī la ya: gsang ba yum gyi gnas lnga ru: bde chen mkha' 'gro sde bzhis gar: gzhon nu rgyan rdzogs cha lugs 'chang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin yi dam sgrub sde brgyad sogs thams cad 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing bla ma yi dam kun 'dus 'di lta bu'i sgrub pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa rang gis lo gsum mtshams dam du bcad pa las kyang tshom bu tshogs sgrub zhag bdun phan yon che ste/ rgyud chen gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dad brtson drag pos sgrub gyur na/ /mtshams med lnga po spyad pas kyang*/ /dngos grub thob pa gsang sngags khyad/ /dam ldan rnams la smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs/

'di lta bu'i phan yon 'byung ba mi bden sogs bsam mi rung ste/ 'di phyogs the tshom za ba'i mi gang su/ /tshe 'dir yid du mi 'ong kun 'dus nas/ /mnar med rdo rje'i dmyal te der 'gro bas/ /kun gyi thun mong ma yin gsang dam srungs/ zhes kyang gdams par mdzad cing*/ mdor na mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i thabs su lan gcig ma yin par rdo rje'i lung gis yang yang bsngags pa yin la/ phan yon de ldan gyi sgrub pa legs par grub pa la dga' spro dad mos yid ches dang ldan pas slad nas kyang rdo rje rgyal po dang rgyal thebs/ gzungs ma mched lcam dkyil 'khor gcig tu tshogs shing mar me gcig la bltas pa thams cad gcig gis gcig la khong khro nga rgyal sgro skur sogs kyis dam tshig la sel bslad ma zhugs par lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du blta dgos pa dang*/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar du dam tshig rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud gcig tu sbrel ba rnam kun 'du 'bral med pa srog gis bsdus pa'i lha'i tshom bu 'khod cing*/ tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi dge ba'i las chen po bsags pa'ang don yod par bgyi ba'i slad mar me'i smon lam bgyid pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de yang rdzong 'phrang las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi spros pa med pa'i dbyings/ /thig le chen po ma bcos lhun grub ngang*/ /skye 'gag med pa byang chub sems kyi don/ /ye shes mar me'i sdong rtsar shar ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dngos po'i gzugs dang bral ba/ khyad chos drug ldan ye shes kyi 'od phung du 'bar zhing gzhon nu bum pa sku'i tshul du bzhugs pa ni mtshon bya don gyi mar me/ gzhi las gzhi snang du g.yos te/ lhun grub rang snang gi sgo nas shar lugs chen po brgyad kyis 'khor 'das sna tshogs su snang ba mtshon pa brda yi mar me/ 'di la dbye ba snang tshul snod kun gzhi'i kong bu ru/

bcud rnams shes kyi phung po'i sdong bu la/ gnas lugs chos dbyings ye shes kyi mar khus gtams nas rig pa rang gsal gyi sgron me sbar bas lam gzhi snang sku dang ye shes kyi 'od snang 'phro bas/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje'i rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod dbyings rig dbyer med kyi kong bur/ bcud gzugs phung ma dag gi sdong bu la/ me long ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te shes rab rang byung gi sgron me sbar bas lam chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang bas/ 'bras bu rnam snang gi rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod ka ti shel gyi kong bu ru/ bcud tshor phung rnam dag gi sdong bu la/ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sgron mes gtams te/ lam rgyang zhags 'od gsal gyi mar me sbar bas lam nyams snang gong 'phel gyis/ 'bras bu rin chen gyi rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod 'ja' zer thig le'i kong bur/ bcud 'du shes rnam dag gi sdong bu la/ sor rtog ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te/ dag pa dbyings kyi sgron me sbar bas/ lam rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang bas/ 'bras bu gsung pad+ma'i rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod gzhon nu'i bum sku'i kong bur bcud 'du byed rnam dag gi sdong bu btsugs te/ bya grub ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te thig le stong pa'i sgron me sbar bas/ lam chos nyid zad pa'i snang bas/ 'bras bu las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam bskangs pas/ rgyu sku dang ye shes/ rkyen 'od dang kha dog /byed las sgron ma bzhir smin te 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus su 'od gsal thig le chen po dang*/ spyi bo nas rtog pa med pa'i sku 'char ba ni mtshon byed rtags kyi mar me ste/ de dag rten cing 'brel 'byung gi dbang las snang gsal mar me 'di yis mtshon byed du byas/ ye shes chen po'i snang bas nyon mongs kyi mun khang bcom/ rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sgo rtsad nas bcad/ rdo rje khro rgyal rnams kyi zhal mthong*/

rang rgyud snang ba bzhi yi shul mtshon/ rig stong khyab brdal chen pos rgyab skyor/ rang grol spyod pa cog bzhag gis mtha' brten te bgrod par bya ba'i lam lnga dang sa bcu bgrod du med pa'i tshul gyis dwangs srog thig le chen por srid pa gsum po yongs su dag pa 'od zer 'phrul bzhad kyi klong dam par bgrod nas chos thams cad bya rtsol gnyis med kyi klong du gdod nas skye 'gag 'pho 'gyur bral ba gzhi rdzogs lhun grub chen por gdeng chen thob/ dbugs chen 'byin/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i thugs 'dun rtse gcig pa mdzad nas smon lam gyi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog

sogs shis brjod rgyas par spel bas las mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /spros bcas tshogs sgrub chen po'i phyag bzhes kun/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i man ngag kho na'i don/ /mtshon byed stong thun snying po 'di tsam yang*/ /blo ldan mkhas pa'i mdun sar gser ltar brim/ /de phyir gong ma'i gsung gi snang ba la/ /brten nas gsar spros tshig gi me tog 'dis/ /dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar 'bum 'jo bas/ /rig 'dzin 'dus mang zung 'jug mngon gyur shog /ces bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi /spros bcas sgrub chen gyi stong thun rab 'jigs khro bo rol pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang tshul 'dir mi 'phrog pa'i dad mos rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i 'brong smad bla ma karma lung rigs rgya mtsho dang*/ 'brong pa rdo shul du skyes pa'i sgrub bla gi li o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul zung nas 'di ltar dgos zhes nan bskul ngor/ gnam lcags bstan 'dzin ming pas rigs kun khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i dpal chen 'dus pa'i stong thun la gzhi byas nas 'phros don kha bsgyur bcas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu mo lug gi lo rgyal zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes la grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang snying po'i bstan pa ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ thig chen lag len blo la 'dzin bde bzhugs so/ dkyil 'khor thig gi lag len bshad/ /de yang slob dpon slob ma gnyis/ /yab dang yum du btags pa yi/ /so so phyag rgya mtshon pa'i phyir/ /yab kyi rdo rje yum dril bu/ /'dzin bzhin dkyil 'khor stegs bu yi/ /nub nas slob dpon shar tu blta/ /de bzhin slob ma shar nas nub/ /bltas la 'khod par slob dpon gyi/ /thig skud nub nas slob mar gtad/ /slob dpon gyi ni dpral ba dang*/ /slob mas snying khar bzung byas la/

/mtheb srin sbyar ba'i 'debs tshul dang*/ /se gol dang bcas ngag tu yang*/ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal la phaṭaḥ zhes/ brjod la nam mkhar 'debs tshul bya/ /thig la tshang thig zur gyi thig /log thig gsum gyi dang po ni/ /slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar/ /tshang thig dang po gdab par bya/ /slob dpon lho la slob ma byang*/ /tshang thig gnyis pa zhes su brjod/ /rgyab 'gros dang bcas g.yas bskor 'gro/ /gnyis pa zur thig rnam gnyis la/ /rgyab 'gros mi dgos g.yas bskor tshul/ /slob dpon shar lho slob ma ni/ /nub byang gnas pa'i dang po gdab/ /slob dpon lho nub slob ma ni/ /byang shar gnas pa'i gnyis pa'o/ gsum pa shar lho nub byang gi /logs kyi thig bzhi gdab tshul ni/ /slob dpon shar lho'i phyogs su bzhengs/ /slob ma byang shar la gnas pas/ /shar gyi logs thig dang po gdab/ /de bzhin slob dpon nub byang la/ /slob ma lho nub nub thig gdab/ /slob dpon nub byang gnas bzhin du/ /slob ma byang shar byang thig gdab/ slob dpon shar lho slob ma ni/ lho nub gnas pa'i lho thig te/ 'debs tshul rgyab 'gros snga ma mtshungs/ /de yi thig chen 'debs tshul song*/ /mthar ni slob dpon slob ma gnyis/ /nub dang shar du thog ma bzhin/ /'khod nas thig skud slob dpon gyi/ /phyogs su bsdus pa'i re zhig tshang*/ /'di yang slob dpon bsod rdor gyis/ /bka' stsal bskul ngo ma ldog tsam/ /rang 'dra'i blun po 'ga' zhig la/ /phan pa'i sems kyi gu h+yas bris/ ༈ slar yang thig rtsa mdor bsdus bshad/ slob dpon slob ma rim pa bzhin/ nub shar lho byang tshangs thig dang*/ me rlung srin dbang zur thig gnyis/ me dbang rlung srin shar nub logs/ /rlung dbang me srin byang dang lho'i/ logs te tshangs logs rgyab 'gros dang*/ zur la de spangs g.yas kho na'i/ 'gro ste thig chen brgyad po tshang*/ slob dpon nub nas srad bu bsdu/ shar lho me la lho nub srin/

nub byang rlung la byang shar dbang*/ zhes brjod slob dpon dbang phyogs dang*/ slob ma'i me 'tshams spang ba yin/ thig chen rtsa tshig mdor bsdus lags/ zhes kyang gnam lcags gu h+yeso/ ༄༅/ /bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi/ sgrub pa'i khog dbub dngos grub nyi ma 'gugs pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ snang mtha'i rol gar bla ma'i bla ma rig 'dzin kun dngos pad+ma 'byung*/ /sku yi cha la sgrub sde brgyad 'dus yi dam yongs 'dus me phreng can/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro yongs kyi tshogs rje bde chen sgyu ma'i rol gar mkhan/ /skyabs gnas rtsa gsum ma lus kun 'dus pad+ma drag pos shis pa stsol/ /steng du gtum chen khyung gi dmag dpung sprin ltar bsdus pas steng gdon 'byung po mthar zhing bcom/ /dbang chen khros pa lcags sdig tshwa tshwa ser ltar 'dril bas rgyal 'gong dam sri hab hab za/ /nā ga rak+sha dug gi phag rgod mun ltar 'thibs pas 'og gdon sa bdag thal bar brlag /drag sngags me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas nad yams sreg mdzad gnyen po stobs 'dus khyod min su/ de slad srid zhi'i phan bde yi/ /dngos grub nyi ma 'gugs pa'i bang*/ /sgrub pa'i khog dbub dam pa'i srol/ /skya rengs snang ba 'dir gsal bya/ de yang gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud lung man ngag rnams su che thang du bsngags shing dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag tu 'grub par byed pa'i thabs zab rmad du byung ba tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i lag len pra khrid gzhung so so las mang du 'byung ba ltar/ rang lugs rtsa gsum spyir 'jug 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes 'khyer bde don gsal du bzhugs kyang rang 'dra'i blo rmongs rnams kyi gzhung so so dang zhi drag sogs kha bsgyur tshul bzhin mi shes pa dang nor 'khrul 'byung bar dogs te 'dir bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung kho na'i dbang du byas te nag 'gros su bkod pa la/

phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba/ rjes las kyi rim pa mtha' rgyas su bya ba'o/ dang po ni gter kha phal mo cher/ ston pa gnas dang 'khor dang dus/ /yo byad la sogs bzhir ldan pa/ zhes 'chad pa mang yang*/ 'dir gsang sngags lam rim ltar na/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga ni/ dang po sgrub pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rang gter las/ dwangs shing snang ba dben pa'i gnas: phun tshogs zla gam dbang phug tu: dmar zhing dwangs pa'i sa gzhi la: dal bcag thig gdab dkyil 'khor bri: zhes gu ru rin po che dang grub thob du mas byin gyis brlabs la/ dben pa nyams dga' zhing dam nyams sde 'khrug sogs grib kyis ma gos pa'o/ gnyis pa dus ni/ rgyal ba'i dus chen bzhi/ ra ba bzhi'i yar ngo*/ yar mar tshes bcu rnams dang ma 'dzoms na gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba la'o/ gsum pa sgrub pa po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rgyal thebs gzungs mas gtso bor gyur pa'i ston 'khor thams cad so so'i mtshan nyid gzhung mthun dgos par gsungs kyang*/ spyi tsam du bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi dbang lung rdzogs par thob cing bsnyen pa las rung du byas pas bsgrub bya la the tshom med cing dad pa rtse gcig dang ldan pa/ sgrub pa po nang phan tshun dam sel gtan nas med pa zhig gal che'o/ bzhi pa yo byad ni/ rab dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang*/ 'bring ras bris tshad ldan med thabs med cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgrub rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ rgyan rdzas la sogs pa dam tshig gi yo byad thams cad tshags su tshud par bya'o/ lnga pa sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ yid ches rtsod bral gyi zab chos brgyud pa drug ldan gyi khyad par du byas pa zab mo gter ma las byon cing de yang dam sel 'dres khyer gyis ma bslad pas rgyud lung man ngag khungs btsun gyi dgongs pa dang mthun zhing 'khrul pa med pa/

byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa ste phun sum tshogs pa lnga'o/ gnyis pa bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i las rim mo/ dang po la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi dpung bskyed pa/ sa yi cho ga bya ba'o/ dang po la rang rgyud sbyong ba/ chos 'khor bskor ba/ gtor ma gtong ba/ sbyin gtong bya ba bzhi/ de re re la'ang bzhi bzhir 'byung ste/ dang po ni lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang phyir sāts+tsha gdab pa/ nye'u 'don pa/ srog bslu/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs kyi khrus bya ba/ ngag sgrib sbyang phyir/ na rag dong sprugs dang yig brgya bzlas pa/ yid sgrib sbyang phyir sems bskyed blang ba dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa/ gzhan yang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa/ lus ngag yid gsum ka'i phyir du phyag skor dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la tshogs skong rgya cher bya/ gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid kyi don rtogs phyir sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin/ bdud gzhom phyir lhor stobs po che/ rgyu 'bras go phyir nub tu lang kar gshegs pa/ bar chad zhi phyir byang du tog gzungs dang grwa nga bklag /gsum pa ni/ byin rlabs 'byung phyir dkon mchog sri zhu yi mgron dang*/ phrin las bcol phyir yon tan/ 'byor pa 'thob phyir snying rje/ bu lon 'khor phyir lan chags kyi mgron rnams la/ phyi chu gtor dang mdos glud/ nang gtor ma/ gsang ba lus kyi mchod sbyin bya bar gsungs so/ bzhi pa ni/ dngos su snang ba'i mgron la dngos 'byor ci rigs pas mnyes shing tshim par byed pa ste/ bla ma dang dge 'dun rje dpon dang yon tan can nad pa dang dbul phongs bya rigs chu gnas bu lon lan chags pa dang*/ mi mdza' ba rnams yon dang bza' btung ci 'byor stob la sgrub pa mthar phyin cing bar chad med pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ gnyis pa sa yi cho ga la lnga/ brtag pa/ bslang ba/ dbang du bya ba/ sbyang ba bzung zhing bsrung ba'o/

dang po ni/ sa yi mtshan nyid dang*/ rten 'brel/ lto 'phye brtag pa rnams te/ sgrub gnas rnying pa la mi dgos so/ gnyis pa snang ba mi las bslangs zin pa'i dbang du byas te/ mi snang bar bslang ba la gnyis/ sa lha dang mi min yul bdag spyi la'o/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gzhi stegs byi dor byas par tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum mtheb ril gyis mtshan pa gnyis dang*/ gser skyems/ mtha' skor byang shar mtshams 'dzin me tog nas brtsam chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas bskor du bkod/ bdag bskyed la mkho ba'i phyi nang gi mchod gtor gang dgos phug logs lta bur bshams shing 'og gi skabs so sor dgos pa'i yau byad rnams kyang tshags su tshud par bya'o/ de nas thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor bya ba'am lugs 'ga' zhig tu sku gtso rkyang dran rdzogs su bskyed nas bzlas pa brgya rtsa byas pas chog pa'ang yod kyang*/ 'dir rgyas bsdus kyi mthar ma lhung ba rang lugs ltar na/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyis rgyud sbyang bar gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas/ ma bcos lhun grub ngang nyid du: rang byung dran rdzogs 'di ltar bsgom: oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gdod ma'i stong nyid ngang las snying rje'i rtsal: hūm̐ dmar 'od kyis 'phro 'dus snod bcud sbyangs: stong gsal ngang las rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang : dur khrod rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas dbus: pad nyi dregs pa rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i steng : sa bon khra thabs tshul du babs pa las: che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po rtsal: dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar khro zhing gtum: spyan gsum sdang mig sma ra smin ma gzengs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra sgrogs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes snang srid zil gyis gnon:

g.yon pas phur pa ma rungs snying la gzir: lcags sdig tshwa tshwas dam 'gong hub hub za: dbu gtsug rta mgo rdo rje dbyings su 'tsher: 'jigs pa'i gad mos stong gsum 'gul zhing 'khyom: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du rngam: gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: drag me dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong na rol: spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med pas mtshan: sku la zhi khro rab 'byams sprin phung 'phro: gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge gsal zhing 'bar: thugs ka'i 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ rak+sha srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas: stong gsum dregs pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po'i skur bzhengs nas: ma rungs log 'dren 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hrīḥ pad+ma kro dha he ru ka e h+ya hi hrīṃ hrīṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: bskyed pa'i dam tshig rten la gnyis med bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pa'i brda yis dad phyag 'tshal: drag po'i nyer spyod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs phyag rgya'i gar gyis mchod: shrī he ru ka badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs? pañca a mṛ ta ta na ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bzlas pa sngags kyi 'phro 'du ni: thugs kar pha lam rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: sngags phreng dus mtha'i me lce 'bar ba yis: dregs pa tshar bcad rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs nus stobs bdag thim gnyis med gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ pad+ma he ru ka artsig nirtsig sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes nyer gcig bzlas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ mthar bsdu ldang bya/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas gsal gdab cing*/ ha ha: hūm̐ hūm̐: ho ho: phaiṃ phaiṃ: de nas khro bo'i gad rgyangs sa gsum rab tu g.yo ba bsgrags par bsam/

hoḥ de ring bkra shis dus tshes bzang : rten 'brel kun gyi mgo yang legs: gnas bdag yul 'dzin phun sum 'tshogs: mi shigs pho brang sa 'dul lo: mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab: hūm̐: mdun du ri rab gling bzhi'i dbus: skyon bral pad+ma'i lte ba zlum: sa yi lha mo bstan ma ser: bum 'dzin pus btsugs gus pa'i tshul: 'khor du sa 'dzin bcu gnyis bcas: rang mdog phyogs mthun rgyan chas gsal: thugs srog laṃ las 'od 'phros pas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang rang gdan la dgyes par bzhugs: om̐ baṃ laṃ bhū mi pa ti badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ri rab rol mtsho bcud kyi bdag: sa la gnas pa'i lha mo che: sa 'dzin bcu gnyis bran g.yog 'khor: mchog gsum rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rin chen gser gyi sa mchog stsol: de ring dbang chen dkyil 'khor 'debs: bdag gi zhi rgyas dbang drag gis: phrin las bya ba gang bcol yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog dang : gdug pa'i sdang sems zhi gyur nas: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rogs dan dang : lo legs 'bru 'phel nad yams zhi: khyed cag sa mchog 'di phul mthus: mngon rdzogs rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur: de ltar bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ces gtor ma phul la sa gnon gyis rgyas gdab/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par bsam/ zhi rol bcas gtor ma phyir phul/ gnyis pa ni/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ s+d+yā na pa ti k+ṣe ṭa pa la lañca na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: shar lho nub byang la gnas pa'i/ /sa 'dzin sde dpon bcu gnyis dang*/ /spar kha sme ba lo skor dang*/ /gza' khyim dus 'gyu zhag gi lha/ /lha klu phyogs skyong sde brgyad dang*/ /'byung ba'i sde brgyad gzhi bdag la/ /gser skyems gtor ma 'di 'bul bas/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig /sa rko ri bshig brag bsgyel zhing*/ /chu rlung me 'gyed zor 'phang dang*/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las gang yang*/ legs nyes bya ba gang byas kyang*/ ko long spangs shing rogs dan mdzod/ /gal te phrag dog sdang gyur tshe/ /bdag nyid khyung chen khro rgyal gyis/ /ri rab bsnyil zhing rgya mtsho dkrug /klu dang sa bdag dregs pa'i rigs/ /rdul du brlag par gdon mi za/ /de bas dam srungs phrin las mdzod/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa ma ya ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gāts+tsha/ gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing*/ 'jam rol dang bcas gtor ma dang gser skyems phyir 'bul/ mchod pa rnams bsdu'o/ gsum pa dbang du bya ba ni/ stegs kyi mdun nas slob dpon gyis dbang mchog gi phur bu bzung*/
