bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phur bu la thim: de nyid dpal rta mgrin gyi skur gyur par bsams la/ hrī pad+ma ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btab ste lan bdun bzlas pas/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar pos sa gzhi thams cad khyab/ bdag gis dbang du gyur par bsam mo/ bzhi pa sbyang ba la/ sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga ser por bsams nas/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas te stegs bu'i steng du bzhag /thams cad kyi rdo rje dang bcas lag g.yas sa la reg pa'i tshul byas nas/ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ lan gsum gyis sa la bsnun/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyong ba ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ phra mo grangs med pa phyogs bcur 'phros: 'phags pa mchod sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs: rnam dag ye shes kyi zhing khams chen por gyur: ces mos/ lnga pa bzung ba dang bsrung ba gnyis las/ dang po bgegs gtor byin brlab cing sngags kyis bsngo/ las byang ltar bka' bsgo zhing mtshams bcad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhengs te las phur thogs la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu spros pa'i tshogs kyis sa gzhi gang bar gyur/ phur bu rnams stod zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu 'dril ba/ smad lcags phur me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur/ phur pa bsgril zhing*/ hūm̐: sngon tshe sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: 'og min rdo rje'i pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang gis: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rngam stabs kyis: drag sngags me yis stong khams khengs: ma rig nyon mongs sa sri btul: dbyings phyug mi 'gyur sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no:

de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: che mchog khrag 'thung khro rgyal gyis: bdud po mgo gsum btul ba'i tshe: drag sngags rdo rje'i char chen phab: bar gyi 'jig rten sa sri btul: gsang chen rmang btings sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: klu srin sa bdag kha rlangs las: rims nad sa sri 'dul ba'i tshe: sprul pa'i bya khyung me gshog gyis: klu srin ma rungs sa bdag 'joms: 'og gi ma rungs sa sri btul: rlung ri rdo rje'i sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas su: lha 'dre ma rungs dam la btags: bod khams gling bzhi'i sa sri btul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i rmang gzhi btsugs: de ring gsang ba'i sa 'dzin no: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kyi 'gros stabs kyis: shar gyi sa sri dam la btags: shar phyogs zhi ba'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba shing gi srung mkhar btsugs: shar gyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi 'gros stabs kyis: lho yi sa sri dam la btags: lho phyogs rgyas pa'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba me yi srung mkhar btsugs: lho yi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yon tan ma mo'i 'gros stabs kyis: nub kyi sa sri dam la btags: nub phyogs dbang gi pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba chu yi srung mkhar btsugs: nub kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa'i 'gros stabs kyis: byang gi sa sri dam la btags: byang phyogs drag po'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba lcags kyi srung mkhar btsugs: byang gi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yang dag khrag 'thung 'gros stabs kyis: dbus kyi sa sri dam la btags: dbus phyogs che mchog pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba rlung gi srung mkhar btsugs: dbus kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: ces phur pa 'debs shing*/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

lan gsum/ phur bu las 'phros pa'i khro chung dang me 'od kyis sa gzhi khengs par gyur: hūm̐: steng du nam mkha'i 'khor lo phub: 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bcings: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rgya gram 'gros kyis sa bcag go /spro na 'dir stangs stabs dang bskor ba sogs rgyas bsdus gang rung bya'o/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ ye shes kyi lha bsnyen pa'i rim pa/ lha dang dbyer med du byed pa sgrub pa'i rim pa grub nas dngos grub len pa sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa'o/ dang po la bcu ste/ mtshams gsum rten bca' sta gon bya/ rgyan bkod mnga' gsol brda sbyar zhing*/ sri mnan bskos gdab byin 'bebs so/ zhes pa'i dang po phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyogs bzhir tho bzhi la rgyal chen so so'i sku'am sngags byang rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa btsugs la so so'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar gtor ma dkar zlum mdun mtheb skyu ril bus mtshan pa re dang*/ de yi mdun du g.yon phyogs nas brtsam pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bcas bshams/ sgrub pa po rnams rol chas sogs ser sbreng gi tshul gyis sgrub khang nas don te shar gyi tho mdun du 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas pi waṃ du gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa dri za'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: bar gyis mchod/ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung : lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur tshe: dri za 'bum dang me lhas bskor: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis shar phyogs dung sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs par: srung zhing shar gyi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ badz+ra bh+rūm̐ bi pa la rā dza badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ lho yi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ral grir gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa gshin rje'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: om̐ bi rū dha kā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po: 'dzam bu gling la dbang bsgyur tshe: gshin rje 'bum dang grul bum bskor: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis lho phyogs gser sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing lho yi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ ār+ya gu li rā dza rat+na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas sbrul zhags su gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa klu yi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

ri rab kyi nub phyogs nas rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang : ba glang spyod la dbang bsgyur tshe: klu dbang 'bum dang rlung lha bcas: mos bzhi dbang sgyur mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis nub phyogs zangs sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing nub kyi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ tsak+ṣu mu ta rā dza pad+ma āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ byang gi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ne'u ler gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las rnam thos sras ljang gu ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin gyi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: rtsa sngags mthar/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur tshe: gnod sbyin 'bum dang dbang ldan bcas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis byang phyogs lcags sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing byang gi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā rā dza karma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐:

zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya'o/ gnyis pa bar mtshams la gnyis/ dam sri mnan pa sgo byang gdab pa'o/ dang po ni/ stobs chen ma hā ba la'i lto bar khro zhal nang du liṅga bri ba dang bskyed pa sogs gsungs kyang spyir btang du dug shog la dam sri liṅga bya mchu can yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i snying khar dza tri na tri dza kha sprod mthar mgrin pa nas brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pa/ yamadamasriyamaparimāradzadzaḥ nananan/ tri'utri'umārayanamashodzaḥ khuganan/ zhes dang gzugs kyi mthar yig mgo nang du bstan la/ dusadrugadangabacurargyuba'inyulaledamasrirgyala'agonga'abyungapo'itshogasadangabacasapa'ilusangagayidagasumamathustobasathamasacadanonacig bskalapastongagibaradumaldangazhig om̐lam̐hūm̐lam̐satwaṃbhayanan/ zhes pa rnams kyi mthar dza khram gyis bskor ba bris la/ 'grub na sgrub pa'i snga nyin ltar phur pa sogs drag po'i phrin las btang ba'i tshogs tha ma'i gdab kha dang 'brel bar 'gugs stim grangs mang byas la thun gdab zhes pa 'di sta gon gyi nyin snga mar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i ling khrus dang 'gugs gzhug drag po byas la/ ling lteb sogs snga tshags tshud par bya dgos pa yin no/ de'i tshul zur du shes par bya'o/ mchan gang ltar yang*/ 'dre lteb tu bcag cing tshon skud kyis bcings/ thod ngan nam khyi thod lta bur bcug phung ras kyis dril la rtsang gis gzir ba'i mnan chas bya/ sgo drung du dong gru gsum brus pa la bkod/ de tsam mi 'grub pa'i skabs liṅga dong nang du btings/ slob dpon gyis gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par pad+ma khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed:

ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum la gser skyems phul/ de nas pad+ma khrag 'thung gsal gdab la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ e yaṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ mdun du las kyi gshin rje kha tham nag po sa rim pa dgu'i bdag po nag la 'jigs shing srog la rngam tshul can/ 'chi bdag kha shin tu gdangs pa'i nang du na nag po yongs su gyur pa las dug gi rus sbal nag po khang sgrom gyi dbyibs can/ de'i dbus su tri nag po las dam sri pho mo mdog mi sdug cing sngo ham pa mya ngan gyi gzugs can rid cing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i? khyad par bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i ya ma dam sri mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig tri yaṃ dzaḥtri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ de nas thun brdeg cing mnan pa ni/ hūm̐: sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer nas: 'chi bdag kha tham nag po bzhengs: nad rlangs dug gzer 'phro zhing bzhengs: za byed gdug pa'i khro zhal gdongs: 'joms byed rno ba'i sgrol mche gtsigs: 'jib byed g.yo ba'i dbal lce rkyongs: snyob byed 'chi bdag lag pa rkyongs:

dam nyams dgra bo las ngan dang : sgrub la bar gcod dam sri'i rigs: sgab 'dre yul 'dre rgyal 'gong dang : gson 'dre pho mo shi 'dre'i rigs: grib can la sogs gnod byed rnams: 'chi bdag gnod sbyin khyod la gtad: deng bzung bskal pa ma stongs bar: ma shor zungs shig lag ma shor: gal te shor ram btang srid na: bdag nyid gtum drag he ru kas: srid gsum bshig cing stong gsum 'gul: mthu chen drag rtsal rdul du brlag: de bas byang chub mchis kyi bar: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: om̐ tsaṇ+ḍa he ru ka ya ma rā dza kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: dam sri 'byung po waka thaṃ spur thaṃ nan: 'og gi 'don tshig dang bstun te skyer phur sor bzhi pa gdab/ thun rdzas brab/ gu gul bdug /dur rdo la ri rab gling bzhi dang rgya gram bris pas mnan la/ hūm̐: dam sri bya ba'i las ngan 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos: mched lcam rnams la gnod cing bskyal: rgyal khams kun tu mi dge btang : gsang sngags lam gyi sgo yang bkag: bka' 'das nam yang ma btang bas: da ni khro bo'i phur tshogs gdab: thun tshogs brdeg ste dud tshogs gtibs: gtub cing srin po'i zhal du bstab: ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan: zhes mthar 'bebs ring 'og tu sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum re dang sāts+tsha nag pos mnan/ hūm̐: gcig ni brjod med nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa phyag rgya bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun pa yan lag bdun gyi rgya: brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa khro rgyal bcu yi rgya: khyod la rgya bcus bcings te gdab: ri rab brjid pas steng nas mnan: dpa' bo'i bro ra byas te brdungs: bskal pa bye snyed mtha' ru mnan: om̐ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du khro rgyal 'khor bcas bzhugs par bsams la/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: mnan mnan ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bro: nam yang ma ldang las kyi bro: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul zhing shig: om̐ nan ā nan hūm̐ nan mā ra ya nan: mched lcam rnams srin lag lu gu rgyud du sbrel te las bzhi'i bro gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bro brdung hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod do/ gnyis pa sgo byang phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi'i sgo gong du ra yi sog pa'am ro ras la sogs par dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum la bya khyung sde lngas bskor ba snying po 'dod gsol bris pa dang skyer phur la snying po bris te rgyab tu btags pa bkod/ dmar gtor dang mchod yon sogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhan+dha'i snod du mchod lha dngos po'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par 'char bas nam mkha' gang bar gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar bar gtor rdzas om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ so so'i las sngags kyis bsang*/ om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang chen rta mchog pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar gdeng zhing g.yon pas lcags sgrog thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyi gseb nas rta skad 'tsher bas snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud cing zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril bas phung 'dre dam sri rgyal 'gong gi snying khrag gsol ba/ zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs kyis dam sri pho mo mnan cing*/ yum phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa mgul nas 'khyud pa/ 'jigs byed bya khyung rigs lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ sa bdag klu gnyan zil gyis gnon pa/ sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan cing me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na 'gyings pa'i gnas gsum om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ hrīḥpad+ma kro ta h+ya ghṛ ba hūm̐: lan bdun/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: sogs kyis mchod/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: dpal chen pad+ma dbang gi lha: che mchog yongs 'dus gtso bo che: las kyi khro bo mi bzad pa: bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms khrag 'thung sku: dmar nag rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril srid gsum g.yo: rab 'jigs gyad kyis dor stabs tshul: dbang sdud dmar mo gri thod 'dzin: 'jigs byed bya khyung sde lngas bskor: gser mig zangs rwa lcags sder bgrad: klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen po che: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i snying khrag 'thung : dbang chen dregs pa khro chen tshogs: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: bar sgo srung zhing gshegs mtshams chod: om̐ pad+ma ta kri ta h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra wā ra hī ga ru ṭa yak+sha badz+ra kro ta hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes lan gsum bzlas nas me tog 'thor zhing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya/ zhes phyi'i sgo srung gi gzugs cing sgrub khang sgo yi ya them la zla ba/ ma them la nyi ma/ g.yas su g.yung drung*/ g.yon du 'khor lo bris te bkod la/ hūm̐: steng phyogs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: 'og tu nyi ma'i sa gzhi bdal: g.yas su rlung gi g.yung drung la: g.yon du sa yi 'khor lo ste: 'byung ba'i kha sbyor srung ba'i gur: su yang bgrod par mi nus so: dam sri 'byung po mtshams chod cig: de nas nang sgo'i shing byang la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku sngags 'dod gsol skyer phur sngags ldan bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhan+dha'i snod du mchod lha dngos po 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par 'char bas nam mkha' gang ba gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar bar gtor rdzas om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur/

om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ so so'i las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag g.yas bum pa 'khor lo g.yon rgya gram thogs pa yum gri thod 'dzin pa sbyor te bzhengs pa'i gnas gsum du om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐: lan bdun/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: khro chen 'bar ba bdud rtsi 'khyil: dpal chen las kyi he ru kaḥ sngo sangs thabs shes phyag rgya yis: bum pa 'khor lo rgya gram 'dzin: mi zad zad med bdud rtsi 'khyil: dam tshig yum chen gri thod sbyor: khro bo'i rol stabs stangs stabs brjid: ye shes dam tshig mkha' 'gros bskor: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis sgo mtshams 'di srung zhing : dngos grub phyi ru ma gtong zhig: sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi mdzad cing : las kyi rtags rgya 'di srungs shig: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha ri ni sa baṃ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya'o/ sgo byang gnyis ma 'dzoms pa'am bsdu na phyi sgo'i rta mgrin kho nas chog go /sgo them gyi nang du brub khung zhig gi nang du zan ling la seng ldeng ngam skyer pa'i phur bu'i dbal la mi g.yo ba'i sngags dang*/ mgul du rgya shog la sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig ces bris te btags pas rgyas btab/ sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig: ces brjod/ gsum pa gsang mtshams la gnyis/ ma traṃ bsgral ba dang khro bcu'i phur gdab bo/ dang po rang rgyud kyi ma traṃ bdag 'dzin gyis 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i nga bdag bsgral ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir ma traṃ gi gzugs brnyan mgo lho nub tu bstan pa gan rkyal du bzhag

/stegs bu'i shar ngos slob dpon zhal nub tu phyogs te phyag tu g.yab dar dril bu bsnams nas stong thun zur gsal ltar bshad pa'i rjes su las sngags/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ pad+ma he ru ka artsig nirtsig sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brjod la/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skur gyur par bsam/ mnyam bzhag gi rgyas/ phaṭḥ kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rig pa ma 'gags 'gyu ba las: bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i ru tra byung : bag chags rim par brtsegs pa las: nga bdag nyon mongs las kyi rlung : ye shes sgrib pa'i gnod byed la: ma yengs dran pa'i lcags kyu yis: shes rig lta ba'i phur bus bsnun: gtub bo gcig chod sa ma ya: gtubs shig ka dag khregs chod mtshon: nga bdag ru tra dbyings su sgrol: ma ni 'khor 'das dbang chen gzhi: traṃ ni brdal khyab chos sku'i dal: ru ni ma bcos spros bral dbyings: tra ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg: ye grol chen po'i pho brang nas: zang thal rgya yan pho brang gsal: om̐ dharma dz+nyā na ma traṃ ru tra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces bdag lus ye nas gzhal yas khang du gsal: lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bcings te/ ma traṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ lan bdun brjod/ phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po stong gsum dang mnyam pa las kyi bsad khang de'i dbus su nad rlangs sngo dmar yam yam 'phro ba'i rnam pa can gyi nang du gnod byed mo 'dre gdon bgegs sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri'i rigs lus sngo ba ham pa red pa nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gsal bar gyur: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa gsum dkon mchog thugs rje'i bdag: rgyal sras rig 'dzin grub thob phyag rgya sngags: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bden pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub la bar gcod tshogs: 'byung po mi min gnod byed dam sri dang :

log 'dren gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus rnams: steng 'og phyogs bcu ri rab gling bzhi'i srang : ban bon lha srung skyabs 'og gar gnas kyang : rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di dag la: myur du khug cig rdo rje lcags kyu ma: chongs shig sdoms shig las byed zhags pa ma: gcun cig gzir cig mthu stobs lcags sgrog ma: myos shig gtor cig las byed ral gri ma: rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di la khug: om̐ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes bkug bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: mthing nag rab rngam tshwa tshwa 'phro: rdo rje gdeng zhing phur bu 'debs: dam sri gnod byed byad ma rnams: rdul phran bzhin du brlags par byed: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral zhing*/ ma hā de ba ru tra dza dzaḥhūm̐: zhes lan bdun bzla zhing thams cad kyi lag g.yas kyi sor mo gsum sbreng ba kha ṭ+wāṃ gyi rgyas snying khar bsnun tshul byas la/

gzugs phung hrul gyis zhig: ma rig sgo lnga'i sbubs dang bral: rnam shes tri nag por gnas pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis sbyangs pas hūm̐ yig dkar por gyur bdag gi thugs kar thim nas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ de nas snying dbus su dur khrod ma la ya: rtsib g.yas shar bsil ba tshal: mgo lho kī la rdzogs: rtsib g.yon nub laṅka brtsegs: gsang gnas byang pad+ma brtsegs: lag g.yon shar lho gsang chen rol: lag g.yas lho nub lhun grub gter: rkang g.yas nub byang 'jig rten brtsegs par gyur: rkang g.yon byang shar he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod gyur cing lha so so'i pho brang du gyur par bsams la/ hūm̐: ru tra bsgral ba'i g.yang gzhi la: dbang chen pho brang gzhi ru gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i lag pa g.yas: shar phyogs gtum drag dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i lag pa g.yon: lho phyogs gad rgyangs dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i rkang pa g.yon: nub phyogs tshang tshing dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i rkang pa g.yas: byang phyogs rab rgyu dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i mtshams bzhi 'di: ha ha rgod dang bsil ba tshal: rngam pa sgra sgrogs kī la'i gnas: nang rol phyi nang rim pa bzhin: gnas dang nye ba'i gnas brgyad gsal: snying dbus dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dal: yongs rdzogs gzi brjid mdangs ldan gsal: om̐ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3 haṃ: slob dpon shar du gnas pas bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: thugs ka nas bh+rūm̐ 'phros khog pa la thim pas khog pa dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod brgyad rwa ba me dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur: thams cad kyi lag g.yas phyi dang lag g.yon nang du byas pa'i khu tshur dpung mgor bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐: pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces lan bdun bzlas nas rgya bkrol te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shag gis phye bar gyur par bsams la/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon 'gros gar gyis/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ha ha ha: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces brjod nas dkyil 'khor g.yas su lan gsum bskor nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du tshud par gyur: zhes brjod la stegs bu'i dbus kyi khri'i khar slob dpon zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs pa'i mdun du seng ldeng gi phur bu tsan dan dmar pos kha bsgyur zhing rtse mor me tog phreng ba bcings pa bcu bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar nub rnams su phur gdan bcu bkod la/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig bcu spros phur bu rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las stod khro bo'i gzugs can smad phur bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ thams cad hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sum+bha na ི'i sngags kyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug pa la slob dpon gyis lag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon pas phur bu bzung la/ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'jig rten kun: zhe sdang rdo rje bla na med: sku gsung thugs sprul stobs dang ldan: ta krita khrag 'thung khro rgyal bcu: 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i stangs stabs kyis: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams brlag par mdzod: dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: rang byung khro rgyal chen po bcu: log 'dren bdud bgegs mtshams gcod phyir: khro bcu'i phur pa gdab par bya: steng gi phur bu shar gyi shar nas brtsam g.yas su rim par/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭḥ shar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la: ma hā kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ shar lho/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho nub/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ār+ya a tsa le hūm̐:

gnod byed 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub byang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang shar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'og gi phur bu nub kyi mdun du/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces 'bar ba'i stangs stabs dang bcas steng gi phur bu shar gyi shar/ shar nas shar lho sogs rim gyis byang shar bar g.yas bskor dang*/ 'og gi phur bu nub kyi nub tu gdab pas/ bgegs rnams kyi snying phug nas g.yo 'gul med cing 'od gsal bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer srung ba'i 'khor lo 'khrigs pas phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab par bsam/ zhes dang*/ las gzhung nas 'byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi tshig brjod cing bsrung bya srung byed thams cad las 'das pa kho na nyid kyi srung 'khor yang bya/ bzhi pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bca' ba la/ thog mar chag chag gdab pa ni/ dung phor ram ka pā lar bdud rtsi rnam pa lngar sbyar ba'i dri bzang gi chus dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la rdo rje khu tshur gyis byang shar nas g.yas bskor du khyab par khyams med par byugs shing*/ hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje ye shes gsang ba'i chu: rnam dag yon tan dri ma med pa'i rdzas: smon lam dbang gis byang chub sems bskyed mchog: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sa gzhir chag chag 'debs: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun rgyu rdo rje'i sa gzhi la:

rang byung rten 'brel 'char ba'i steng : gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i dal bcag pas: dbang chen mkha' klong yangs par gsal: oṃ sarba dharma bhū mi haṃ: zhes brjod cing zhi rol bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rim pa ni/ dbang gi sa gzhi 'jam zhing lag mthil ltar mnyam par bya/ thig skud dal gyi nyis 'gyur tshad tsam gyis 'debs pa'i ri mo dkar po dag tu 'dod/ sgrub pa po ni dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod: bkra shis mtshan ldan rig ma rgyan can de: shar du sdod la thig skud sne mo btang : de nas thig skud rdo rje pad+mar mtshon: dang po mkha' la ye shes dal thig gdab: thig skud rig ma'i spyi bor khru gang btegs: hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' lam du: bden gnyis 'bras bu ston pa'i phyir: rig pa rdo rje'i thig gdab bo: rang byung ye nas pho brang gsal: om̐ dharma badz+ra swa bhā wa hūm̐: de nas rig ma'i brang la gtad: shes rab yum gyi bha ga ru: thabs kyi kun da sbreng bar bsam: hoḥ stong nyid ye shes rgyun lam du: zag med dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i phyir: zung 'jug bde chen thig gdab bo: sna tshogs lnga ldan lhun gyis grub: oṃ pra dz+nyā su khaṃ pra mo ti ri hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor dag la gdab: de'ang slob dpon nub dang rig ma shar du byas la rdor dril dang bcas pa'i ngang nas gung mos thig skud bzung*/ 'og nas gyen du gcus te se gol gtog pa la/ nub shar lho byang tshangs thig gdab/ /me rlung srin dbang zur thig gnyis/ /me dbang rlung srin shar nub logs/ /rlung dbang me srin byang dang lho/ /logs te tshangs logs rgyab 'gros dang*/ /zur la de spangs g.yas kho nas/ /'gro ste thig chen brgyad po gdab/ /slob dpon nub nas srad bu bsdu/ ras bris yin na tshon chog sogs mi dgos la 'di nas sta gon la 'jug pas chog go /de nas tshon byin brlab pa ni/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs mtshon pa'i phyir/ byang du ljang gu la tām̐ bris/

nub tu dmar po la pām̐ bris te bzhag /lho ru ser po la lām̐ bris te bzhag /shar du dkar po la mām̐ bris te bzhag /dbus su sngon po la mūm̐ bris te bzhag la/ hūm̐: 'byung ba rang byung bsnol brtsegs thabs: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rang byung rang shar de bzhin tu: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus de ltar thim: e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ bh+rūm̐: slar phyogs su bzhag nas/ hūm̐: zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod phrag dog: gti mug ma spangs dbyings su dag: ye shes lnga ru lam gyis shar: kun tu gnas 'gyur sa bon bh+rūm̐: om̐ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe haṃ: de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba la/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum gdab: gnyis pa dbus nas cha bzhi mnyam: dbus ma'i tshangs thig legs par gdab: tshangs thig bgos pa'i gnyis cha mtshams: g.yas g.yon bya rog rjes rnams btsal: de la gcig btab thabs shes gnyis: bzhi cha gdab pa tshad med bzhi: de nas gnyis gdab phar phyin drug: go cha dang po rnam thar brgyad: gnyis pa stong nyid bcu drug pa: gsum pa dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi: bzhi pa mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: des ni gzhung gi thig chen tshang : de nas sa bcad bgo ba ni: nub byang slob dpon dag gis gdab: shar phyogs gsang ba'i rig mas gdab: dang po phyed gdab phyi ma bsal: gnyis pa cha bzhi legs par gdab: gsum pa bzhi pa rang sar bzhag: lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma bsal: bdun pa cha bzhi legs par gdab: brgyad pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: de yis thig chen rtsa gnyis rdzogs: dang po cha chen lta ba la: gnyis pa pad+ma gsum 'khor lo: bzhi pa sgo mtshams blo yis dpag: tshad ni cha chen gcig tu 'dod: chos 'khor la ni cha phran bzhi: gnyis 'das gnyis dang bzhi 'das bzhi: bskor ba klong gur ri mo 'byung : ka zur mun pa cha chung re: glang rgyab mun pa cha chung gsum: cha chung bzhi cha kha rgyan bskor: mun pa'i skor tshad sgo yi mtshams:

ka rgyan steng nas za ra tshags: gyen bskor sna tshogs rdo rje 'byung : pad+ma rdo rwa cha phran re: dur khrod me ri cha chen re: rtsig pa lnga ldan cha chung gcig: 'dod snam dmar po cha chung re: pha gu ser po cha chung gcig: mun nag drwa dkar cha chung gnyis: sham bu sngon po cha chung gcig: mda' yab mchod rten cha chung gcig: ka ba phyogs mtshon ka rgyan mdzes: lcam dang rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog: rta babs sa chu me rlung bzhi: ser sngon dmar ljang cha chung re: ka gdan mdzes tshon cha chung re: chos 'khor ser po cha chung gnyis: char kheb nyi zla cha chung re: de ltar zhib tu rim par gdab: ces so/ lnga pa sta gon la bzhi/ lha yo byad bum pa slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'o/ de'ang slob ma la dbang bskur dang 'brel na de rnams skabs dang sbyar/ ma 'brel na mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang yo byad sta gon ni nam du'ang dgos pas sgrub rdzas tshang bar bsags la thams cad kyang ye shes kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig tu mos pas byin gyis brlab/ dang po lha sta gon ni gtso bor dkyil 'khor bri bar gnang ba zhu ba'i don yin pas grub na legs pa las lhag skyon du mi 'gyur bas de ltar na/ dkyil 'khor bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus gtso bo'i gnas su bdud rtsi dri bzang sbyar ba'i chab kyis thig le byas la/ dbus kyi tshom bu/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes bkod/ phyogs bzhir/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra kro ta tsaṇ+ḍa grī wa tsa tur kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes bkod/ mtshams bzhir/ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa pañca hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes bkod/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir/ oṃ ma mo mu kha le kro ti tsa tur baṃ ru lu ru lu bh+yoḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes brjod cing dri'i thig le byas la me tog gi tshom bu gtso 'khor bcu gsum phyed par bkod/ phyi nang gi mchod gtor bshams la/

las byang ltar mchod pa byin brlabs nas dam tshig pa bskyed/ phyag mchod bstod pa'i bar du song nas thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar te/ hoḥ dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dgongs: dkyil 'khor bzang po legs bris nas: bdag cag bsnyen sgrub las gzhung bsrang : sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod: lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis se gol gsum byas la/ lha rnams bar snang 'od kyi drwa bar bzhugs par bsam/ tshom bu mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ 'dir yang las byang gi mngon rtogs rgyas pa mi lcogs pa lta bu la/ sgrub pa'i gzhir rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen por lha tshogs dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ ces gdod nas grub pa'i sems kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab la mchod bstod byas pas kyang chog go /gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ sgrub pa'i mthar slob ma la dbang bskur min gang ltar yang*/ bum pa sta gon dgos pas bsdus par 'dod na/ bum pa lha grangs sam rnam bum dang las bum tsam 'du bya/ drag sngags yungs thun gyi brab/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug la bgegs bskrad/ khrus kyis sbyangs/ gtso bo'i snying po brjod la nang bcud mgul chings kha rgyan ldan pa bkod/ mchod pa bshams shing byin gyis brlab/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las phyi rin po che bum pa'i rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus su bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mtsho rdzing dwangs par zla skar shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur: mchod bstod ni/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo:

bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzung thag blangs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros bum pa'i lha rnams la phog: snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems ye shes bcud du 'khyil bar bsam: bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci mang mthar/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i mchod yon phul bas lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur: las bum ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang pad+mar gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bum pa bsnams pa khro bo'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan par gsal ba'i spyi bor om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ ham̐'u: 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms byed pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/

ces bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing*/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa gang bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus bzlas mthar/ khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur te phrin las mdzad par mos la/ gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni gsham du gsal/ drug pa rgyan 'god pa ni/ dkyil 'khor lding khri rim gsum mam gnyis yod pa'i 'og mar rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ bdag bskyed mchod gtor logs gang bder bzhag /sgrub rdzas spyir sku gzugs tsakli rgyud dam gzhung pod/ sngags byang*/ rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan sku gsung thugs rten rnam rgyal bum pa sgrub thod bdud rtsis bkang ba'i thog me long shel rdo/ sgrub gtor sman raka /tshe 'brang tshe ril tshe chang mda' dar bcas dang*/ myong grol sman sgrub dang 'brel na rdzas khyad par can dmigs bsal du 'byung ba rnams bkod/ de yang pad+ma khrag 'thung gi gtor ma gdan gru bzhi sum brtsegs thog 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ de steng zla gam sgo gcig thog dpal gtor phrag zlum pad 'dab bzhi lte bar rgyun lam can/ gzhan yang las bzhi zhi rgyas dbang drag dang*/ bka' gter srung ma'i gtor ma spyi dang khyad par gter srung las kyi ma mo'i mchod gtor/ dge bsnyen sde bzhi'i gtor ma sogs rang lugs bka' srung spyi mtshungs/ dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas rgyan rdzas sogs ci 'byor ba stegs bu'i steng du bkod/ slar 'dzab dbyangs bya ba'i tshe rdo rje slob dpon gyis dril spos 'dzin pas thog drangs/ rten sgrub mchod pa'i rdzas rnams thogs pa'i ser sbreng gis dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor lan gsum byas te/ mdun du 'khod la dbyangs dang bcas te tshig dang mthun par phul la rang gnas su bkod/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du:

yi dam mchod cing dngos grub blang ba dang : dam can dgyes bskang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bkod pa ni: bum pa bzang po lha yi gzhal yas khang : dam rdzas mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyan du che: sman raka gtor bcas rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang : gdugs dang bla bre rgyal mtshan ba dan dang : mda' dang gri dang tshon skud drwa ba 'brel: dar sham smad dkris dur khrod rdzas mchog bkram: mthun pa'i rdzas mchog dgyes pa'i dkor cha sogs: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru yongs rdzogs gsal: zhes dbyangs dang zhi rol bcas bya zhing sgrub rdzas rnams/ las slob sogs kyis nor 'khrul med cing bag dro lhun chags dwang ba 'dren par bkod/ dkyil 'khor dbus su bsgrub pa'i rdzas kyi gtso bo thod pa rnam bum myong grol bum pa sogs khri'i khar bkod/ lding khri gong mar sku gsung thugs rten/ rgyab ngos su bye brag gi gtor chen rgyan spros can dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rwa'i steng khro bcu'i phur pa/ mtha' bskor shar du mchod yon nas brtsam ste nyer spyod shar lhor mtshams 'dzin me tog bcas/ phyogs bzhir ral gri bzhi/ mtshams bzhi mda' dar me long can bzhi btsugs pa tshon skud kyi drwa bas sbrel/ gzhan yang zur bzhir rgyal mtshan logs bzhir 'phan dar gyi drwa phyed sogs so so'i phyag len las byung ba ltar mdzes brjid chags pa dang*/ steng na dar gyi gdugs phub/ gsham du stag gzig gi sgab dkris kyis bskor/ dkyil 'khor mdun rgyab gang bder mchod gtor kha zas bzang dgus brgyan pa'i g.yon du chos gter srung ma spyi dang bye brag gi gtor 'bul chad brtan rgyun bzhag /rgyun gso'i chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar phyi mchod brgya rtsa bkra shis rtags rdzas rgyal srid sna bdun sogs yod na mtha' skor stegs bu rim pa can la go rim ma 'dzol bar bkod/ gzhan yang nyin re bzhin 'bul rgyu'i chos skyong gi gtor spungs chad mdo brtan ma tshogs kyi yo byad kyis mtshon phrin las la dgos pa rnams dang*/

dkyil 'khor byang phyogs su lcags snod du nyul le'i liṅga dang las phur phur stegs bcas yungs dkar sogs thun rdzas rnams kyang 'du bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun g.yas nas brtsams te/ las bum/ ḍā ma ru/ nas gzed yungs gzed/ g.yab dar/ rdor dril/ las phur/ nang mchod rnams bzhag /mchod pa rnams la spyi khyab tu/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phros/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mkha' khyab tu spel bar bya'o/ bdun pa tshogs sgrub kyi las la 'jug rung gi bya ba sgrub pa po rnams mnga' gsol zhing gnas su dgod pa ni/ las kyi rdo rje'i thod chang yar bzed nas tshig dang bstun nas so so la bdud rtsi drang ba sogs lag len ltar byas la/ thog mar rgyal thebs kyis stong thun zur gsal ltar sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len gyis/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po 'di: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rdzogs: dug lnga rtsad gcod dngos grub kun 'byung gnas: ston pa'i sgron mer mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes dang rgyal tshab la/ hūm̐: bla ma'i gdung 'tshob sku gsung thugs kyi sras: dam chos char 'bebs tshe dang dngos grub spel: dbang bskur phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa: rgyal tshab ston par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: yum la/ gnyis med bde skyed mtshan nyid rab tu bzang : kun bzang yum du mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdo rje las sar/ phrin las gzhung bsrang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad: rdo rje karma mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: ging la/ bar gcod bgegs bsgral gzugs phung lha la stob: rdo rje ging mchog mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: mtshams par/ phyi nang mtshams gcod bar chad thams cad srungs: rdo rje mtshams par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs:

spyan pa/ dngos grub bgegs gnyis dus dang drod tshad mkhyen: rdo rje spyan pa mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: dus mtshams par/ phrin las skabs sbyor dus 'dzin nam tshod mkhas: rdo rje dus mtshams mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: phyag tshang par/ phud gtsang g.yos mkhas phyi nang bya byed mkhas: rdo rje phyag tshang mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: byan pa pho mor/ gsal dag dzap mkhas dad ldan brtson par bzhugs: gser phreng mched lcam mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdul phyags pa la/ kun gyi bka' sgrub phyi yi nyul le skrod: rdul phyags skyes bu mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes so sor mnga' gsol zhing rang gral du 'khod pa las nam yang ma 'khrugs par bya'o/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis zhal bkod gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir: rdo rje slob dpon rgyal tshab gzungs ma dang : rdo rje karma ging mchog mtshams pa dang : spyan ma phyag tshang rdo rje rdul phyags pa: rdo rje gser phreng la sogs mched dang lcam: rang rang gral bzhugs bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gyis: tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgyas bya ba yi: byang chub sgrub la gsang ba'i lam mchog 'dir: sngon sbyangs tshogs bsags 'bras bu dus 'dir smin: da res sgrub mchog 'dir bzhugs skal ba bzang : tshe 'di blos thong sgrub la snying rus bskyed: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ngo e ma hoḥ de'i rjes 'brel du chas su zhugs shing rtags gdab dgos pas chas rnams las rdor sogs kyis thogs/ rgyal tshab pas gtong thun sngon du 'gro ba'i dbyangs bor len tshul gyis zhi chas la/ hrīḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'bras bu'i lam zhugs pa: rtags kyi phyag rgya bder gshegs dngos su gsal: dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang : do shal dpung rgyan se mo do: stod g.yogs smad dkris sham bur ldan: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rab tu spras: dri mchog ngad ldan brgyan pa po:

'dod yon ma spangs rang grol rgyan du bzhes: khro chas la: hūm̐: don dam spros med sgyu ma'i khong gseng nas: ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i dbu rgyan gsol: 'khor ba ma spangs mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: skye 'chi rtsad gcod thal chen tshom bu gsol: sku gsum lhun grub thod phreng tshar gsum gsol: cis kyang mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab gsol: ma rig nags sreg ye shes me dpung gsol: zhing bcu yongs sgrol dpal gyi chas bcu 'di: dbang phyug chen po'i sku la rgyan du bzhes: zhes rjes zlos bcas tshig dang bstun nas dpal gyi chas rnams las kyi rdo rjes rgyal tshab par rim par phul la rdo rje slob dpon sogs thams cad kyi gnas so sor bgo zhing rgyan pa'i tshul bya'o/ brgyad pa brda sbyar ba la/ brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag zhal mjal phyir: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'thib sgo bcad: zang thal rig pa'i 'char sgo phyes: gsal stong de bzhin phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis 'dzin mnyam pa nyid du bshags: 'khor 'das ro gcig lta bas mchod: bla med ye grol chen por bstod: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya badz+ra a ti pu ho dz+nyā na shud+dhe hūm̐: gdod nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i sgo glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri mas bcad pa rig pa ye shes kyi brda mjal bas lhag ge phye bar bsams la/ bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces brda sgo dbye/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ci ltar shar yang rang rig las gud du med pa'i gnas lugs chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur rtogs pas/ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes brda phyag 'tshal ba tsam gyis kyang grub bo/ dgu pa bsre bsnan bya ba ni/ skabs 'dir dbang ma thob pa'i mched gsar bu rnams dkyil 'khor byang shar lta bu logs su phye/ slob dpon gyi mdun rdor dril bdud rtsi yungs thun sogs bkod nas/ las byang gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/

sman mchod khā hi bcas bya/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag nyid las kyi dpal chen he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ya las lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa 'phros: de las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas slob bu'i sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par gyur: par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla zhing yungs thun gyis brab/ las byang ltar bka' sgo bgegs bskrad brjod/ drag sngags yungs thun gu gul dud pa rol mo sogs 'tsham rngam gyis bgegs bskrad gsar bu rnams kyi rgyud sbyang ba'i phyir rjes zlos byar gzhug ste/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ slob ma rnams kyis snying gar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba re yod par bsgom: byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi rdo rje'i lce thog tu lan gsum bzhag nas/ hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang : byang chub sems dang rdo rje 'dzin: de bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa: de dag la ni snying ring na: rdo rje yak+sha gnod sbyin gyis: khyod kyi snying la zhugs te 'thung : snying la yang dag gnas pa'o: 'di ni sems can dmyal ba'i chu: dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed: dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub: ces bdud rtsi byin pas slob mas kyang*/

i dan+te na ra kan sa ma ya yak+sha hūm̐: zhes myong la snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim nas dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo/ 'dres gral bsnan pa'i rgyal tshab pas bdud rtsi g.yon bskor du gsar rnying thams cad la bran zhing*/ gtso sngags dzap dbyangs lan gsum mjug tu 'jam rol dang bcas pas bdud rtsi myong nas thams cad kyis/ oṃ: dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed sku dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: āḥ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed gsung dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: āḥsarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: dpal ldan sangs rgyas thugs 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes dang slob dpon gyis/ deng phyin chad mched gsar rnying thams cad skal ba mnyam zhing dam tshig gcig tu 'dus pa yin pas dam tshig gzhung bzhin du bsrung bar gyis shig: ces bsgo/ thams cad kyi phyag thal sbyar gyi bar me tog bzung nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon dang : dam tshig 'brel ba'i mched dang lcam dral gyis: sgrub mchog rnams su byin gyis brlabs pa yi: bka' drin rjes su dran phyir gtang rag gtong : zhes drin lan gyi me tog 'thor/ de nas rdo rje'i gral du bzhag pa ni/ mched gsar pa rnams rang rang gral du 'khod nas/ phyag thal sbyar bar me tog bzung la/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang : bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi bstan cing bsgrub pa dang : yi dam lha tshogs 'dzab bsnyen bgrang ba'i phyir: dam tshig rdo rje'i gral du mchis par gnang :

zhes brjod cing mched gsar pa rnams rang gral du 'khod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐: rdo rje 'du 'bral med pa'i gzung thag la: dam tshig srog gis bsdus pa'i mched dang lcam: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'thob bya'i phyir: thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces brjod de dam tshig gi bslab bya rgyas par bya/ de nas thams cad lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ om̐ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje thugs kar gsor ba dang*/ om̐ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐: zhes dril bu dkrol zhing dkur brten/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes thugs kar 'khyud rgya byas la dril bu dkrol ba dang*/ rol chen brgya brdung sogs/ rol mo sgra cher bsgrag go /bcu pa lha bstim zhing byin dbab pa ni/ rang gral nas dkyil 'khor la phyogs par bzhengs la/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams sprin gtibs pa bzhin byon nas rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs par bsam rol mo bcas pas/ hūm̐: spros med rtog bral mkha' dbyings dag pa nas: skye med rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs mnga' ba: 'gro don rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yab yum sras 'khor bcas: stong nyid dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul gyi: sprul pa dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol:

ces dang gtso 'khor sngags mthar/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ zhes btags pa brjod/ gong du sta gon byas nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa de nyid dkyil 'khor la bstims par mos/ bsdu na spyan 'dren bskos gdab 'dir ma byas kyang chog go /byin dbab pa ni/ 'brel dang byin rlabs che ba nyang gter bde 'dus las 'byung ba ltar na/ sgrub pa po rnams zhwa chos sogs gzi byin bskyed de dkyil 'khor la bskor/ dar sna'i g.yab mo sogs dang spos dud dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ rang gzhung byin 'bebs 'dir bya/ mthar rol 'og dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas te gnas dang sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa la byin phab nas sku gsung thugs ye shes chen po'i rol par gyur bar bsams la rang gral du 'khod de 'dzab dbyangs lan gsum gyi mthar grol lo/

gnyis pa lha dang dbyer med du byed pa sgrub pa dngos la gsum/ 'dzab dgongs bzlas pas dngos grub sgrub pa de'i bar gcod bsal ba/ dus grangs rtags tshad kyi rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ phrin las dang 'brel dgos pas las gzhung nyid nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug /'bring nyin lan gnyis mtshan lan gnyis te dus bzhi/ tha mas kyang nyin mtshan gnyis la tshar re bsrang dgos pas/ thun dang po la rnam 'joms nas bzung*/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ sku gsum gsol 'debs sogs nas theg chen dgu ldan/ gnas ri so dgu bcas chos spyod zur 'debs ltar byas la/ las gzhung phrin las lnga sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs mthar skye ba kun tu?myur thob shog nas snyan gsan rol mo brdung*/ de nas las byang rdo rje'i gad rgyangs kyi skyabs sems nas brtsam sngon 'gro rnams rgyas par btang*/ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin gsum gyis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgoms la ye shes 'khor lor bstim zhing mchod bstod bya/ bzlas pa'i mgor dzap khang phyes te dzap dbyangs lan gsum bcas gzung thag blangs/ de yang nyin dang por gzung thag gnyis ka slob dpon la phul nas mthar bsdu ba'i skabs las rdor gyi las kyi gzung thag bsnyen rgyun par gnang srol 'dug /bdag mdun gnyis kar spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bzlas pa rgyun mi chad par bya dgos pas/ bsnyen rgyun pa rnams kyis kyang 'di nas bzung mthar ma grol gyi bar du bsnyen pa'i rgyun mi gcod/ grub na thun rer lha'i rgyun khyer lta bu'i mngon rtogs gsal gdab la sngags rgyun blang*/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams kyis lhag chad kha bkang zhing nus pa brtan par byas la stong tshig phul nas nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa la/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor byang shar du slob dpon nam rgyal thebs bzhengs/ mdun du hom khung nyul le'i liṅga bcas pa dang*/

las phur thun rdzas rnams 'god la rten bskyed pa ni/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i log par lta ba'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad rid kyang nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur par bsams la: na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags dang rig sngags gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang : ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang : chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthu la rten nas dngos grub la bar du gcod cing log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ phur thun tshom bur bskor ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad khro gtum skur bstan pa: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ sras 'khor sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas: drag po'i lha tshogs dus la bab: g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyu 'gugs: lcags kyus zungs la phur pa thob: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces drag sngags dang phur skor byas pas gdab cing thun gyis brab/ khyad par dpal gyi pho nya kun thabs rgyal mo bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas: khrag mdog dmar mo bswe yi lan phran can: spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi ma'i zer ltar 'phro: smin ma glog 'khyug bar snang go skabs 'gyed: bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khrug: bzhad pa he dang dpal gyi spu gris gtams: rngam pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ag tshom me 'bar rab 'byams srid pa sreg: bskal pa'i 'brug sgra snyan nas 'brug stong sgrogs: lag pa dmar po spu gri 'bum gyis gtams: sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse la me chen 'bar: ba spu gnam lcags zhun ma'i rdo rje 'khrug: smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chung char 'bebs shing : zhabs kyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir: ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: shin tu mi bzod gtum chen khrag 'thung ma: srin mo'i snying 'byin changs par bcug nas gsol: shin tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku gcig ma: dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol: khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha: na bza' dmar po srin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol: phyogs bcur kha bltas phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan: bdud la bab na snying khrag dron mo gsol: srin la bab na srog rtsa dmar po gcod: dgra la bab na dug gi kha chu 'debs: bgegs la bab na rū pa rdul du rlog: dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs: phung po dum bur gtubs la don snying sregs: dam nyams nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlog: hūm̐ gru bu gru bu a pa tse: ru pa tse: na ra tse: tsa me thun thun: nā sha ya: na sha satwaṃ bha ya: yak+sha byi na: yak+sha byi na: phye ma phye ma: rdul phran rdul phran: tsit+ta rbad nan: om̐ sum+bha ni?

om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya prā ma rā dza trig nan: dha na rak+sha rbud ling : tri'u tri'u ma ma na ya sho na dza mā ra ya rbad rbad: drag sngags spos rol dang khyad par gyi dbyug pas brdeg cing thun gyis brab la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ byin 'bebs pa ni/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis zhwa chos sogs gzi byin bskyed de dkyil 'khor la bskor/ dar sna'i g.yab mo sogs dang spos dud dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ mthar rol 'og dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas te gnas dang sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa la byin phab nas sku gsung thugs ye shes chen po'i rol par gyur bar bsams la rang gral du 'khod de 'dzab dbyangs lan gsum mthar grol lo/

de dag gis thun dang po grub/ thun gnyis pa la mchod kha gsos te mchod pa byin rlob pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dz+nyā na pañca pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs: sman raka phyar zhing dkrug: de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing brdal: āḥ zang thal ngang l sogs nas bsnyen pa yan mthar chags su btang*/ stong tshig phul/ rgyal chen kha gso zur gsal ltar bya/ nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa sogs sngar ltar ram stabs bde byed na/ rdo rje mtshams pas gu gul dud pa dang thun brab ste dkyil 'khor bskor la drag sngags so lnga pa dang*/ om̐ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sder mo'i sngags drag tu brjod pas tshar bcad la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ mthar byin 'bebs rgyas pa'am bsdus pa ni/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byin gyis rlobs pa'i dus la bab/ /dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen bdud 'dul bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ

oṃ dz+nyā na a be sha ya āḥ ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃḥ des thun gnyis pa grub/ chos skyong sde lnga sogs rang lugs bka' gter srung ma'i gtor chog spyi dang khyad par gter srung las kyi ma mo'i mchod thabs dang dge bsnyen sde bzhi sogs rgyun ltar bya'o/ thun gsum pa yang de dang mtshungs la bzlas pa stong tshig bcas grub pa dang*/ de nas na raka skong bshags dang gtor bsngo rig 'dzin srog sgrub spyan 'dren bar song nas/ tshogs byin mchod nas phyi snod srid gsum sogs gtor bsngos mthar dbyung*/ skong ba rgyas bsdus nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btson du 'dzin/ bskul chos skyong gtor 'bul dang las gzhung chad brtan rta bro bya/ skabs 'di tsam nas rgyal theb pa dang ging pa sogs kyis bsgral ba'i bya ba la 'jug pa'i phyir zhwa phod sogs bzhes par phebs/ mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya/ nongs bshags dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum gsum brjod brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du rdul tshon yin na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du mchan/ de srid du brtan par bzhugs nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes 'bru 'thor/ bsngo smon rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dang*/ ye dhār shis brjod bcas grub nas rol mo rgya cher bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos grub la bar du gcod pa bsal cing byin rlabs gzi byin dbab pa ni/

slob dpon nam rgyal thebs bzhengs mdun du hom khung du/ nyul le'i liṅga bcas pa dang*/ las phur thun rdzas rnams dgod la/ rten bskyed pa ni/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i log par lta ba'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad rid kyang nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur par bsams la: na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags dang rig sngags gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang : ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang : chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthu la rten nas dngos grub la bar du gcod cing log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ phur thun tshom bur bskor ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad khro gtum skur bstan pa: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ sras 'khor sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas: drag po'i lha tshogs dus la bab: g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyu 'gugs: lcags kyus zungs la phur pa thob: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kro ta rang nyid srung phyir spyi bor lan gsum bskor/ pad+ma kro ti shwa rī byad phur bzlog phyir sked la lan gsum bskor badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs sgrol phyir mdun du lan gsum bsgril ma hā yak+sha pho rgyud zil gnon g.yas su lan gsum phyar kā la rū pa g.yas su lan gsum bsgril karma raṃ raṃ mo rgyud dbang sdud g.yon du lan gsum phyar dz+wa la raṃ g.yon du lan gsum bsgril hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra lag g.yas rdo rje g.yab dar dang bcas pa'i dbye sprad kyi rgya dang ldan pas ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe khrus lung gsum gyi dmigs pa dang ldan pas phur bu dgra bgegs kyi snying khar gdab bo/ ces drag sngags phur skor byas pas gdab cing thun gyis brab/ gsang zil las byung ba'i gnas nyul rang lugs ltar/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: ma 'di nas gnas chen bye ba stong dang phrag: rtsub 'gyur me ri rab tu 'bar ba yi: zla ba dkar mo khro chu khol ma'i klong : nyi ma dmar ser rak+ta 'khrigs pa'i dbus: ljang nag rlung ri bu yug 'tshubs pa'i dkyil: ti ra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: las kyi ging chen yab yum bcu gnyis te: ye shes ging chen dkar gsal drag tu 'khros:

g.yas g.yon phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams: rdo rje ging mo myur mgyogs chu shel mdog: phyag na g.yang gzhi bhan+dha rlon pa thogs: tho rangs nam langs rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ging chen ser nag mi sdug gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na 'khor lo thod khrag dkrugs: rin chen ging mo gser mdog 'od kyis 'gengs: g.yang gzhi bhan+dha thogs shing stong khams 'grim: nyi shar nyi dros rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: sor rtog ging chen dmar nag srin po'i gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na me thun bhan dmar thogs: pad+ma ging mo zangs mdog mche ba gtsigs: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing tshogs khang nyul: nyin phyed phyed yol rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: bya grub ging chen ljang nag khrag 'thung gzugs: rdo rje phur pa 'dzin cing nyon mongs bsgral: las kyi ging mo rlung mdog shugs ldan ma: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar rak+ta dkrug cing 'thung : nyi thal mun 'tshub rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos dbyings ging chen mthing nag gtum pa'i gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na gri thun gri zor 'dzin: bud+dha ging mo lcags mdog 'khrul snang gzhom: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing stong gsum g.yo: srod dang srod 'khor rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: 'gyu byed ging chen nag po dug gi gdong : g.yas g.yon phyag na spu gri lcags kyu 'dzin: sha za ging mo mun pa'i zug rngu can: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing dpag tshad khyab: nam phyed phyed yol rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim phyir gshegs su gsol:

sha khrag gsur mchod bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ ghṛ wa ṣa ṭa kro ta dza dzaḥ hūm̐: bskul lo ging chen pho mo rnams: mdzod cig nyon mongs bdud bzhi thul: rbad do rnal 'byor nyams grib sol: brten no nyon mongs zug ngu sregs: 'bod do dkyil 'khor mu ran skyongs: rnal 'byor dam tshig chag nyams rnams: bshags so rkyen ngan bar chad sol: hūm̐: ging chen lha tshogs dus la bab: nyon mongs lhong gsum dgra dar na: ging chen thugs dam dus la bab: dam tshig gnas nas bskul ba'i tshe: ging phos rdo thun sha ra ra: ging mos me zor wa la la: dmar nag ral pa sa la gzhol: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: rgyu ma'i zhags pa na ra ra: stag lpags sham thabs khrigs se khrig: rngam rgyug gar stabs lings se lang : rkang gling phaṭ sgra 'u ru ru: bshugs sgra ljags glu kyu ru ru: bgegs bskrad gad mo lhangs se lhang : phyi yi rnam rtog bdud dgra chom: nang gi nyon mongs bdud dgra chom: gsang ba'i na tsha rkyen ngan phrol: dug lnga'i 'khrul pa da shigs la: nga bdag 'gong po dbyings su sgrol: dam sri gnod byed rmang nas phyungs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i bar chad thal bar rlog: oṃ kro ta ghṛ wa hūm̐ hūm̐ gnod byed nyon mongs bdud thams cad gardza gardza phaṭḥ oṃ kro ti shwa rī ghṛ ni bh+yoḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel ngan pa thams cad da ha da ha dz+wa la raṃ: zhes thun brdeg cing me zor ram me bshur btang*/ de nas sgrub pa ma grol bar bgegs che na/ dus bcu gnyis sam/ drug tu cha yang gsal 'bud pa re re btang bas gegs sel lo/ khyad par dpal gyi pho nya kun thabs rgyal mo bskul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas: khrag mdog dmar mo bswe yi lan phran can: spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi ma'i zer ltar 'phro: smin ma glog 'khyug bar snang go skabs 'gyed: bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khrug:

bzhad pa he dang dpal gyi spu gris gtams: rngam pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ag tshom me 'bar rab 'byams srid pa sreg: bskal pa'i 'brug sgra snyan nas 'brug stong sgrogs: lag pa dmar po spu gri 'bum gyis gtams: sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse la me chen 'bar: ba spu gnam lcags zhun ma'i rdo rje 'khrug: smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chung char 'bebs shing : zhabs kyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir: ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: shin tu mi bzod gtum chen khrag 'thung ma: srin mo'i snying 'byin changs par bcug nas gsol: shin tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku gcig ma: dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol: khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha: na bza' dmar po srin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol: phyogs bcur kha bltas phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan: bdud la bab na snying khrag dron mo gsol: srin la bab na srog rtsa dmar po gcod: dgra la bab na dug gi kha chu 'debs: bgegs la bab na rū pa rdul du rlog: dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs: phung po dum bur gtubs la don snying sregs: dam nyams nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlog: hūm̐ gru bu gru bu a pa tse: ru pa tse: na ra tse: tsa me thun thun: nā sha ya: na sha satwaṃ bha ya: yak+sha byi na: yak+sha byi na: phye ma phye ma: rdul phran rdul phran: tsit+ta rbad nan: om̐ sum+bha ni? om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya prā ma rā dza trig nan: dha na rak+sha rbud ling : tri'u tri'u ma ma na ya sho na dza mā ra ya rbad rbad: drag sngags spos rol dang khyad par gyi dbyug pas brdeg cing thun gyis brab la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ de ma thag dngos grub ster ba'i ltas 'byung bas byin rlabs dgos par gsungs pas chas sogs sngon bshad ltar byas la thog mar/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs?sogs sngon du 'gro la byin 'bebs pa ni/

hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ spro bar mos na gzhung gi byin 'bebs 'dir byas la dpon slob rnams kyis rol 'og tu dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor zhing dzap dbyangs lan gsum du gyer ro/ ye shes pa brtan pa'i phyir me tog 'thor ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: rten 'brel dam tshig rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la: brtan par bzhugs kyang byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'grub par gyur cig badz+ra sa ma ya: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: mtshan thun gsum por 'don 'grig nyin thun gnyis pa dang mtshungs la thun mjug so sor nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa ma chad par bya la mjug tu dzap dbyangs bcas grol lo/ de bzhin tshogs sgrub kyi skabs 'byor mkhos can gyi spros pa rgyas par byed na nyams chag bskang ba'i phyir rdor sems 'khor 'das rang grol dang*/

bar chad bsal ba'i phyir rdo rje mtshams pa rnams zur du bzhag nas yang phur las byang rgyas bsdus gang rung gi dkyil 'khor zur du sgrubs la so so'i khrus dang bgegs bskrad pa'i las dang rgyal tho gso ba rnams mdzad srol yod pa ltar grub na legs so/ rgyud las/ 'khor la bka' bsgo dge sbyong bskul/ zhes khyad par du gsungs pas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis sgrub mched rnams la skabs skabs su blang dor gyi bslab bya dang dam tshig bshad nas/ bskyed bzlas kyi dmigs pa go sla don 'dus bshad grub na legs pa'i yan lag go /gsum pa ni/ dus grangs rtags gsum las/ dus ni smin slob la zla ba drug /mos slob kyi dbang du byas na zla ba gcig gam/ zhag po bdun nam nyin zhag gsum gyi mthar brten par bsgrubs pas kyang*/ dus dang dbang po dang mthun par dngos grub ci rigs pa thob par 'gyur bar gsungs so/ deng sang phyag len du spros bcas sgrub chen rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na sa chog nyin gcig /sta gon nyin gcig dngos gzhi nyin bdun/ rdul tshon chur gshegs nyin gcig bcas nyin bcu'am gzhan du sta gon nyin gcig /dngos gzhi nyin bdun te nyin zhag brgyad la grangs bzung srol yang yod/ yang spros pas lcog na thog mar sta gon gyi skabs drag po'i sbyin sreg dang sgrub pa nyin gsum par zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /drug par dbang gi sbyin sreg dngos grub blangs grub pa'i rjes rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bcas gnang srol yod la/ khag gcig dngos grub rjes las bzhi mchog dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg lnga dus gcig tu gnang srol yang 'dug /mi nus pa rnams tha ma rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gcig kho nar mdzad pas 'thus par byed pa'ang yod pas spro bsdus so so'i nus tshod dang bstun pas chog go /rtags ni gsang ba spyi dang so so'i gzhung las 'byung ba ltar yin la/ gal te rtags tshad ngan pa byung na nyul le sprad/

rta bro brdung dam sel ltas byung na yig brgya bzla zhing bshags rgyud bklag /grib mi gtsang pa la rnam 'joms sme brtsegs saugs kyi bum khrus bya/ rtags tshad bzang ngan gang la yang re dogs dgag sgrub med par dbyings su bsre ba gnad yin/ dngos grub kyi ltas bzang nges pa can byung na de nyid du rgyun gyi dngos grub len pa gnad du che bas/ thod pa mtshan ldan chang dang chos sman sbyar bas bkang ba mdun du bzhag hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus dgongs su gsol: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs: lha yi dge bsnyen dam ldan thams cad kyis: tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe dang chos dang phrin las rnam bzhi dang : rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mngon shes nus mthu dang : srid nor zas dang 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol: a la la hoḥ zhes brjod la bdud rtsi myang ngo zhes gsungs pa 'di bzhin rgyun du phyag len gnang srol nyung bas ma byas kyang chog go /gsum pa bsgrubs nas dngos grub blang ba sgrub pa chen po'i las rim ni/ dang po sbyor sgrol la bsten pa yin kyang da lta mos slob tsam gyi skabs su rdzas la bsten nas blang ba la gsum/ dngos grub kyi rdzas bsham pa/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro/ cho ga dngos so/ dang po sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring dgong thun nas dngos grub blang ba'i rdzas bshams te/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gzhi dkar po'i steng du gro yi g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil bris pa'i dbus su rin po che'i snod 'bru bzang gi phye ma mngar gsum dang*/ zho mar 'o mas sbrus pa'i 'brang rgyas nor bu 'bar ba'i gzugs dang*/ phyogs bzhi las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas bza' bca' sna tshogs pas bskor ba g.yas su mngar gsum thud dang bsres pa'i ril bu dang*/ g.yon du bhan+dha bzang por 'bru bcud bdud rtsi a mṛ ta btab pa'ang bsham/

dgong thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pas bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bebs par gyur/ bsnyen sgrub sngags/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya tsam bzla/ yang phyag len phal mo cher dngos grub kyi rdzas de nangs rang du bsham/ snga nub dmigs bzlas 'di mi byed pa'ang yod pas long skabs dang bstun chog /phyir nangs thor thun phrin las gzhung bsrangs te bsnyen pa'i mthar gong gsal ltar dngos grub kyi dmigs pa 'dir 'bog la dngos grub blang ba'i sngags btags pa bsnyen rgyun bsrang*/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod bcas bya/ de nas gtor bsngo tshogs mchod sogs bsdus tsam byed la tshogs tha ma'i skabs nyul le'i liṅga mer bsregs shing chos skyong gi gtor mar bstab/ gnyis pa dngos grub la mi dbang ba'i blta nyan gyi bgegs tshar gcod pa'i phyir/ las byang ltar bgegs bskrad cing rgyal thebs pas dkyil 'khor dang sgrub pa po rnams bskor bzhin drag sngags bzlas shing thun gyis brab la srung 'khor bsgom/ las kyi rdo rje'i spos 'dren gyi sna drangs slob dpon nam rgyal thebs kyis zhwa chos g.yab dril bcas dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing byin chen dbab/ spyi bshags ye shes sku mchog lta bu brjod la 'khon bcugs sbyang*/ gsum pa dngos grub bskul ba ni/
