lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: 'dir 'dus rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing : bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrangs: bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mtha' ru phyin: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yis: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐: dngos grub bstsal dang stsol bar mi dmigs kyang : bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje dang : tshogs lam sbyor lam gnas pa'i rig 'dzin dang : bde gshegs yongs rdzogs rnams kyis zhal bzhes ltar: sgrub mchog bdag la sngon gyi smon lam mthus: tshe dang chos dang las bzhi lhun grub dang : rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : srid dang zas nor mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de ltar rtse gcig thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams mnyam sbyor ba'i: sbyor mtshams 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros: 'gro drug sems can rgyud sbyangs mkha' khyab kyi: bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dgyes par bskyed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: dngos grub tshur bsdus bdag dang sgrub rdzas la: thim pas 'chi med bdud rtsi dwangs ma che: dngos grub kun gyi snying po 'khyil bar gyur: zhes gsal btab la bsnyen rgyun pa'i gzung thag bsdus te dngos grub kyi gzung thag dang lhan du slob dpon la phul/ bsnyen sgrub lha sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ sham bur/ kā ya sid+dhi om̐: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ṇa sid+dhi trām̐: karma sid+dhi hrīḥ sarba lo ka dz+nyā na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes btags pa stong phrag gam brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba bzlas la/ dngos grub thams cad 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam pa bdag nyid gnas lngar thim par gyur/

skya rengs 'char kha dang bstun sku gsung thugs rten rnam rgyal bum pa sogs sgrub rdzas las rdor gyis btegs la dngos grub len pa ni/ hrīḥ ye shes lus can 'gran du med pa yi: gzi brjid sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshangs pa'i dbyangs la chos kyi char chen 'bebs: nus pa sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gzungs dran ting 'dzin mkhyen brtse yongs kyi gzhi: 'od gsal snying po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bum pa bzang : 'dod 'byung gter gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gdul bya so so'i mos pa ji bzhin du: thogs med 'jug pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: srung dang zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sogs: thun mong las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mkha' spyod ril bu mig sman rkang mgyogs sogs: khyad par grub pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshe dang yo byad 'dod rgu bsgyur la sogs: phyi nang dbang bcu'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mthong thos dran rig gdul bya smin cing grol: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes dang rang gzhung gi dngos grub bskul tshig ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: skye med dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: 'gags med rang byung snying pos bskul: rten 'brel sngags bzlas mtha' ru phyin: lus kun bde bas ltem gyis gang : deng sang skya rengs dang po shar: rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: zab dbyings bla med gsang ba'i mchog: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: mi 'gyur sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: 'gags med gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: spros bral thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang bzhi stsol: 'chi med tshe dang mi zad nor: snyan grags mnga' thang chos srid gos: phun tshogs 'dod rgu deng 'dir stsol:

oṃ dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirmā kā ya: swa bha kā ya: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes brjod pas sgrub rdzas bum pa bhan+dha sogs dbang bzhi'i rdzas dang sku gsung thugs rten rnams thog mar slob dpon la phul zhing de nas kun la brim/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams bza' btung byas te longs spyod/ stan thog de nyid du dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag gi tshul du thob par bsams la/ dgongs pa'i gdeng bzung ngo*/ gzhan don du dbang bskur na gtor dbang ye shes snying po tsam mam rgyas bsdus gang yin pa skabs 'dir sbrel lo/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa mtha' rgyas rjes kyi rim pa la gsum/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rjes chog phyi mtshams bkrol ba slob dpon la sku drin gsol zhing smon lam dang shis brjod bya ba'o/ dang po ni/ dngos grub blang ba kho na'am dbang bskur grub pa'i rjes su/ rnying ma spyi yi phyag bzhes ltar bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang las thams cad myur du 'grub pa'i phyir zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg skabs 'dir bya srol yod pas grub na gal che'o/ lhag chog btang zhing sngar btson du bzung ba'i lhag ma dang lhan cig sgrub khang lho nub gom pa bdun cu'i sar bskyal/ de nas gnas nyul gtor ma'i nang du sngar lhag ma'i ras ma cung tsam dang*/ gser skyems thogs la/ hūm̐: ging chen bcu gnyis gnas nyul ma mo 'bum: rnal 'byor stangs 'byed ting 'dzin drod nyul ma: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bya ba mtha' ru phyin: lhag ma dang ni gser skyems mchod pa 'bul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: om̐ dz+nyā na ghṛ wa kro ti satwaṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul nas badz+ra muḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs/ chos skyong gtor 'bul skabs su de dag gi gtor ma rnams yang thog lta bur 'bul/ chad brtan la rgyun bzhag gi gtor ma phyir bskyang zhing rta bro brdung*/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas la nongs pa bshags/

ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin na brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag gi rnal 'byor yang 'od gsal du bsdu zhing rgyun spyod go bgo ba ni/ hūm̐: ngar 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di: bla med sku gsung thugs su rgyas btab nas: bden pa dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel te: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra hrīḥ.āḥ mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: stong pa'i go cha bla na med: chos sku skye med rdo rje yin: mtshan ma'i spyod yul kun bcom nas: chos kyi dbyings su rgyas btab pas: sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na: gnod byed bgegs kyis ga la mthong : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: om̐ badz+ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta hūm̐: zhes rgyas gdab bo/ gnyis pa mtshams bkrol zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rgyal tho bzhi la zlum gtor bzhi sgo byang gnyis la dmar gtor re re dang*/ phyi mchod bcas bsham/ phyi rol shar gyi tho rtsar phyin te/ mchod pa byin rlob pa ni/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyi gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hūm̐: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : dri za grul bum tshogs bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs phyi yi dung sgo phyes:

dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: zhi ba'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas lho yi tho rtsar phyin la mchod gtor rnams/ byin brlab sngar ltar ram bsdu na/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlabs la/ om̐ bai rū dha kā ya ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: gshin rje me lha'i tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs phyi yi gser sgo phyes: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: rgyas pa'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : srin po klu yi tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs phyi yi zangs sgo phyes: dbang gi dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: dbang gi las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas byang gi tho rtsar 'khod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: rlung lha dbang ldan tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs phyi yi lcags sgo phyes: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: drag po'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas sgo byang phyi nang bkrol ba ni/ phyi sgor mchod gtor bshams/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kaḥ yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: bar gyi sgo mtshams phyes su gsol: rtog med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: bkra shis dge legs mdzad du gsol: badz+ra muḥ zhes lha gshegs sgo byang bsdu'o/ 'byung ba rnams bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: nyi zla rlung sa 'byung ba bzhi: de ring dkyil 'khor mtha' ru phyin: rgya yi gdams pa dkrol du gsol: 'byung ba rang byung mkha' la thim: zhes rgya bkrol la gser skyems mchod/ de nas nang sgor mchod gtor bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dam tshig bdud rtsi'i mchog: yab yum sprul pa 'khor bcas rnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pas: nang gi srung 'khor bkrol du gsol: dam tshig ye shes dbyings su gshegs: bkra shis dge legs brtan du gsol: om̐ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ me tog dang gser skyems dang bcas sgo byang bsdu'o/ de yang khro bcu'i phur pa bsdu ba ni/ nang du sleb ma thag slob dpon nam rgyal tshab pa dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod la 'og gi phur bu'am nub kyi phur bu phyi ma lag gnyis skam pa'i rgya dang bcas/ om̐ badz+ra kī la ya ut+kī la ya badz+ra dha rod a dz+nyā pa ya te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: blangs te/ om̐ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā: zhes phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i don yid la byas te dril bu dkrol zhing*/

om̐ swa bhā wa laṃ san te hoḥ ā kā ro? sogs sngags brjod bzhin 'jam rol bcas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin na slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i re khā nang du bskor zhing las rdor pas rdul tshon dbus su bsdus la slob dpon gyi dngos grub spyi bor bkod/ ras bris dkyil 'khor yin na bsdu'o/ gsum pa thog mar nongs bshags bya ba ni/ mched lcam rnams phan tshun du phyag byas la res mos tshul gyis/ hoḥ thams cad rdo rje mched dang lcam dral te: bde bar gshegs pa'i slob ma dam mnos nas: kun kyang mthun par spyod pa'i dam tshig la: mnyam nyid ngang las legs nyes dbyer med kyang : lus ngag rnam par dag pa'i tshul tsam du: gzhung las nyams shing thugs dang 'gal ba rnams: rnam dag bsam pas mi gnas tshig 'dis bshags: 'dzin med ngang du bzod par bzhes mdzod la: rang bzhin dag pa'i tshangs pa bstsal du gsol: a a āḥ de na rdo rje slob dpon la gtang rag 'bul zhing bzod par gsol ba ni/ thams cad kyi phyag bya lus longs spyod 'bul ba'i blos/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal mchog ldan: gsung rab rgya mtshos lha mi'i 'dren pa'i dpal: yang dag don ston 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyob: 'jig rten 'di na pha ma'i tshul du gnas: bka' drin bzang yang bsnyen bkur rngo ma thogs: sdom gsum bsrung bya dam tshig gang nyams kyang : nyes ltung sgrib par mi 'gyur 'dag bya'i phyir: mthol bshags bzod par gsol gyis tshangs par stsol: zhes zhabs spyi bor blangs shing bla ma spyi gtsug tu 'bral med bzung ngo*/ nongs bshags dang bka' drin gsol ba gnyis so/ spros med skabs ma byas kyang chog go /de nas smon lam spyi ltar gdab pa ni thal mo sbyar la/ kye hoḥ mi gnas ye shes chos kyi dkyil 'khor du: ma bcos lhun grub yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' lung yongs rdzogs nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog:

'di lta bu yi dkyil 'khor rtag tu brtson: bka' drin che ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang : lu gu rgyud kyis 'brel ba'i mched lcam rnams: 'bral med dag pa'i zhing du 'tshogs par smon: bla med sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma thob bar: sa lam mthar phyin 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: sku gsum ye shes lnga la spyod par shog: ces rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis smon lam gdab/ khyad par mar me'i smon lam bya ba ni/ thams cad kyis lag g.yas su mar me dang g.yon du spos ring thogs la/ rgyal thebs pas stong thun zur gsal ltar sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len byas te/ hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi dbu mdzad nas: dam tshig ldan pa'i mched dang lcam dral rnams: deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing : ma rig mun pa'i nang du mi 'khyams shog: gcong rong zab mo'i gnas su mi skye dang : dmyal ba'i zangs khar gnas su mi ltung zhing : gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi grags shing : mtshon cha gdug pa'i dbal gyis mi phog shog: rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin che ba dang : mtshan ldan gzungs ma rdo rje mched lcam rnams: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: sa bcu rim gyis khyad par bgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos 'chi ba'i dus bzung tshe: ma rig dbang gis 'khor bar ltung srid na: snang gsal mar mes ma rig sdug bsngal sel: nyon mongs dbang gis rigs drug gnas 'khyams na: snang gsal mar mes 'gro drug sdug bsngal sel: rgyu mchog 'di yis sa bcu yongs sgrol te: shes bya'i sgrib sbyangs phyir mi ldog par shog: snang gsal go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di: bde gshegs yongs la phul ba'i mthu byin gyis: sa bcu 'das te sa rnams yongs non shog: kun tu 'od dang ma chags pad+ma'i spyan:

'khor lo tshogs chen stug po bkod pa'i sa: de wa ko sha kun bzang dbyer med sa: rdo rje sems ming lcang lo can gyi gnas: bla ma'i sa dang srid gsum gzhir rdzogs sa: rtsod bral lhun po'i sa la thig le yi: sa lam 'gro rnams ma lus lhun bgrod nas: gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don yongs rdzogs shog:

ces dang rang lugs bka' brgyad kyi mar me'i smon lam gnyis gang bder bya'o/ gzhan yang spro na theg pa chen po spyi dang khyad par gyi smon lam rgya cher gdab pas/ dus gnyan pa'i phyir 'grub par 'gyur ro/ gzhan du spros pa la dga' ba dag rdul tshon chur gshegs sogs bya bar mos na gzhan du shes par bya'o/ de nas bkra shis spos bskor rgyas spros la zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs/ gzhan so sor 'byung ba'i shis brjod rgyas par spel la/ me tog gi char du bsnyil te/ rol mo snyan par 'khrol ba sogs kyis dge legs su bya'o/ kha skong dang las myur du 'grub pa'i sbyin sreg grub na mchog tu 'gyur zhing gnas srung dang dga' ston sogs mtha' rgyas gzhan du bshad pa ltar ci 'grub byas pas phyin chad legs tshogs rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ de ltar tshogs sgrub legs bshad zla ba'i ma/ /rnam dpyod dri med srub shing gyis bsrubs pas/ /legs thon dge tshogs shar gyi thig le 'di/ /bstan 'gro'i rgud mun sel ba'i gsos su smon/ /de lta na yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /ma rtogs log rtog 'gal 'khrul gang mchis pa/ /chos spyan ldan pa rnams kyi drung 'chags nas/ /legs par bsgrubs la gsol ba lan brgyar 'debs/ /'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba'i cha/ /cung zad mchis na ring nas bskyangs pa yi/ /ma rgan 'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /rnam grol gtan bde dam pa'i dpal thob shog /de ltar bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi /sgrub pa'i khog dbub dngos grub nyi ma 'gugs pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba tshul 'dir mi 'phrog pa'i dad mos rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i 'brong smad bla ma karma lung rigs rgya mtsho yul gangs can nas ngal dub la ma ltos par tshul 'di dpar skrun la sri zhu'i slad 'byor ba dang*/ 'brong pa rdo shul du skyes pa'i sgrub bla gi li o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul nas kyang lo gsum sgrub pa'i bar gseng ma lus par 'di ga'i dpe sgrig las 'gan dwang blang zhus nas tha ma'i dpe gzugs bskrun la nye skabs 'di ltar sgrub khog bgyis rogs zhes nan bskul ngor/

gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nam/ sgo chen sprul phreng lnga par 'bod pa'i snyoms las pas/ rgyal khams chos bzhin skyong ba'i kha bzhi lho yi ljongs/ dpal 'brug pa'i rgyal khab chen po'i chos srid gser gyi 'khor los mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i cha shas shar phyogs bkra shis g.yang rtse rdzong khongs btsan mkhar slob grwa ru/ skal ldan 'dus pa stong phrag du mar snying thig ya bzhi'i smin grol 'bogs pa'i bar gseng du rab rgyan zhes pa chu mo lug gi lo rgyal gyi nya ba nyin byed dbang po chu srin gyi khyim du zhugs shing dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i res gza' rgyal po'i bu dang rgyu skar gyi bu mo drag mo lhan cig rtsen pa'i dus sbyor nor srung rgyal po'i srung ba'i char grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang yid srub bdud kyi dpung gi ru dar bsnyil zhing gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' thang phyogs bcur rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //
